items.name: Astrowig
items.description: You'll have the perfect hairdo with the Astrowig.

items.name: Bunny Ears
items.description: These ears will accentuate your bright smile and really ramp up the gossip and rumours circulating behind your back.

items.name: Megacape
items.description: This cape used to belong to a famous hero who was famous for confronting the terrible Doctor Wily. This beast wanted to invade and dominate the World of Twelve with his army of summoned creatures. The good Doctor died before his minions had finished eating what he called "the last supper".

items.name: Viootifool Cape
items.description: Silvia herself sewed this cape together from old curtains. The result looks more like a mop that's been boiled in Lousy Pig blood. It just goes to show you can always do worse.

items.name: Megahelmet
items.description: This helmet is perfect for excelling in the most extreme situations and the most exclusive company.

items.name: Viootifool Helmet
items.description: This helmet once belonged to old Jojo, a renowned hero of times gone by. He is world famous for his epic travels, but it's still hard to understand the legendary devotion of his fans.

items.name: Winter Cloak
items.description:
A pretty, warm, powerfully smelling lining was sewn beautifully onto an ordinary cape.
Around your shoulders, or lain in front of a roaring fire like a Gobball-skin rug, you'll find some use for this cape. Eventually.

items.name: Earmuffs
items.description: These very soft earmuffs will keep your big floppy ears nice and warm.

items.name: Brilliant Hermiturtlook
items.description: Only slightly dated, this hat will give you a unique look – one that's sure to attract wallflowers like flies. Perfect for those warm summer night parties.

items.name: Broken Mount Stinkky Shield
items.description: This shield has seen a few battles too many and in this state it is good for nothing. Bouwada, in Pandala village, might be able to replace it for you.

items.description: This porous but absorbent yellow shield was made from the remains of a creature who used to live in a Pineapi Mask at the bottom of the sea.

items.name: Burnt Feudala Shield
items.description: This shield has seen a few battles too many, and in this state, is good for nothing. Perhaps Bouwada, in Pandala village, could replace it for you.

items.name: Vanished Aerdala Shield
items.description: This shield has seen a few battles too many and in this state it is good for nothing. Bouwada, in Pandala village, might be able to replace it for you.

items.name: Pineapi Mask
items.description: This exotic, fruit-shaped mask is a real collector's item. It is absolutely useless, but you'll look original and tasty. People appreciate the effort.

items.name: Pineapi Bag
items.description: Made from magical pineapi, this nothing-less-than-original bag suffers from a slight design fault: it hasn't been hollowed out. That means you can't put anything in it. And it's very heavy. A bit like your Iop friend who's been spending all his time in the Astrub Inn for several months. What's more, contrary to appearances, the Pineapi Bag is not part of the Pineapi set. In short, it's a completely useless item, and therefore an absolute must-have.

items.name: Pineapi Cape
items.description: Some adventurers complain that this cape is as rough as a Crocodyl's skin, and others say that it's even coarser than a Bwork's bottom. So, by careful to wear it the right way round, or you may regret it.

items.name: Champion Boots
items.description:
Some adventurers say these boots allow you to walk on traps without activating them. But be careful, as that might be a trap in itself...
(Place these boots over a pair of already-equipped boots to change their appearance.)

items.name: Champion Cape
items.description: This splendid cape will give you the allure of a real champion.

items.name: Champion Helmet
items.description: With this imposing helmet, you'll become big-headed for sure, if you aren't already!

items.name: Champion Belt
items.description: With this low-slung belt around your hips, you'll finally be able to hide your least flattering attributes.

items.name: Mini Champion
items.description: This small creature only follows champions... You might get a few days out of it before it realises you're a hopeless imposter. From then on, you'll be wearing the leash.

items.name: Coney Cap
items.description: Who would dare wear such ridiculous headgear? No one, if not you.

items.name: Indifferent Coney Cape
items.description: The power of this cape? When you turn your back to someone, your utter indifference will cause them to weep instantly. Only for the very spiteful among you.

items.name: Coney Hat
items.description: If you're planning to communicate with Wabbits, this might be the hat you need. If you want to look good, put it on someone next to you.

items.name: The HmmMmmmMmmm
items.description: Mmmmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm, mmm mmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm mmmmmmm mmmmmm mmm mmmm'm mmmmm mmmm mmmmmmm.

items.name: Wicked Sword
items.description: Vlad fell in love with this wonderful sword. He entered the most terrifying of all Dragokart races to get enough money to buy it. Unfortunately, he didn't know that the sword was cursed.

items.name: Satanass Hat
items.description: Satanass was a figure skater slicing up pretty much everywhere, taking part in prestigious contests and enlivening second-rate galas. While recovering from a broken tailbone, he had a life-changing revelation: his destiny was to be the most talented Dragokart driver of his generation! A little bump can sometimes leave a hefty lump.

items.name: Sharkal Shield
items.description: This shield will protect you for now, but don't be fooled, it won't last.

items.name: Sidimote Shield
items.description: This shield will remind your opponents you grew up in the Sidimote Moors. That alone could be enough to scare them away.

items.name: Phtalmo
items.description: This shield is covered with peepers to allow you to give one of those devastating multi-evil-eyes. Unstoppable.

items.name: Inn Shield
items.description: The Innkeeper at the Feubuk Brewery in Bonta was bored to death one day when he suddenly got the idea of equipping his bouncers with neon advertising shields.

items.name: Akwadala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Akwadala should do the trick.

items.name: Fan Shield
items.description: When your allies run out of breath, or when you want to clear the air after an unexpected wind of panic, this shield can save your life. The only thing you need to do is to shake it energetically in all directions, like you'd do with a hungry baby.

items.name: Sadida Shield
items.description: Sadidas originally used this shield as a stool when they needed to rest. If you tuck in your feet, it will protect you from a wide range of attacks. Nothing will protect you from the cruel laughter of your opponents, however.

items.name: Shield in Briefs
items.description: This surprising creation is covered in a pair of Chafer Lancer Leather Briefs which have been boiled, cleaned and stretched so that they hug the arm as perfectly as they did the full, generous curves of Chafer Lancer's... I think that's quite enough of that actually.

items.name: Asse Shield
items.description: This magnificent shield contains a few drops from the Asse Sea. Not only does it bring good luck but it can also be used as a flask.

items.name: Treechnid Shield
items.description: Hidden behind this shield, some naive adventurers could mistake you for a Treechnid and run off screaming. Most will attack all the more eagerly, thinking they can get some amber out of you.

items.name: Pandawa Shield
items.description: Perfect if you want to fit in on Pandala, or to stand out anywhere else! The biggest advantage of this shield is that it's entirely covered with hypoallergenic Pandawa hair, so now you don't need to pack your underwear and your armour in separate suitcases when you take your vacation.

items.name: Fire Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Fire element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Air Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Air element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Earth Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Earth element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Water Dial
items.description: This special shield will protect you from the Water element and will also give your opponents plenty of time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

items.name: Lumberjack Shield
items.description: This shield used to protect lumberjacks from falling trees. Its function quickly changed and now it is more often used to protect warriors from enemies who tend to land on them without warning!

items.name: Mount Stinkky Shield
items.description: Greenish and smelly, this shield remains a first choice for protection when it comes to fighting the creatures of green and smelly Mount Stinkky.

items.name: Imp Shield
items.description: If your dearest dream is to become a real imp, this is the shield you need. Passed down from generation to generation, it will enable you to rob all the young Astrubian adventurers you like without getting hurt.

items.name: Heart Quarter
items.description: A renowned adventurer spent his whole life looking for all four quarters of this shield. Some say that when the shield is complete, it has the exact opposite effect of that of breaking a mirror.

items.name: Bawbawian Shield
items.description: Not all Wabbits are nice little creatures. In fact, all Wabbits are vile creatures. Some get their kicks smashing up Cawwots with this huge shield and taking baths in the juice.

items.name: Derma Tho
items.description: This shield of skin will fit you like a glove. Don't forget to treat its warts and furuncles from time to time to prevent them from getting worn.

items.name: Captain Amakna Shield
items.description: A young adventurer once dreamt of joining the Bonta militia to protect the oppressed. Considered morally unfit for service, he was contacted by an Amakna alchemist who took advantage of his good nature, using him as a guinea-pig for his potions. You'll be glad to know that this is one story that ends... well, the middle bit is happy. He became so strong that he was known forever more as Captain Amakna and had this reputedly indestructible shield forged for him. The end... well, you don't wanna know the end.

items.name: Kloome
items.description: This huge shield saved the famous adventurer Kloome from an awful death: squashed under the weight of a Crackler who was in love with him. The legend doesn't say if he survived the side effects of his subsequent romance with the stony beast.

items.name: Flying Shield
items.description: As strange as it might sound, some say this shield of wood and hair enables the lightest adventurers to become airborne for a brief moment... a final attempt to shock their enemies before falling flat on their faces.

items.name: LeChouque's Shield
items.description: LeChouque used this shield to protect himself from the friendly cannonballs his friends regularly tossed to him. Some crazy stories tell that some of those balls were alive.

items.name: Gobball Shield
items.description: Although it's all but useless, its stench alone will spread your fame far and wide. This shield accompanies many young adventurers on their first quests - maybe that's why so few make it to thirty.

items.name: Bowisse's Shield
items.description: This shield is a tribute to Bowisse's Cloak which itself was a tribute to a famous relic composed of three triangular shapes. Blimey, all this history is putting me to sleep.

items.name: Crackler Shield
items.description: This stone shield is in fact made from a Crackler's head, smashed by the foot of a Minotoror. A perfect combination of big head and smelly feet.

items.name: Terrdala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Terrdala should do the trick.

items.name: Feudala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Feudala should do the trick.

items.name: Aerdala Shield
items.description: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Aerdala should do the trick.

items.name: Tipsy Top Hat
items.description: There was an unbeatable Cra, who performed all attacks from afar. He thought it quite strange, when the Neye stole his range, and his hits became very sub par!

items.name: Oirish Tailcoat
items.description: A thirsty Pandawa went west, to see which great city was best. Not Bontarian beer, which was empty of cheer, but Brakmar's was quite full of zest!

items.name: Galgarion's Helmet
items.description: In spite of appearances, this helmet won't help your hearing. It'll help you see farther, though. Just watch out for any strong winds or you'll be blown away like a little feather.

items.name: Goultard's Headgear
items.description: This headgear won't really make you any more fearsome or powerful... If you think for a moment that some naive souls will mistake you for Goultard, well you're crazy. Your enemies will see you coming from miles away, that's all.

items.name: Master Black Jack's Headgear
items.description: The Eniripsa Master Black Jack has always been passionate about sewing. What's more, that's what led him to become an expert in stitches. A friend to tailors, he created this two-coloured headdress using inspiration from the one belonging to a cruel tailor who once massacred the Ouginaks of the Macians tribe... how charming!

items.name: Pepitoo's Sombrero
items.description: This sombrero belonged to a sombre Xelor hero nobody hears from anymore. The last time Pepitoo was sighted, he was serenading his beloved. Some say that his fiancée's brothers had something to do with his disappearance. Others say he was whisked away into a parallel dimension just like that. The mystery has never been solved...

items.name: XVII's Horns
items.description: If you keep trying to butt the horns off your enemies, you're the one whose head will start to resemble a sieve! The horns of XVII, the Demon of the Seventeenth Hour, are cursed: they have the power to make you forget everything... except maybe when lunch is!

items.name: Cra's Burnt Headgear
items.description: This headgear is perfect for Cras who don't mind looking average. Careful though, you will look very silly, stupid even. Usually this headgear is given to retired combatants who've lost a good portion of their brain cells.

items.name: Pym's Blade
items.description: This blade was stolen from a smith's shop window where it had laid for many years. Let's hope it sees more use in your hands than it did with its previous owner! If not, it's not going to be much good unless you open your own shop.

items.name: K Cap
items.description: Lice used to eat your head. Not anymore: this new confectionery headgear will divert the nasty creatures. Now they'll graze on your hat instead, like a herd of tiny, white cows.

items.name: K Cape
items.description: Roll it up in fruity jam, cover it in jelly and resist the temptation to scoff it. This treat is best enjoyed as a suppository.

items.name: Beanie Cape
items.description: Made from enormous coffee beans, this cape smells like a Pikoko's armpit. It really gets the blood flowing before a battle... and it's cheap, too.

items.name: Beanie Hat
items.description: Pop in two sugars, give it a quick stir, and quench your thirst with this revitalising hat. Sugar sold separately.

items.name: Livitinem Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Livitinem Hat
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.

items.name: Livitinem Amulet
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate amulets.

items.name: Livitinem Ring
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate rings.

items.name: Hamm'Ornet
items.description: The little wings attached to this hammer make it lighter and easier to handle... It can even fly on its own and hit you on the head while you're sleeping. Hilarious.

items.name: Beezing Cape
items.description: The sting sticking out the end of this cape will prevent you enemies from kicking your backside, but you probably won't be able to sit down...

items.name: Bee Hat
items.description: By wearing this hat, you have to accept that you're running the risk of being hit by a Moskitoswatter.

items.name: Piggibits
items.description: These ears are still warm, and they'll let you seduce any Lousy Pig you meet. Don't laugh; you still don't know how lonely you can get in the Cania Plains.

items.name: Cork Cloak
items.description: Also known as the "Cloak Screw", this item of clothing will be of no use for uncorking bottles. Admit that you're disappointed.

items.name: Eastern Wood Hat
items.description: Not as trendy as the Clint is, but a lot more elegant, this hat will show the others how sophisticated you are.

items.name: Eastern Wood Cape
items.description: This cape will protect your back from getting sunburnt. Be careful: it doesn't go all the way down to every adventurer's buttocks. It is therefore advised you wear underpants if you don't want to show your backside to the whole world.

items.name: Lemon Hat
items.description: Your head will easily fit this humongous emptied lemon and the little pip inside it will feel at home!

items.name: Citrus Cape
items.description: This cape was made from the peels of lots of different citrus fruits. It's a pretty, refreshing cape, but unfortunately it doesn't glow in the dark.

items.name: Strawaff
items.description: If you've ever dreamt of drinking your enemies' blood while hitting them relentlessly, this weapon's made for you!

items.name: Crystalline Hat
items.description: The next barber who tries to give you a haircut will be lucky not to break their comb.

items.name: Crystalline Cape
items.description: This huge piece of crystal can be used as a cape, albeit a rather stiff one. This item of clothing may be uncomfortable, but the next monster that tries to devour you will surely cut themself on it.

items.name: Bobblecape
items.description: If you think your backside never had the attention it deserved, just put on this long cape which will dress it up and catch everyone's attention.

items.name: Bobbl'Hat
items.description: This hat smells of demonic roses which should rid you off your lice, and any other parasites that have invited themselves to the party on your head.

items.name: St. Ballotwine's Day Hat
items.description: This magic hat can only be worn by adventurers who are not yet married, and so wearing it advertises your all-consuming desire to find a soulmate to all the other tragic loners in Amakna, who will flock around you at the nearest Zaap, clucking and squawking like broody hens. Inevitably, someone will let off a few Fairyworks in a vain attempt to win your affection, but you'll end up with a splitting headache, be unable to speak, and have the feeling that you're walking through treacle.

items.name: Poshat
items.description: If nothing else, the pin nailed into this hat will shrink a big-head...

items.name: Caposh
items.description: With such a nice target sewn upon your cape, your enemies will have no excuse for missing you.

items.name: Poshield
items.description: The pin nailed into this shield can be used as an extra-close combat weapon and kill your enemies.

items.name: Shield Kada
items.description: If you don't want to scare your friends away with your ugly face, just hide it behind this nice, welcoming shield.

items.name: Boh-Bihn Shield
items.description: When Iops get stars from their teachers for good work, they stick them to this shield. From time to time, they would stick them all over themselves to show off in front of their classmates.

items.name: Pac-Tiger Shield
items.description: This shield isn't quite a full protection guarantee for the owner, but it is great at chasing ghosts.

items.name: Cicapeda
items.description: The three little balls at the bottom of this cape will enable you to give great headbutts if you learn how to spin!!

items.name: Cicad'Hat
items.description: With or without this hat, you'll look like a buffoon... But with it, at least, you'll have a good excuse!

items.name: The Godfather's Cape
items.description: This cape will protect your neck from the wintry weather and your behind from low blows...

items.name: The Godfather's Fedora
items.description: This special hat will make you look like the Godfather. You should be proud!

items.name: Raydi Shield
items.description: The Raydi was first forged in the taverns of Pandala. It's said that this shield – inspired by the goddess Pandawa herself – provides protection from the effects of the krosmic ray. Reality, or a blip in communication between the blacksmiths of Pandawa Shields: it remains a mystery.

items.name: Black Wab Hat
items.description: Hopefully you'll look like a masked avenger wearing this hat, rather than a masked A-wenger. Alright, alright, it's been a long day -_-

items.name: Black Wab Cape
items.description: The little pompom at the end of this cape is the greatest duster ever... It's so small that it can even fit under your furniture. Don't forget to take it off when you go work in the fields.

items.name: Alowa Headband
items.description: This headband is perfect to absorb perspiration or to display your "Alowa Attitude".

items.name: Kwakap
items.description: The wings on this cap protect your ears from insults – but only the insults you dish out.

items.name: Alowa Cape
items.description: This cape will flatter the curves of your backside, or the hump on your back.

items.name: Poopapink Staff
items.description: Who gave that staff such a stupid appearance? Well, no one knows... But you'll still have to brandish it in front of your enemies... no matter how stupid YOU look doing so!

items.name: Slait Cape
items.description: Two tails on one body... A dream come true – finally!

items.name: Slait Nears
items.description: These ears may be covered with red fur, but they are the most aerodynamic ears you'll ever come across.

items.name: Sword Inary
items.description: This weapon was once a Shushumi capable of stealing Rushu's Shushus' soul fragments from monsters. Its magical properties seem to have dried up, making it of dubious use for most Twelvians... However, you can always use it as a cosmetic item!

items.name: Nutyprofe Sword
items.description: This weapon was once a Shushumi capable of stealing Rushu's Shushus' soul fragments from monsters. Its magical properties seem to have dried up, making it of dubious use for most Twelvians... However, you can always use it as a cosmetic item!

items.description: This weapon was once a Shushumi capable of stealing Rushu's Shushus' soul fragments from monsters. Its magical properties seem to have dried up, making it of dubious use for most Twelvians... However, you can always use it as a cosmetic item!

items.description:
This weapon was once a Shushumi capable of stealing Rushu's Shushus' soul fragments from monsters. Its magical properties seem to have dried up, making it of dubious use for most Twelvians... However, you can always use it as a cosmetic item!

Place these daggers over already-equipped daggers to change their appearance.

items.description: This weapon was once a Shushumi capable of stealing Rushu's Shushus' soul fragments from monsters. Its magical properties seem to have dried up, making it of dubious use for most Twelvians... However, you can always use it as a cosmetic item!

items.name: Bedazzling Horns
items.description: The legend says that these horns were used as a lightning rod, concentrating lightning for several hours and then projecting bolts towards any unwary people who came too close. Another legend says they just make their wearer look ridiculous.

items.name: Bedazzling Double Hakken Axe
items.description: This double-headed axe can cut off two heads in one swing, which equates to an eighth of a sixteen-headed hydra.

items.name: Siks Wonn Ein Mask
items.description: This mask makes you look like a giant mutant larva from a distance, and a terrifying warrior from up close. Best used in hand-to-hand combat.

items.name: Slamdance Mullet Hairdo
items.description: Long at the back, short on top, this hairdo has a bad reputation, but you'll surely change all that.

items.name: Siks Wonn Ein Cape
items.description: Every Rassler knows the most dangerous part of rassling is the crowd. So when the chairs and bottles come flying into the ring, wrap this Pikoko fur cape around yourself and curl up into the foetal position.

items.name: Darth Vaydhat
items.description: This helmet is perfect for people who look too kind. That can be very dangerous in the World of Twelve.

items.name: The Chatlin
items.description: This hat comes with a fake moustache that never grows – perfect for anyone who hates visiting the barber.

items.name: Swodor
items.description: This sword's blade was soaked in concentrated firefly juice for 18 months to make it glow in the dark. It now stinks in the dark too, by the way.

items.name: The Chapstick
items.description: This flexible bamboo cane is definitely not for leaning on... try twirling it round in the air instead.

items.name: Newddha the Prophet's Backpack
items.description: Newddha the Prophet is famous for renouncing his family's wealth and sitting under a Kokonut tree, waiting for enlightenment to dawn upon him. Instead, a giant Kokonut cracked him on the head, leading him to leave all that spiritual nonsense behind for good.

items.name: Hispañic Shield
items.description: The legendary Dal-Uk-Wet, who unified the Kingdom of Hispañia, had a magic shield. Sir-Dal, his great-grandson, had a few copies forged to reward his best warriors. This shield is one of these rare copies.

items.name: Unique Hispañic Shield
items.description: The legendary Dal-Uk-Wet, who unified the Kingdom of Hispañia, concentrated all his powers into his shield, to his enemies' great displeasure. Years later, Sir-Dal, his great-grandson, had copies forged to reward his best warriors... This very shield is no replica but indeed the original shield itself, rendering it the most powerful of all!

items.name: Chisp Shield
items.description: Ponch proudly wore this shield as he sat mounted on his Dragoturkey and ensured the safety of the streets of Bonta.

items.name: Chisp Helmet
items.description: This helmet will protect the skull of its wearer should they fall off a Dragoturkey. It also makes you look like an idiot, even if you aren't one.

items.name: Slugly Cloak
items.description: The pores of this cape exude a sticky slime. You'll look classy if you lie on your back and let it carry you along the floor.

items.name: Slugly Helmet
items.description: This slimy, dripping helmet will nourish your scalp and keep your hair shiny, if not healthy. The two eyes attached to the top can be connected to your skull if you agree to have the nerve endings inserted into your ears.

items.name: Solaris Shield
items.description: This shield will reflect the sun right into the eyes of your opponent. Instead of dazzling them with your blinding wit, blind them instead with your dazzling shi...eld.

items.name: Solaris Mask
items.description: This mask will capture the sunlight and concentrate it on your face so you can stay nice and brown all year round, even if you live to the north of Amakna.

items.name: Noke's Mask
items.description: Noke loved to put on this mask and hide in the woods to terrify lost ramblers. He died a long time ago after seeing his reflection in a puddle.

items.name: Noke's Cloak
items.description: Noke dreamt of becoming a big, bad wolf. Sadly, with this cloak on her shoulders, she was more like one of the three little pigs.

items.name: Noke's Daggers
items.description: A long time ago, there was an aggressive boar that dreamt of becoming a stag. These daggers were used to carve it up.

items.name: Oxo Helmet
items.description: This helmet will make you into an excellent protocol Wobot thanks to a unique device that translates the Oxon language in real time. It's also soundproof.

items.name: Koninginnedag Crown
items.description: To celebrate the birthday of an illustrious queen, a feast is held. This crown is usually worn on the day of the feast. Its magic is very powerful, and it can change the colour of the person who wears it to orange. This will make it easier to hide among people dressed in this colour.

items.name: Ughat
items.description: This headgear will keep your ears protected from cold and bad jokes.

items.name: Toot's Helmet
items.description: Only a Gobbowl player would come up with the crazy idea of disguising themselves as a Tofu to intimidate their opponent. Mind you, this helmet's aerodynamic shape allows the wearer to slice through the air like a missile. Maybe it's not such a crazy idea after all. Well, whatever, you'll certainly stand out from the crowd.

items.name: Benji's Helmet
items.description: It's the integrated red sunglasses that make this the helmet of choice for any self-respecting Lamechester United player.

items.name: Real Gobbly Shield
items.description: This imposing shield bears the marks of many a Gobbowl match. However, despite its robust, intimidating appearance, it'd be of no use at all in a real fight. You'd be better off using it to play peek-a-boo with Gobblies.

items.name: Lamechester United Shield
items.description: This imposing shield perfectly sums up today's youth: style over substance – all bark, and no bite. It'd be good for nothing in a real fight, unless your opponent was coming at you with a ball.

items.name: Grozillamulet
items.description: You won this amulet thanks to your incomparable capacity for breaking eggs without making an omelette.

items.name: Scale Shield
items.description: Fashioned from one of Grozilla's scales, this is a heavy shield of exceptional stature. Only rare and fearsome fighters may proudly wear it.

items.name: Master Lumberjack's Shield
items.description: This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.

items.name: The Black Crow's Cloak
items.description: Some thread, a needle, a few feathers taken from the remains of decaying Crobaks, and voilà! You're in possession of the most chic of cloaks!

items.name: The Black Crow's Helmet
items.description: You can't hide; you've been unmasked! So, the Black Crow is you after all! You would have gotten away with it too, if it weren't for those meddling kids!

items.name: The Black Crow's Piercing Lance
items.description: It may have taken you a while, but here it is, in your hands at last! The Black Crow's sword...

items.name: YeCh'Ti Amulet
items.description: When your enemies see this amulet around your smooth, slender neck they'll think you're actually as hairy as the YeCh'Ti, which will frighten the living daylights out of them.

items.name: Frost Hat
items.description: This hat is ideal for keeping your head cool and your ideas fresh. That said, if you don't want to look like an ugly ice cube, you'll have to find something else.

items.name: Frost Cape
items.description: Jon Lemon wore a similar cape during his famous concert in Brouce Boulgoure's Clearing. Those who weren't deafened still remember the concert's climax, when he stopped singing after becoming trapped in the ice because of his own cape.

items.name: Viopal Sword
items.description: Heavy, clumsy, dull and ugly, just how was Goultard able to become such a formidable fighter using this mediocre sword? Wielding it yourself will not improve your skills: it will just make you look ridiculous.

items.name: Capocalypse
items.description: This hat is so tight-fitting that it compresses the skull and causes strong hallucinations. Fortunately, Goultard wore it when he was young, and what's more, he has quite a small skull, which betrays his roots.

items.name: Youllbea Mantle
items.description: Goultard wore this mantle until he discovered the three sisters, when it was forgotten about in the back of an old cupboard.

items.name: Clementine Hat
items.description: Slap this hat on your head, peel it for a few hours, and eventually, if you're lucky, you might find a tiny pip.

items.name: Clementine Cape
items.description: The cape, which releases a pleasant citrus aroma as you walk, will transform you into a powerful Moskito trap.

items.name: Pynekone Hat
items.description: Padded with Bow Meow hair and covered with bark, this hat is extremely flammable. You should not sit on it if your pants are on fire.

items.name: Pynekone Cape
items.description: In hot weather, this cape's scales spread open to help your sweat evaporate. When it rains, this cape's scales spread open to let the rain in and rinse your posterior.

items.name: Lonne's Hammer
items.description: When it comes to sounding out his opponents, Lonne Jenone has more than one string to his fiddle – he uses it as a hammer. One thing is certain: sparks will fly!

items.name: Lonne's Cape
items.description: This leather cape, though light, will accompany you on all your incredible rides on the back of a Dragoturkey.

items.name: Lonne's Hat
items.description: Before being worn by Lonne Jenone, this hat belonged to Sergeant Payper, who was a rather quiet chap rarely prone to sticking his oar in.

items.name: Gadjet's Hat
items.description: Gadget was one of the most creative handymen the World of Twelve has ever seen. Unfortunately, he was also one of the most daft. They say he mistook his wife's head for his anvil on more than one occasion, although she didn't complain, apparently.

items.name: Gadjet's Cape
items.description: Gadget made this cape in the hope that it might enable him to fly and thus more easily escape the beatings administered daily by his wife.

items.name: Grillian's Hat
items.description: Grillian was a great magician. He is most famous for having reinventing the wheel, having forgotten how to manufacture them.

items.name: Grillian's Cape
items.description: This cape is supposed to protect your posterior from carnivorous plant bites.

items.name: Legend of the Dungeons Boots
items.description:
Their soles may be worn but these boots are very comfortable. They have trampled the soil of the most dangerous dungeons as well as the heads of the most vicious monsters.

(Place this pair of boots over another, already-equipped pair of boots to change their appearance.)

items.name: Paper Cape
items.description: This cape is long enough for you to be able to afford to leave blank lines between each cribbed note you've made before you take that all-important, life-changing exam.

items.name: Paper Hat
items.description: The tailor who made this hat had to use 12 powerful characteristic scrolls to craft it. Or possibly 12 sheets of toilet paper.

items.name: Feather Cape
items.description: This huge feather cape accentuates your figure.

items.name: Feather Hat
items.description: In some tribes, the wisdom of the Chief is measured by the number of feathers on his hat. Yours has only one, and what's more, it's very small and quite grubby.

items.name: Poppinz Cape
items.description: The last person who tried to use this cape to fly down from a cloud crashed into a bank.

items.name: Poppinz Hat
items.description: This hat isn't waterproof, and as a result, you'll have to use a ridiculous umbrella wherever you go.

items.name: Prisoner Cape
items.description: The striped cape belonged to a prisoner famous for his predicament.

items.name: Prisoner Hat
items.description: This striped hat is big enough to hide a skull, especially if it's numb.

items.name: Borbacape
items.description: This cloak with a ridiculous name is intriguing nonetheless, and belonged to a righteous man who claimed he wanted to clean up the streets of Brakmar. Nobody knows if he was a vigilante or a dustman.

items.name: Borbahat
items.description: This hat will give you the allure of a Borbat. You're single at the moment, right? Yeah, you're going to stay single for quite a while.

items.name: Pinokio Cape
items.description: This wooden cape grows larger when you lie. There's a good chance you'll trip over it regularly as a result.

items.name: Pinokio Hat
items.description: You can also use this hat as traffic cone should you have an accident while riding your Dragoturkey.

items.name: Jon Lemon's Cape
items.description: Jon Lemon loved this cape to death, which explains why he wears it to each of his funerals.

items.name: Jon Lemon's Hat
items.description: This old hat is bordering on the ridiculous, and it's how Jon Lemon earned the nickname "The Moustachioed Grandmother". That name tends to put him in a bad mood.

items.name: Jon Lemon's Blowpipe
items.description: Jon Lemon should never have used this blowpipe just after eating. Since then, he's had to use it as a simple staff, and as he so often says, "it was better before".

items.name: Blue Tofu
items.description: They say blue tofus do not exist. They say no one alive today has ever seen one. Yet on very cold mornings when mist still clings to the soles of your boots, you can sometimes find a blue feather amongst all the yellow one in the squares in front of tofu houses. Finding such a feather is considered a blessing, for the visit of the mysterious Blue Tofu is always a sign of joy, everlasting and bountiful.

items.name: Island Pearl Necklace
items.description:
This little necklace made from island pearls exudes a soft bluish aura that evokes powerful memories of adventures on the beautiful, cerulean sea.

Only the small note on the back of this exquisite piece shatters the idyllic illusion: "Made in IOW".

items.name: Stasili
items.description: This very special, extremely rare rock is excavated by Enutrofs without them ever being able to find any value for it. Dark and crumbly, it cannot be used for construction, or as an ornament, and has very little commercial value. It would seem that its low resistance could make it an inexpensive form of protection. However, the most notable effect of this rock is to plunge the person who carries it into a deep depression.

items.name: The Hive
items.description: Hives are rare, very rare. Because bees are our friends, because we like to spread our bread with good honey, because our flowers like to be pollinated, we carry our own hives! And from these chambers, the juice of these adorable little things, worthy heirs of the mythical little goddess Beebee, will flow.

items.name: Elia Ring
items.description: A strange ring, imitating a cube with unknown properties. Is it a thimble? A game die? A small chest? Nobody ever knew the answer. It was thought, probably wrongly, that it could be an imitation of an ancient, long-forgotten artefact whose shape could have survived the fashions, irrespective of its use. One reason for its success remains the welfare and assurance it provides its wearer, as if protected beyond time and space.

items.name: Platypus Helmet
items.description: This helmet is used by the hostesses of Osamodas temples to welcome new candidates to the annual competition of the best trainers in Astrub. The idea of using the Platypus as a mascot for the event came after the pet, known as being indomitable, was introduced to the masses. The trainer who can subdue the animal has definitely earned his stripes. So far, no one has succeeded, the animal preferring to choose its own master and do exactly whatever it wants. Holders of the cap believe themselves to be rebel elements of a theocratic society known for its rigidity.

items.name: Percimol's Cape
items.description: This cape perfectly illustrates Percimol's favourite saying: React, resist, and never relinquish!

items.name: Percimol's Mask
items.description: No one will mistake you for a Scarecrow with this mask on your pudgy little face, unless you're a Xelor dwarf or the person you're talking to is a Iop. Yes, "a" Iop, because it's pronounced Yop. So there.

items.name: Stroud's Hat
items.description: Fed up of being mistaken for a slob because of his hat, Stroud had the ingenious idea of attaching a kama to it with a piece of Minotoror leather. The result was immediate: people mistook him for a wrinkled old skinflint instead.

items.name: Pol the Octopus's Hat
items.description: Pol the Octopus, also known as the Frigostian Oracle, was capable of predicting the results of various tournaments and bets. He ended his life as a kebab, sliced up with some red and green peppers, some onions, drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with ground black pepper. Oh, but he was so delicious! *burp*

items.name: Cauldron Hat
items.description: Dressed up in this strange hat, you have the strangest desire to stagger off to the nearest tavern, and drink Shambrosia until you fall quietly into an apathetic stupor. A bit like you usually do, come to think of it.

items.name: Phoenix
items.description: This pet can arise from its ashes by itself, just like a grown one.

items.name: Wicked Protector
items.description: This light, airy shield is great for showing off with, but not much more. For once, however, you merit your fifteen minutes of fame, so make the most of them.

items.name: Percimol's Hammer
items.description: This hammer, which is as heavy as the atmosphere generated when Rattedauge tells one of his "jokes", is perfect for crushing the Minotoror's hooves. It is equally effective should you wish to smash other, just-as-sensitive body parts.

items.name: Bearendizer's Belt
items.description: Certain adventurers claim that Bearendizer, in order to become the most powerful of all the Bearbarians, sold his soul to Djaul and, since then, his physical incarnation has been controlled by the bee on his shoulder, Actahive. This is only a rumour, though, and they're probably just trying to justify the fact that they're not very muscular.

items.name: Rogueraider
items.description: A long time ago, a Rogue and a Masqueraider were rivals for the hand of a famous tailor. When she wouldn't give a response, the infuriated suitors asked her to make a mask in the effigy of whichever one of them she preferred. Unable to make up her mind, she made the Rogueraider, a mask that resembled both the Rogue and the Masqueraider. After consultation, the two suitors decided to go and fight over the hand of another tailor instead.

items.name: Hir Hat
items.description: Part of the Hir Suit, this hat will let you bungee jump using your hair.

items.name: Hir Cape
items.description: Watch out for Prespics, who will be all too happy to rub up against you.

items.name: Apprentice Cloak
items.description: Working as an apprentice is no picnic, but it lets you progress faster than theory-based lessons, especially when your employer is the most famous alchemist around.

items.name: 639 Champion Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: Tetra Cloak
items.description: Warning: It seems that if you line up with other adventurers while wearing this cape, you might make them disappear.

items.name: Tetra Hammer
items.description: This hammer will fill the hole in your enemy's head perfectly.

items.name: Parasymbic Hat
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.

items.name: Parasymbic Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Parasymbic Belt
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate belts.

items.name: Parasymbic Boots
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate boots.

items.name: Boratt
items.description: It probably won't surprise you to hear the hairs on this hat didn't come from anyone's head.

items.name: Pandalida Cloak
items.description: Drape yourself in this cloak and adopt your most romantic look, squint slightly, and stare deep into the eyes of your heart's latest desire. They'll fall instantly. Down dead, that is.

items.name: Pandalida Headband
items.description: This pretty headband will make you look like a right diva. It won't do much for your masculinity either.

items.name: Pandalida Staff
items.description: Nobody ever taught Pandalida the art of war. She taught herself everything she knew. The way she held her staff, in particular, was very unconventional. She would point it at her mouth and scream from the top of her lungs. This quickly earned her the reputation of being one of the most monstrous killers of her time.

items.name: Mr. Amakna Amulet
items.description: This amulet makes you living proof that you can take pride in your appearance even in this world of bloodthirsty brutes who wallow in the mud all day. As long as those weren't the criteria by which you were chosen...

items.name: Miss Amakna Amulet
items.description: This amulet makes you living proof that you can take pride in your appearance even in this world of bloodthirsty brutes who wallow in the mud all day. Bet you feel just like Queen of the Lousy Pigs now...

items.name: Mr. World of Twelve Amulet
items.description: Your bulging muscles, your towering stature and your charisma have made you the World of Twelve's most gorgeous adventurer, and this amulet proves it. We all know that you were lucky not to have to sit an IQ test, though.

items.name: Miss World of Twelve Amulet
items.description: This amulet is the proof that you have been elected "most beautiful adventuress in the World of Twelve". Now you have to live with that burden and do all you can to retain your title. In the end, you'll probably regret the whole thing.

items.name: Spacevader Hat
items.description: With this hat on your head, you'll look out of this world. Or out of your mind. Probably the latter.

items.name: Spacevader Staff
items.description: It has been said that this staff is able to deal mortal blows which can destroy any invader with just one blow. Only a fool would fall for a thing like that.

items.name: Escudo Epico
items.description: This broad shield was forged in Amakna to protect the knights amidst the riots and wild bloodshed that occurred in the city following the genetic modification scandal caused by certain crazy alchemists who are members of N.E.R.F.

items.name: Caschoygan
items.description: The Caschoygan does protect the head rather effectively, but unfortunately it also covers the eyes, preventing the wearer from seeing and – worse – reading anything. Most of the time, adventurers end up writing a load of piffle and yelling nonsensical expressions such as "HOYGAN" in the hope that someone will notice them.

items.name: Cuarzomyr Masinko
items.description: This strange, rare sword is a replica of the one belonging to a Iop knight, well known for the wigs under which he tried desperately to hide his bald spot. Forged with magic filaments taken from the original sword, the Masinko can do great damage against dirty meanies (though they have to be at least 51% dirty). The Amaknian smiths cannot be held responsible for any side effects such as hair loss or uncontrollable cravings to drink dodgy green drinks at breakfast time.

items.name: Snarffe
items.description: Rumour has it that this hat makes its wearer fluent in all animal languages. Careful, though, as it would seem most of the monsters of Amakna have not inherited your great conversational skills, and greeting them amicably isn't going to discourage them from tearing you limb from limb.

items.name: Thundercape
items.description: No one could really figure out what this strange cloak looked most like: a giant rat? A dinosaur? A being from another galaxy? In any case, one thing's for sure: it systematically causes disgust in the whole of the female population of the World of Twelve. Use it wisely.

items.name: Incarnam Shield
items.description: With this shield, everyone can see that you've left Incarnam and joined the World of Twelve to set off on the long search for the Dofus.

items.name: Davyd's Cloak
items.description: Once very popular, Davyd's cloak was considered a staple of any inhabitant of the World of Twelve's wardrobe because of its cheap price, high quality, its simplicity and the big pocket on the back that can be used as a backpack. Unfortunately, the bag makers soon saw to it that this cape "disappeared", since it took away the very last advantage backpacks had over cloaks.

items.name: Davyd's Scythe
items.description: A great music lover, Davyd knocks 'em dead (both audiences and crops alike) with the strings attached to his scythe, which vibrate every time he swings it. In the time it took him to perfect his skill with this unique instrument, he managed to send all the other farmers running for the hills, meaning he now owns all the wheat fields in Amakna and his fortune is guaranteed.

items.name: Pongloak
items.description: The circle in the middle of the Pongloak bounces off one of the sides with each step you take, making a characteristic "pong" sound. Even after years and years of use, a lot of adventurers still find it fun. Maybe the simplest games really are the best!

items.name: Pongshovel
items.description: The flat, strangely-shaped Pongshovel is one of the worst shovels you could hope for when it comes to digging. It does make a pretty good table tennis paddle, though.

items.name: Nam Cape
items.description: With this cape on your back, you'll constantly have the feeling that someone's following you. It'll guarantee a non-stop flow of adrenaline, but is also likely to lead to acute paranoia.

items.name: Pacmaggers
items.description: For a long time, people believed that the Pacmaggers were throwing knives: their first users were scared the yellow ball that decorates their handles was going to gobble up their hands, which caused them to throw them instinctively. Nowadays, jumpy adventurers are banned from using them because of their unfair advantage over standard daggers.

items.name: Librarian Amulet
items.description: This little amulet is proof of your love of books, libraries and old, bespectacled owls. You can also use it as a bookmark.

items.name: 640 Champion Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: 641 Champion Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: Survivor Shield
items.description: You are one of the smallest mammals in the World to have witnessed Grozilla and Grasmera's extinction and the apocalypses which followed, and to have survived. With a bit of luck, you'll take a leaf out of your distant ancestors' book and set about evolving into something better now. I mean, you kind of need it.

items.name: Hapony
items.description: Put on this hat, get down on all fours and any adventurers who cross your path will think they've discovered a new breed of mount that's infinitely nicer and cuter than Dragoturkeys. Then, impale those trusting nincompoops with your horn. Or let them take you for a ride. Whichever you prefer.

items.name: Clomane
items.description: This long, soft and colourful mane, decorated with its pink flower bow, will attract the fervour and caresses of all the ladies in the World of Twelve. If you're one of them, that is. If you're a man, it will just remove your virility and remove you from your position as the alpha male. Forever.

items.name: Gladiahat
items.description: This hat will protect you like no other against your opponents' blows. Careful, though: it won't protect you against being stabbed, cut, burnt, scorched, scratched, slapped, insect bites, clingy adventurers, bad jokes, your own stupidity...

items.name: Gladiakane
items.description: Adventurers who don't know what this fighting cane with two round ends is for may assume it's for cleaning out a Trool's ears. Not so – it's just the right size for yours, though.

items.name: Wicked Roundel
items.description: Sick of seeing their roundels continually smashed to pieces, the three adventurers and cousins, Anne, Al and Arty Fissial, had a new one made that allowed them to do a little smashing of their own... until the day they met the Kwismas Minotoball, that is.

items.name: Wicked Shield
items.description: Anyone who equips the Wicked Shield will have a wicked time. Those were the words of Halden the Sram when he brought down the Kwismas Minotoball that was terrorising Amakna Village.

items.name: Eiderdat
items.description: This feathery, Turkohat-inspired hat will have your latest conquests all aflutter.

items.name: Eiderdape
items.description: Showing off this cape, decorated with beautifully coloured feathers, you should have the object of your affections falling at your feet. Just make sure you don't get your feet caught in it, though, or you could end up falling at theirs.

items.name: Feline's Hammegaphone
items.description: Every day, Feline does her singing exercises on the bridge of her ice prisoner boat, the Glass Heart, using her Hammegaphone. Little does she know, that's what keeps her safe from the region's monsters: the sound of Feline's amplified voice is so unbearable that all living creatures for kilokametres around run away and never come back. Only her husband, Rayné, stays. He's been a bit hard of hearing for quite a while, though.

items.name: Feline's Cape
items.description: If little Feline from Frigost managed to appeal to a huge audience and make a name for herself right across the Amaknian continent, you can bet it was this cape that got her noticed. Anyone who wears it on their shoulders will make a real spectacle of themselves, so Feline always played sell-out shows. Don't hope for too much when you put it on though, the public's not stupid enough to fall for it twice.

items.name: Stroud's Shovel
items.description: This shovel can do everything: dig earth, collect kamas, stun bandits and even repel your mother-in-law. As you can see, it's pretty much essential.

items.name: Scampiscuba Helmet
items.description: Mix new technology with traditional methods and you end up with the Scampiscuba Helmet. This jazzed-up diving headgear will allow a Scampihorse to disappear down into the deepest, darkest depths of Sufokia for days on end for a little "alone time". As for you, you can use it as a scuba-diving mask, but please try to stay afloat. We wouldn't want to have to call the rescue team out again.

items.name: Thousand Shield
items.description: Once upon a time, all the kingdoms and dukedoms were fighting for independence... People of the same lands battled against one another, fighting to the death. Chaos reigned. Then, one day, a general assembled a troop of elite soldiers: 1,000 men, ready for anything. These heroes strove to eliminate the fear in the World. With his army, the general succeeded in putting an end to the war. This shield, a symbol of true bravery and a reminder of those difficult times, is now awarded to the land's most courageous, gallant soldiers.

items.name: Stobbs Mask
items.description: An elegant copper mask that will allow you to not only solder away to your heart's content, but also impress your friends with your metallic voice and blood-shot eyes. Try not to fall head over heels, you might just get a shock.

items.name: Alyverol Boots
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate boots.

items.name: Alyverol Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Alyverol Belt
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate belts.

items.name: Alyverol Hat
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.

items.name: Guild Shield
items.description: This magical shield reflects the soul of your guild.

items.name: Ringomontade
items.description: The beloved tradition of swapping tales of bravery and danger over endless rounds of beer has led to more than one tragic death from alcohol abuse. The bearer of this ring can boast that they survived their harrowing adventures in every tavern in Amakna as long as their liver holds out.

items.name: Mini-Miss Amakna Amulet
items.description: So... You've been on the receiving end of the bitterness and insecurity left over from your mother's own adolescence; and you've spent your childhood believing that the only ambition worth following was to win a beauty contest. Now that you've braved thousands of makeup sessions, heinous costumes and camera flashes... and been voted one of the beauties of your generation... Was it worth it?

items.name: Mini-Mr. Amakna Amulet
items.description: So... You've faced hundreds of hours of tortuous gym workouts. You've weight trained and fake tanned like your life depended on it. You've downed a raw egg milkshake every day, even on Kwismas... and you've been voted one of the hunks of your generation. Let's hope it was worth it!

items.name: Hot Staff
items.description: This Hot Staff, often used as a dumbbell by the show-offy warriors of the World, is sought high and low on Pandala. It's fairly rare to come by so you'll want to hold on to this one - the carvers have a shortage of the raw materials needed to make it and consequently the ecosystem is gravely suffering.

items.name: O'Basan Spade
items.description: O'Basan was an Enutrof who was convinced that her magic spade made her shrink at unexpected moments, allowing her to understand animals. Unfortunately, she couldn't think of any "magical" excuses for her crumbling bones, severe deafness and deteriorating sight that stopped her from recognising her friends and family.

items.name: Neon Cloak
items.description: This cloak is the ideal garment for a late night. It'll keep you buzzing into the early hours and will probably send your enemies raving mad.

items.name: Sirloin Cloak
items.description: Wearing this cloak is the best thing to get your enemies drooling with envy.

items.name: Wee Willie Wincap
items.description: This hat will make you want to run through the town in your nightwear. For the crazy, lazy fool that you are, that doesn't change much, so why not try putting it on your head when facing adversaries?

items.name: Bussinpoots Hat
items.description: Nobody's figured out why, but when small, ginger, chubby, whiskered, very hairy adventurers with abnormally large pupils and funny accents put on this hat, they suddenly change in the eyes of women from the "definitely do not approach under any circumstances" type to the "aww can I stroke it?" type. Wonders never cease!

items.name: Imakohat
items.description: With this snug hat on your head, you feel as airy-fairy as a goddess of light. Of course, to everyone else, you look like a Boowolf cub.

items.name: Imakape
items.description: It's said that the hem of this cape makes flowers bloom wherever it skims along the ground, even in the most desolate landscapes. Oddly enough, when you're the one wearing it, these flowers wilt immediately. Must be something to do with your armpit hygiene.

items.name: Wosungwee Shield
items.description: Some Wabbits say that the Wa starved his subjects, going so far as to pull cawwots right from the mouths of hungry Tiwabbits. One day, the unhappy citizens rebelled and took up arms. This shield now symbolises their revolution. Of course, they hadn't realised just how cruel His Majesty Barf I could be, and the rebellious rodents all ended up in a stew.

items.name: Diplocape
items.description: With this cape on your back, you'll feel ready to defend your planet like a hero.

items.name: Diplohelmet
items.description: Your enemies will find you adorable; you remind them of childhood memories. But rest assured, they'll kill you all the same.

items.name: 642 Champion Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: Golden Hispañic Shield
items.description: The legendary Dal-Uk-Wet, who unified the Kingdom of Hispañia, had a magic shield. Sir-Dal, his great-grandson, had a few copies forged to reward his best warriors. This shield is one of these rare copies.

items.name: Krosmahat
items.description: This hat will allow you to hide your biggest secret – you too have a "super-deformed" head.

items.name: Krosmacloak
items.description: This cape was specially designed to hide the flabby builder's bum that peeps out of your trousers when you bend over to pick stray kamas off the ground.

items.name: Kwismas Treetop
items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.

items.name: Sewears
items.description: It has to be said, you do have certain similarities with a rat. You are extremely hairy, long in the tooth, have a rather pointy snout, and a tendency to repel the opposite sex. All you're missing is the long tail.

items.name: Tailblazer Sword
items.description: When this sword was forged, its blade was quenched in mimilk more than a hundred times, which is why it shines so brightly.

items.name: Tailblazer Hat
items.description: This jaunty hat has an adjustable strap that pretty much guarantees you won't lose it on your adventures, even if you take a nasty tumble. Not only will you land on your feet, but your pride and dignity will remain happily intact.

items.name: Tailblazer Shield
items.description: This elegant shield will protect you from low blows, cutting remarks and rotten tomatoes. You can even use it as a scratching post!

items.name: Boss Saw
items.description: This buzz saw is the most important piece of a bloodthirsty killing machine from another time. Unfortunately, you're missing all the other pieces. This bit will do as a shield for the moment – just make sure you don't lose a hand to it.

items.name: Brrrito Shield
items.description: This giant snout may not increase your sense of smell, but its tusks will help you ward off approaching danger.

items.name: Brrrito Cloak
items.description: Ah! What better cloak than one made of leather from an antediluvian Woolly Piggoth to protect you from the icy winds of Frigost? It didn't do that good a job taking care of its original owner, of course, but beggars can't be choosers.

items.name: Koolich Aid
items.description: Koolich Aid is a symbol for those who rebel against parental authority, homework, tidying their bedrooms, being grounded, and for some young adventurers on a quest of self discovery, even the law. Yet if you ask them directly why they carry it, they'll tell you it's only for emotional support purposes. Guess you'll just have to try it for yourself.

items.name: Oafblocke Shield
items.description: With this shield, you can share your point of view without saying a word. It's brandished by everyone who's anyone during public debates, and the most energy-efficient adventurers equip a Pluswan ring at the same time to show their support with minimum effort. Use with care, lest it take control of your life.

items.name: Witter Beanie
items.description: This thing can talk... And talk... And talk... And talk! It picks up phrases it likes and repeats them to Witter Beanies in the area. At first, these hats were quite a good alternative to carrier pigeons, until they became so commonly used that the same messages started going round and round in circles, resulting in a permanent hubbub. These days they're also used for a parlour game called Rage K-Witter in which each participant dons a Witter Beanie and the one who can stand the noise the longest is pronounced the winner.

items.name: Chromulet
items.description: This amulet will give you the answer to the ultimate question of life, the Krosmoz and everything. But you'll need to know how to ask it. Did you mean the cosmos?

items.name: T'Youb
items.description: This cloak is very special indeed. It allows its wearer to display anything at all on their back. Most dumb adventurers just use it to show off hunting trophies and count how many people are taking an interest in them. A few canny wearers have, however, managed to generate a real following on T'Youb with their original ideas.

items.name: Oddrick Cloak
items.description: This cloak used to belong to a fellow named Oddrick, one of those scholars who often crossed the fine line between genius and folly. One time, he managed to inadvertently create a species of motorised plants armed with buzz saws! Time has forgotten what became of Oddrick, but with traces such as this one reminding of us his legacy, there will always be people intent on finding him.

items.name: Darkshield
items.description: If it's dark enough, this shield will hide you from view. Of course, your position will be given away immediately by the whimpers of fear you can't help but emit when you don't have your night light.

items.name: Rat Shield
items.description: With its strong smell of black pudding pizza, this shield is your VIP pass to skulking around Sphincter Cell's lair without drawing attention to yourself. Sometimes, smelling a rat is a very good thing indeed.

items.name: Amakna Mask
items.description: This mask is a wooden replica of Captain Amakna's, designed for children. But that doesn't give you the right to use it on them.

items.name: Just Shield
items.description: From far away, this shield looks like a giant kama coin. Don't be surprised if you amass a gaggle of whispering Enutrofs over the next day or two. Or if Ecaflips start flipping you in the air to make decisions. Or if Srams start dropping from covert hiding places in the eaves of houses to assault you. This shield might just be more hassle than it's worth.

items.name: Just Cloak
items.description: Carried on the wings of justice, you're convinced that all you do is just and good. Don't wear this cloak when you're fighting with Srams or Rogues (even if they're on your team), or you might find yourself stripped of your wings, your sense of righteousness and your dignity.

items.name: Alliance Shield
items.description: This enchanted shield is imbued with the inimitable essence of your alliance.

items.name: Shadow Helmet
items.description: If you suddenly get the impression that there's someone following you around, then you've probably fallen prey to this helmet's power to make its wearer think that shadows are alive. Hey, a shock to the system might finally cure your sciaphobia!

items.name: Okapicap
items.description: The famous explorer Hariston Jaune wore a hat similar to this one. According to the legend, the Okapicap is magic: it whips up your curiosity while sharpening the mind. How excellent it would be if we placed this on the heads of dunces rather than a simple cone!

items.name: Dragokart Cup
items.description: This shield is a replica of the trophy awarded to the winners of the famous Dragoturkey race. It's not as prestigious as the original, of course, but if it stops you from getting sliced in two by an anonymous madman, who are you to complain?

items.name: Miss Triste Mask
items.description: This mask may get you into the prestigious Miss Ugly contest, but you'll need something really special to win it! Most people just use theirs to hide their faces at parties they'd really rather not be at.

items.name: Miss Triste Cloak
items.description: This cloak was designed to help Miss Triste win the Miss Amakna contest. You can probably guess how that one finished.

items.name: Cheekap
items.description: This hat was invented by an anonymous tailor ahead of his time. Indeed, his market research revealed an upsurge in the number of poopy heads and fartfaces. He therefore decided to make a hat that would flatter them, and made a fortune in no time at all.

items.name: Cheekloak
items.description: Trool underwear is much too big to be used thusly, even by you. But, since nothing can stop you once you get an idea in your head, you decided to wear them anyway by strapping them onto your back until your posterior was big enough.

items.name: Cheekrescent
items.description: Now here's a weapon that left Cra herself scratching her head. She turned it this way and that, examined all the seams, and she still couldn't understand why it was so popular with her disciples. Sure, it's got a light draw and it's machine-washable, but its combat-worthiness remains to be seen.

items.name: Maskomen Tengu
items.description: This mask not only makes you seem more fierce than you actually are, but it also hides your terrifying face. Two advantages for the price of one!

items.name: Capnomen Tengu
items.description: This ample cape will hide all your cheap gear, and if you stay perfectly still, you could even pass for a talented actor.

items.name: Staffomen Tengu
items.description: This staff is useful for knocking hecklers around during a performance. It's also quite good for squishing the Arachnees and Moskitos who always come, uninvited, to gate-crash your performances.

items.name: Hattee
items.description: Pro-tip: if you wear this hat as protection during a storm, wring it out later and you've got cheap tea.

items.name: Sekyoo Ratee
items.description: Unlike Enutrofs, your feet, and your mother's cooking, this shield is fresh and smells great!

items.name: Hachetee
items.description: This axe is a great way to ensure that tourists participate in a tea ceremony conforming to established norms. Hard to say how effective it is, though – the tourists can't ever be reached for comments afterwards.

items.name: Adora Bicorn
items.description: Wearing this hat on its own will make you look silly. However, worn with the rest of the set, its generous curves will make you Astrub's heart-throb.

items.name: Adora Blazer
items.description: This cape is carefully crafted to make hideous things look cute - for example, your ample rear end.

items.name: Adora Blades
items.description: You won't think these daggers are quite as cute when they rip slowly through your flesh all the way down to the bone.

items.name: Geishead
items.description: This wig is extremely popular with young Enutrofs, who use it to hide their characteristic baldness, which is itself caused by their hair constantly being yanked into a bun.

items.name: Geishawl
items.description: This cape is mostly worn as a sign of affluence by artists and upper-class women. So it has nothing at all to do with those garish capes worn by the courtesans at Allister's Castle, understand?

items.name: Geishax
items.description: The lightness of this axe makes it pretty easy to use, even for frail women and geriatrics. But don't underestimate its razor-sharpness – more than a few overly-daring men have found their flames of passion permanently put out by it.

items.name: Black Quakask
items.description: Thanks to this helmet, your fantasies of being treated like a bad little ducky can become reality!

items.name: Black Quakape
items.description: To collect the feathers required to make this cape, you'll need around a hundred Black Quaquacks and a cheese grater.

items.name: Black Quakane
items.description: Originally, this staff was immaculate; it picked up its permanent black tint by being repeatedly thrust into the nooks and crannies of Bwork dungeons... and of the Bworks themselves...

items.name: Yellow Quakask
items.description: After playing the fool so often, you finally managed to become one for real. To reward you and to show their pride, your parents gave you this helmet.

items.name: Yellow Quakape
items.description: Because blood would stain yellow feathers, Yellow Quakapes can't be manufactured the same way as Black Quakapes. For that reason, they take a lot longer to make.

items.name: Yellow Quakstik
items.description: Pandawushu masters are able to catch a Moskito mid-flight with two of these wands in the same hand. Not surprising really, when you consider the viscous slime they're usually covered in after being used to dig for nostril treasure.

items.name: White Nincap
items.description: Despite his benevolent nature, or maybe because of it, the White Ninja has completely disappeared from public awareness. So he fashioned this hat after that of his eternal rival: the Black Ninja.

items.name: White Nincloak
items.description: The White Ninja is a stickler for appearances, which is why he always wears this magnificent white cape and takes great pains to keep it clean. It's also why the Black Ninja never misses an opportunity to stain it.

items.name: Ninjammer
items.description: Using a bladed weapon would mean running the risk of staining his clothes with your blood. Consequently, the White Ninja prefers blunt instruments, like this hammer. He may not like messes, but when he reaches for it, you're in for a world of hurt.

items.name: Black Nincap
items.description: Extremely evil and more than a little cowardly, the Black Ninja wears this cap to hide his identity. Like many adventurers, he can't take responsibility for his actions.

items.name: Black Nincloak
items.description: Black and White Ninjas have several things in common, one of them being this impressive garment. But as all experienced fighters will tell you: when you have to fight for your life, throw the cape away. How many adventurers have been killed in battle because they got their arms and legs trapped in their capes at a critical moment?

items.name: Ninjaxe
items.description: Flat broke, the Black Ninja had to trade away his sharp blades for some food and a hatchet sharp enough to cut to the quick. All he has to do is aim for his target's neck.

items.name: Dominairmees
items.description: This cape: it gives you wings.

items.name: Airmarmour
items.description: Arthur Dint, illustrious voyager, used this shield at times as a fruit basket, and at other times as an umbrella. But with your knack for getting into trouble, you'll probably only have time to use it as a shield.

items.name: Airmees Shovel
items.description: You wanted a bow capable of shooting arrows of pure light across the Krosmoz. Unfortunately, you spoke to the wrong artisan and ended up with this shovel instead.

items.name: Makizushield
items.description: Pandikazes use this shield not only to protect themselves but also to stave off starvation during long periods of isolation.

items.name: Maski
items.description: For the first time ever, your face will make the people of Amakna drool with desire. A great way to be desired without having to call on the neighbourhood surgeon/butcher.

items.name: Makatana
items.description: We're not quite sure what the blacksmith was trying to do when he made this sword. The only thing that we know for sure is that he was hungry.

items.name: Pink Dragoomask
items.description: They had to find a use for the Pink Dragoone's head once its dismembered corpse was turned into a cape. So for those who have wished they could show off their pet while riding a mount, your wish has been granted.

items.name: Pink Dragoocape
items.description: The wise men, who are paid to do nothing in particular, have oft wondered what happened to the skins of the animals the butcher killed. Now they know.

items.name: Pink Dragoodirks
items.description: A typical example of the type of equipment that is all the rage not for its utility or (non-existent) efficiency, but for the fact that it could never go out of fashion according to the standards of prepubescent Eniripsas.

items.name: 643 Champion Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: Domesticloak
items.description: Wearing this cape feeds so many fantasies that some eccentric enchanters are trying to make a food out of it. They claim that if they succeed, they'll be able to satisfy all the Word of Twelve for at least ten generations.

items.name: Domesticap
items.description: This diadem is to this set as a cherry is to a cake: useless, but indispensable.

items.name: Domestick
items.description: Before becoming a weapon, the Domestick was a tool used for all sorts of housework. It could be used to dust the shelves, clean the oven, and even to administer a well-deserved spanking for the lady or the man of the house.

items.name: Samurai Helmet
items.description: Besides hiding your natural baldness, this helmet will make you look like a fearsome warrior. But keep in mind, if you feel like fighting, that your martial arts skills are still non-existent.

items.name: Samurai Cape
items.description: A cape in the Samurai Set?! This is the work of some unscrupulous tailor who cares more about selling to his uninformed customers than he does about accuracy. It's his fault this set is not as effective as it could have been if there weren't a cape to hinder your movements in combat.

items.name: Samurai Sword
items.description: This sword, with a blade as sharp as an Ecaflip's senses, excels both at cutting off limbs and cutting up sushi. For seppuku however, you might prefer this sword's little brother.

items.name: Noh Mask
items.description: Wearing this mask brings a horrible curse, causing the wearer to take on a new personality as long as the mask is upon his face. Counterfeits were used at times by Astrubians looking to justify their infantile behaviour, but their massive use near the Frigost Zaap alerted the authorities, who have put a definitive end to the fraud.

items.name: Noh Cape
items.description: The Noh Cape is, first and foremost, designed to go nicely with the Noh Mask. Since it doesn't have its own curse, it simply amplifies the mask's.

items.name: Noh Saber
items.description: Since Astrubian tourists didn't understand when Pandawan women told them "No" in answer to their advances, the women looked for something more forceful. The result: this sword, which was then promptly assimilated into Astrubian culture.

items.name: Coronita
items.description: This headband is worn low in the front, in order to cover the ears. This makes it look a little less unfashionable, and more importantly, helps to keep your ears warm when the cold winds blow.

items.name: Capita
items.description: This cape allows you to blend in with the crowd in urban areas without drawing the authorities' attention. What's more, it's big enough to hide all sorts of things, like lollipops, dolls, and even a small shepherd's crook.

items.name: Hammarita
items.description: When she was just a young apprentice, Dolores Kimo used this hammer to help her commit sabotage. After everything froze over though, she traded it for a sword. Not as good for breaking machinery, but much better for intimidating tourists.

items.name: Blimbonnet
