items.description: This hat may give your friends an irrepressible urge to rip your ears off. Luckily for you, your real ears will be well hidden under this hat.

items.name: Karnaval Headdress
items.description: Although there's no law forbidding you from wearing the Karnaval Headdress all year round, you ought to know that donning it when it's not Too-Faux Karnaval weekend is seen as a sure-fire fashion faux-pas.

items.name: Karnaval Cape
items.description: Just like the matching headdress, it is suggested that you save this cape for special occasions. As much as you'd like to parade around a wedding reception with it on, you must admit that it's kind of rude to steal the bride's limelight so flagrantly.

items.name: Kanuckler
items.description: This shield is said to allow you to charm snakes without a single note on the flute. Some specialists doubt its effectiveness, arguing that such a feat is impossible due to the shield's lack of hair. Guess you'll just have to try it for yourself.

items.name: Bworkler
items.description: The tusks attached to this shield are unstable and can't be used offensively. At the very least, we can say they're a (slight) deterrent.

items.name: Sweetheart Crown
items.description: With this crown on your head, you'll be King Casanova! Even the Gobballs will be falling at your feet!

items.name: Sweetheart Wings
items.description: Love gives you wings, but singletons can always pretend with a pair of these strapped on.

items.name: Sweetheart Shield
items.description: The most important part of any lover's set. If wearing your heart on your sleeve backfires, you'll have a great big red shield to protect yourself from rejection!

items.name: Sweetheart Hammer
items.description: A hammer that makes you feel like a small, pink, cute, fluffy woodland creature... and yet incredibly tough at the same time!

items.name: Dorsal Cap
items.description: Now that you've got the hat for it, you can't wait to start hanging out in the shallow water near the beach to frighten the tourists. You just hope none of them will take it as a challenge and try to attack you.

items.name: Cake Topper
items.description: Wherever you lay your hat, that's your cake.

items.name: Kamakap
items.description: Strapped on tightly, the Kamakap is completely stable and won't drop any kamas. You should still only wear it if you're a good head taller than the average Enutrof, or else you'll have been robbed before you can say "easy money".

items.name: Kamabag
items.description: One kama can hide another. If a bandit tries to grab the fake kama sticking out of the top of this bag, he'll be disappointed... The perfect chance to catch him before he steals all your real treasures!

items.name: Skullcrasher
items.description: After outwitting Gein's double, sidestepping his traps and foiling his invisibility gimmick, you really deserve this skull as a symbol of your clear-headedness. You should probably hide it if you ever come across the real Gein, of course, as it'd be a shame to be stripped of your title so soon.

items.name: Greenengol Helmet
items.description: Proudly show your belief in the Greenengol by wearing this helmet. Or you could grab some pompoms and start screaming the name of your team, but that might be embarrassing.

items.name: Greenengol Shield
items.description: An essential part of a Gobbowler's gear, the shield should be solid and block every blow. This one is just really pretty – it won't block anything, not even your adversaries' insults.

items.name: Draconic Helmet
items.description: Embellished with this horn, you won't need to worry before charging into battle with your head down. Quite the contrary – now you have a reason to do just that.

items.name: Champion 644 Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: Shusack
items.description: This bag has a pretty good storage capacity, but it'd be best not to upset it if you wish to avoid disaster. It's not unheard of to have certain items fall out the bottom of the Shusack, even if there's no hole anywhere in it. Oh, the joys of living with Shushus!

items.name: Meow Daggers
items.description:
Kill with your claws... or stroke with your footpads.
(Change the appearance of the daggers you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto them.)

items.name: Meow Cloak
items.description:
Fur, fur, fur and more fur. Fur everywhere!
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Meow Shield
items.description:
With this shield, you can run riot on walls that have just been painted. Knock yourself out!
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Meow Hat
items.description: Now with free fleas.

items.name: Mosk
items.description: Bzzzzzz. Bzzzzzzz. Bzz Bzz. Bzzz? Bzzz!

items.name: Flashy Sword
items.description:
Even if your next sword flail totally misses your enemy, at least you'll look electro-cute. Teehee!
(Change the appearance of the sword you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Flashy Cloak
items.description:
Not only do you always feel under the weather when wearing this cloak, it doesn't even give you the flashes of inspiration you were hoping for.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Flashy Shield
items.description:
Lightning usually only strikes once, but it's strangely attracted to this shield.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Flashy Headgear
items.description: The ears on this headgear act like two lightning rods. Finally, you've fulfilled your dream and become a conductor!

items.name: Black Madreggon
items.description:
You saw a red Madreggon, and you had it painted black. Black as night! Black as coal!
(Change the appearance of the petsmount you have equipped by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Traffic Blammer
items.description: Just right for smashing up all the hard work your co-workers did yesterday.

items.name: Traffic Cloak
items.description:
With this cloak on your back, the militia will finally stop hounding you for stealing bits and pieces of Astrub for your private fortress.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Traffic Shield
items.description:
With this shield, you can create traffic jams and send all the Dragoturkeys in the land on lengthy detours. Go on, you know you want to!
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Traffic Cone
items.description: With this cone on your head, people will do all they can not to bump into you, turning early to give you a wide berth. Just like they do already, actually.

items.name: Radiant Cloak
items.description:
This cloak will adopt its wearer's colours, except when its wearer goes green with envy.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Groom Daggers
items.description:
"Greet your guests courteously, then stab them in the back when they turn away." That's your philosophy. Un-lackey for some!
(Change the appearance of the daggers you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto them.)

items.name: Groom Cloak
items.description:
This cloak has been enhanced by the addition of a dustpan and brush extension. Now you can keep on opening doors and carrying your masters' bags without needing to interrupt those all-important cleaning sessions.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Groom Shield
items.description:
This shield will provide effective protection from swipes and blows from certain masters. It can also be flipped and used as a platter to serve them.
(Change the appearance of the shield your are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Groom Hat
items.description: Now that you have this hat, your masters will be able to keep you in their sights at all times and constantly call upon your services.

items.name: Boney-O Staff
items.description:
You can throw this staff, fetch it and run around with it in your mouth until you're utterly lost.
(Change the appearance of the staff you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Boney-O Cloak
items.description:
Here today, gone to marrow!
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Boney-O Shield
items.description:
This shield might save your life if you ever find yourself up against carnivorous enemies. Chuck it into the fray and run for your life!
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Boney-O Headgear
items.description: With this headgear gracing your lovely crown, the Moowolf will think you look good enough to eat.

items.name: Mandrog
items.description: Its little tadpole face reminds you of someone... But who?

items.name: Emperor Sword
items.description:
Granted, it's not very sharp, but you're the Emperor, your footmen will do the cutting for you!
(Change the appearance of the sword you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Emperor Cape
items.description:
This cape's little epaulettes will remind all the snotty toerags to call you "Boss".
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Emperor Shield
items.description:
If only you were a little stronger and cooler, you could have used this shield as a shuriken.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Emperor Headgear
items.description: Wearing this hat grants you the right to give the orders when you and your teammates are having fights... Snowball fights, that is!

items.name: Goba Vett
items.description: On steep slopes, you'll want to hold on tight to its horns so you don't fall off.

items.name: Droid Bow
items.description:
This is not the bow you're looking for.
(Change the appearance of the bow you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Droid Cloak
items.description:
The cloak of choice for all those adventurers who are stubborn, cheeky, and effortlessly adorable.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Droid Shield
items.description:
Careful! Flaunting this shield is considered an open act of rebellion.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Droid Headgear
items.description: If you rub this helmet up the right way, it might just show you the hologram it's storing.

items.name: Radiant Shield
items.description:
This shield will adopt its wearer's colours, except when its wearer goes green at the gills.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Raja Wand
items.description: With this wand, you can show your guests the door when they prove themselves to be wittier than you at your dinner parties.

items.name: Raja Cloak
items.description:
This cloak is lined with a layer of polystyrene composite, to protect your botty from smacks.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Raja Shield
items.description:
This shield looks like a target and will attract arrows from archers high and low. Give it to your worst enemy as a present.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Raja Headgear
items.description: This headgear is just what you needed to hide your big head.

items.name: Radiant Dora
items.description: This hat will adopt its wearer's colours, except when its wearer is beaten black and blue.

items.name: Crossbone Shovel
items.description:
This shovel is the ideal Kwismas present for gravediggers, gardeners, and diggers of gardeners' graves.
(Change the appearance of the shovel you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Crossbone Cloak
items.description:
The crossbones signify that this cloak once belonged to a pirate or a Chafer who was an excellent arm wrestler.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Atanip Wand
items.description:
People say that whacking your enemies' heads with this wand will make toys and sweets appear. Finally a little innocent fun in this violent world!
(Change the appearance of the wand you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Atanip Cloak
items.description:
If you manage to roll yourself up in this cloak, someone might think you're a nice surprise.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Atanip Shield
items.description:
Once this shield is destroyed, the chomping, sucking, chewing maws of doom will reach you. At the very least, try and give them some cavities.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Atanip Helmet
items.description: With this helmet on your head, your enemies might finally believe you've got something in there.

items.name: Crossbone Shield
items.description:
This shield is supposed to protect your bones from bad cracks, but it's not much good against crones with bad backs.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Crossbone Headgear
items.description: You could use this thing as a shield, if only it wasn't fitted with hair gel dispensers all over.

items.name: Suri-Me
items.description: This pet walks sideways so as to always have its back to you. Either it hates you, or it trusts you implicitly.

items.name: Featheraxe
items.description: The two feathers attached to this axe help it fly further when you throw it at an adversary.

items.name: Featherback
items.description:
The feathers on this cloak will slow down your fall when you slip out of bed in the night.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Featherguard
items.description: The three feathers on this shield let you use it as a boomerang that never comes back.

items.name: Featherhead
items.description: With all these feathers on your head, only piwis will look up to you.

items.name: Sourachnee
items.description: It's almost always in a bad mood, but then again, so are you.

items.name: Mechanaxe
items.description:
The gear doesn't do anything, but it looks awesome. This axe really makes you think of someone for some reason.
(Change the appearance of the axe you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Mechanacloak
items.description:
This cloak contains enough cogs and gears to run an entire old-school merry-go-round.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Mechanashield
items.description: With this shield in your grubby hands, you can finally go backwards as well as forwards.

items.name: Mechanahat
items.description: This hat makes you think of the time when celebrity tailor Kog Wan tried, in vain, to make you look good naked.

items.name: XIV Staff
items.description:
This staff makes you feel positively regal. Maybe you'll start wearing a huge, extravagant wig and paint large suns on all the buildings in town. Heck, you can even leave the table whenever you want now!
(Change the appearance of the staff you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: XIV Cloak
items.description:
This cloak is excellent at hiding your lack of charisma, but it isn't quite long enough to hide your enormous posterior.
(Change the appearance of the cloak you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: XIV Shield
items.description:
This wax shield is just what you've always wanted for making moulds of your enemies' faces.
(Change the appearance of the shield you are carrying by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: XIV Headgear
items.description: This is the undisputed palace of lice, fleas and ticks. Probably because it's so comfortable and smells like testosterone.

items.name: Decoded Corset
items.description: This belt has traversed past, present and future to bring a message to the World of Twelve. Take good care of it, as you'll probably need it later.

items.name: Al Howin's Helmet
items.description: It's a fine line between fear and disgust, and you're unlikely to forget it with this helmet.

items.name: Al Howin's Cape
items.description: This cape will either terrify people, or make them laugh. It all depends on the person wearing it.

items.name: Al Howin's Shield
items.description: This deformed eye blocks hits as well as any Iop skull.

items.name: Al Howin's Sword
items.description: This sword is more often used to scare people than to actually harm them, since the materials it is made from are largely harmless.

items.name: Gingerbread Hat
items.description: The delectable smell and savoury look of this hat are two reasons to wear it during the holiday season. Put it on, and all eyes will be on you. Just make sure people don't mistake you for dessert!

items.name: Gingerbread Cloak
items.description: This gingerbread cloak will entice every eager foodie. Enjoy! A real Kwismas wouldn't be complete without an upset stomach, after all.

items.name: Gingerbread Shield
items.description: This shield made of particularly soft gingerbread is very absorbent and can withstand most attacks. Its wonderful smell will remind you of the holidays and make combat so much more enjoyable. Mind you don't get carried away and eat it up, though. That tends to happen faster than you'd think...

items.name: Gingerbread Staff
items.description: The wonderful spicy odour of this gingerbread-shaped staff will rub off onto every monster that you hit with it. You'll feel like you're in the middle of a Kwismas market! So hit them, and hit them again!

items.name: Kwismas Sack
items.description: When Father Kwismas climbs down the chimneys in Amakna, he usually leaves a lot of gifts for young adventurers with big dreams. This time, he left you his sack – maybe so you can bring some Kwismas magic of your own to the World of Twelve...

items.name: Ridit Shield
items.description: If you like to read what others are doing over and over again, make acerbic and worthless remarks on nothing very important, or simply have the right to downvote in Amakna, this shield is for you.

items.name: Twit Shield
items.description: When wearing this shield, you will be visible from afar. This allows anyone to keep tabs on your exhilarating adventures and know where you are at all times, including any stops you make at Astrub Inn.

items.name: Insta Cape
items.description: Kevin was a painter who produced as many works in a year as Wa Wabbit had offspring. With success under his belt and wanting less stressful days, he contacted a sorcerer who knew how to put his talent up for auction. An old and unscrupulous book-face collector who was on the decline eventually bought it in exchange for this mass-produced cape.

items.name: Tumble Hat
items.description: When the Divine Dimensions were opened up to the people of the World of Twelve, everyone had a dream of creating their own dimension. When you wear this hat, you only need to close your eyes to be transported to your own personal dimension. You can then customise it to your liking and revel in the delight of all those who visit. Unfortunately, this paradise completely vanishes when you open your eyes.

items.name: Two-horned Hat
items.description: Frustrated by constantly hearing her husband say he had the right horn but didn't know what to do with it, the baker's wife gave this hat to her husband so he'd have somewhere to put both his right and left horn.

items.name: Battler Shield
items.description: Carrying this shield will ensure no one wants to pick a fight with you.

items.name: Springy Hat
items.description: This hat offers protection against bad weather. It should therefore be worn if you are in a stormy relationship and you keep getting the cold shoulder from your significant other.

items.name: Springy Cape
items.description: Do not deflower this cape, or anything else, without consent.

items.name: Piggy Shield
items.description: When wet, this shield tends to become a little salami and you may find that carrying it makes you rather ham-fisted.

items.name: Enutroid
items.description: Who said that the Enutrofs were feeble old relics from a forgotten time? This hat is proof that they can be formidable opponents and ahead of their time. Nothing to do with haemorrhoids, mind.

items.name: Joris's Hood
items.description: This hood might not make you as clever as Joris, but it will protect your head if the blows start raining down on you, no matter how stormy it gets.

items.name: 645 Champion Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: Gerbean
items.description: Do you take comfort in the idea that one can still be too cute with abundant hair, small size, foul breath, and wabbit teeth? It might be true for Gerbeans, but just wait until you meet a Stubbyob.

items.name: Gunsen Shield
items.description: More than just protection, this shield has a simple and refined aesthetic which allows you to cool yourself off on very hot days.

items.name: Demonic Shield
items.description: Loaded with demonic power, this shield will protect you from any attacks from other dimensions.

items.name: Kokokohat
items.description: There's nothing better than a kokoko-strengthened helmet to protect your pretty little head against your enemies' kokolossal blows.

items.name: Cloakscreen
items.description: Ideal for slipping through the jungle unseen, this cloak will help you conceal your little mischiefs, like weeing on your neighbour's letter box.

items.name: 1001 Claws Tail
items.description: Some say you need a tail to wear this piece of armour, while others say it's only ceremonial. Anyone who's seen Kerub use it can tell you it's possible to be both extremely classy and extremely deadly at the same time.

items.name: 1001 Claws Helmet
items.description: Many proud warriors have tried to wear this helmet in pursuit of its power, but in vain as it only confers its power on someone whose head can fill it completely. So far only Kerub has succeeded, which has made him the legend we all know today. Will you manage to take his place?

items.name: Tactile Helmet
items.description: No one will recognise you under this colourful helmet! Now you're a formidable but irresistibly cute soldier, to the point that everyone will want to poke you.

items.name: Exotic Shield
items.description: With this shield on your arm, everyone will think you're returning from a long holiday in the islands. Too bad you didn't get the tan to prove it!

items.name: Charlie's Agents Hat
items.description: Is there anything more disagreeable than getting a sunburn on holiday? Well, worry no more! This parasol-shaped hat will protect you from sun-related unpleasantness. As an added bonus, it will also make everyone else on the beach jealous of your undeniable cleverness.

items.name: Charlie's Agents Cloak
items.description: This multi-purpose cloak will protect your behind from grains of sand when you arrive at Moon Beach. Now there's nothing to stop you from getting the best tan on the island!

items.name: Charlie's Agents Shield
items.description:
"She sells shell shields by the seashore, she sells shell shields by the seashore, shesellsshellshieldsbytheseashore..." 
If you listen closely, you can hear a strange chant repeating faster and faster, coming from inside this shell-shaped shield.

items.name: Charlie's Agents Shovel
items.description: This shovel is an essential weapon for defeating any tourists who try to make a sandcastle that's bigger and better than yours.

items.name: Bigoks Shield
items.description: An ideal protection from any projectiles that may be thrown during the match, this shield will be your most valuable ally in getting out of the stadium in one piece.

items.name: Redroz Shield
items.description: If you're defeated, you'll no longer have to hide behind unlikely excuses. Now you can hide your shame behind this shield all day long.

items.name: Pamus Shield
items.description: This blue and white-striped shield is the symbol of the Pamus. Wave it proudly so everyone will know which team you support!

items.name: Zalblaks Shield
items.description: It's traditional for Zalblaks to brandish the twisted face painted on their equipment while shouting unintelligible lyrics in order to scare their enemies and lead them to victory.

items.name: Bigoks Helmet
items.description: This helmet in your favourite team's colours will make you the ultimate fan! Now all you have to do is yell "Go Bigoks!" in the Gobbowl stadium on a game night and hope your team doesn't lose miserably.

items.name: Redroz Helmet
items.description: The spike on the top of this helmet makes it perfect for charging anyone who thinks their team is better than yours.

items.name: Pamus Helmet
items.description: Pamus supporters who wear this accessory aren't afraid of showing their colours. And if you ask them why, they'll tell you, "Because the Pamus are gonna give you a red card! Or else we'd be happy to paint you black and blue!"

items.name: Zalblaks Helmet
items.description: The expression "to be pig-headed" makes so much more sense when you're wearing this helmet along with all the other Zalblaks supporters.

items.name: Rando Geta
items.description: In mastering the ancestral art of Roshambo, you have finally come to understand the profound meaning of the expression "a rolling rock crushes no paper".

items.name: Pynal Cape
items.description: Both warm and prickly at the same time, this cape lets you collect loads of Kwismas gifts that aren't intended for you, all the while passing you off as a Pricky.

items.name: In'Orth Hat
items.description: If you're lost in the dark, try pointing the star decorating this hat in all directions. When it shines like a thousand lights, you'll have found the North, and the right path at the same time.

items.name: Brakmarian Dragoturkey
items.description: This harness will let your Dragoturkey camouflage itself into the darkest recesses.

items.name: Bontarian Dragoturkey
items.description: This sophisticated gear will let you dress your Dragoturkey in the colours of the city of light.

items.name: Lilotte's Bell
items.description: Be careful not to get your head trapped because of this bell.

items.name: Bakara's Headband
items.description: Sensitive about those big ears of yours? Here's a good way to hide them.

items.name: Marline's Headdress
items.description: Bad hair day? Can't get your locks to behave? Don't worry: just toss on this meticulously groomed headdress on your head, and everyone will be looking at you with admiration.

items.name: Monarch Staff
items.description: This staff has the strange ability to make a trumpeting noise if you push on the end.

items.name: 1001 Claws Nunchaku
items.description: If you doubt their power, know that these Nunchaku have left scars on even the most redoubtable beings in the World of Twelve. Well, that shut you up, didn't it?

items.name: Royal Guard Sword
items.description: This sword is the weapon wielded by the Royal Guards to protect the great city of Bonta. Don't use it as a toothpick...

items.name: Bakara's Cape
items.description: In Bonta's colours, this cape gives its wearer the air of purity and candour. But, as they say, clothes don't make the mage...

items.name: Joris's Cape
items.description:
"The first step in becoming a great hero is wearing a cape!" 
That's the advice Joris got from a mysterious stranger, before leaving on his first adventures. So hurry up, put this cape on, and become a hero!

items.name: Monarch Cape
items.description: Made entirely of velour, the collar of this cape supports the Monarch's head while he sleeps during meetings with his advisers.

items.name: Julith's Cape
items.description: A dark magic inhabits this cape: it seems to be linked to another dimension, giving it the appearance of a dark sky full of stars. But none who've seen its interior are still around to talk about it...

items.name: Monarch Crown
items.description: He who wears the Monarch Crown is the one and only King of Bonta. So if you're wearing it... that must mean... that yours is a fake.

items.name: Royal Guard Helmet
items.description: This majestic Helmet is worn by the chief of Bonta's greatest soldiers: the Royal Guard. They exist to protect and serve the King of Bonta in all circumstances.

items.name: Julith's Sword
items.description: The blows delivered by this sword are so powerful that the shockwaves they generate cut through everything in their path.

items.name: 1001 Claws Shield
items.description: Those who are victorious write history. Those who flee, endure it. And those who look, look away.

items.name: Dragorace Headgear
items.description: Wearing the decapitated head of a mount that lost a race as headgear is indeed a little sadistic... but it is also very effective for motivating your mounts.

items.name: Dragorace Cape
items.description: These wings won't let you fly, but will have you looking like a winner during your next race atop a Dragoturkey.

items.name: Chocoshield
items.description: Usually given at parties, this robust shield is nothing more than a big square of chocolate. It will delight the palates of your enemies, so busy devouring it that they won't attack you.

items.name: Royal Tofu Shield
items.description: Made from a feather you plucked from a Royal Tofu, this shield is thought to be one of the most resistant in the world. As the proverb goes, "The sword is mightier than the feather..."

items.name: Skeunkield
items.description: Grand champion of Saint Ballotwine, Skeunk uses his instrument to seduce everyone who comes into his field of vision. Unfortunately for him, you didn't fall for his serenade, and you smashed him to bits. Now you're in possession of his beautiful harp – adorned with the scalp of victory – which you use as a shield.

items.name: Merkator Shield
items.description: You won't succeed in impersonating a Merkator Foggernaut just by holding this shield. But it should be enough to protect you from your enemies' attacks.

items.name: Kimbo Shield
items.description:
The following inscription can be read on the back of this shield: 
"Kimbo in summer;
The challenge for combatants,
A fearless winner."

items.name: Pilot Dragoturkey
items.description: If you're not timid, you can transform your Dragoturkey into a racing animal with this harness. Or at least make it look like one.

items.name: Treechnid Dragoturkey
items.description: If after equipping this harness, your branches remain stiff for more than four hours, please consult a doctor immediately.

items.name: Royal Dragoturkey
items.description: They say clothes don't make the man, or the Dragoturkey in this case, but wearing this harness is the least your mount must do if it wants to someday be part of the Royal Amaknian guard.

items.name: Seastaff
items.description: There's nothing better to calm young Iops' zeal than a good whack of a Seastaff.

items.name: Seaside Cape
items.description: This lovely cape is the perfect adornment for a gentle summer's night.

items.name: Flowery Summer Hat
items.description: When placed on your head, this flower – which only blooms in summer – will always point you in the sun's direction.

items.name: Dramak Shield
items.description: This shield may not give you an innate talent for acting, but it makes for a perfect defence against projectiles of all kind which your potential spectators could throw at you.

items.name: Royal Rainbow Blop Shield
items.description: In the colours of the rainbow, this shield looks more like confectionery than protective item.

items.name: Fraktal Shield
items.description: If you look at this shield close enough, you may realise that it is made up of many miniature versions of itself, which themselves are made up of miniature versions of themselves, which in turn...

items.name: Korriander Shield
items.description: Korriander leaves may not be a source of vitamin K, but the sturdiness of their structure allows them to be used to make a shield which is perfectly "kunbreakable".

items.name: 646 Champion Shield
items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.

items.name: Brakmarian Seemyool
items.description: If "vileness" is your middle name, stop hesitating! Get this harness on your Seemyool and show your devotion to the ill cause of Brakmar.

items.name: Bontarian Seemyool
items.description: Pledge your allegiance to Bonta by putting this harness on your Seemyool.

items.name: Mechancient Seemyool
items.description: Resistant armour-plating and steam propellers: this harness has all you need to put your Seemyool at the cutting edge of technology.

items.name: Sufokian Seemyool
items.description: Your Seemyool will be impressive in the colours of Sufokia.

items.name: Shell Seemyool
items.description: Thanks to this harness made from shells and coral, your Seemyool will feel like a fish in the water during your underwater outings.

items.name: Shushivin Hat
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.

items.name: Shushivin Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Barbaric Dragoturkey
items.description: Dragoturkeys already have slightly barbaric characteristics: recklessness and a certain absurdity. As for their strength, don't expect a simple harness to do anything about it.

items.name: Unikron Dragoturkey
items.description: Myth or reality? There've never been so many Unikrons reported since this harness was put into service.

items.name: Battler Helmet
items.description: This helmet commands respect, whoever's wearing it.

items.name: Shieltanuk
items.description: This shield is popular among bowlers at bowls championships. Thanks to its magical nature, it provides unparalleled protection against bad losers' inadvertent accidental throws.

items.name: Bramble Cape
items.description: Thanks to this cape, you can finally justify wearing tattered rags every day.

items.name: Crown of Brambles
items.description: With this crown on your head, Treechnids might mistake you for Chopperella. So, don't be surprised if while walking through the forest, a woodland prince suddenly puts his knobbly lips to yours.

items.name: Trool Hunter's Shield
items.description: Once recognisable from kilokametres away due to their appearance, the Trools have become experts of disguise. Posing as quite normal individuals to more easily spread chaos, there's been a marked increase in the number of them in the civilized world. In order to combat this scourge, some adventurers with sharpened senses have decided to take up arms and wear this shield as a distinguishing sign. Be careful though, because there might be some Trools who are smarter than the others hiding in their ranks.

items.name: Mechancient Dragoturkey
items.description: By putting this harness on your Dragoturkey, you'll transform it into a mechanised mode of transport – 100% environmentally-friendly and inexpensive.

items.name: Justice Shield
items.description: Just like the judges of Amakna, here you are now, capable of making everyone believe that you deliver justice.

items.name: Katar's Shield
items.description: This shield is more useful for tearing your enemies to shreds during a bloody charge than for protecting you.

items.name: Sadida King Shield
items.description: The Sadida King made this shield so he could touch wood when he found himself at a disadvantage. The fact that the Sadida King is no more today says a lot about the effectiveness of such an act.

items.name: Qilby's Shield
items.description: Originating from another time, historians don't understand how this shield came to be found in the Dofus Era.

items.name: Cube
items.description: It's hard to know if this creature is alive or whether it's an item inhabited by powerful magic. You won't get the answer by burning it.

items.name: Drhellakna
items.description: Tired of regularly getting extorted while crossing Cania, Amaknean merchants have financed the raising of hard-shelled Drhellers. For now, they are delivered as a kit with the Drheller on one side and its armour on the other, but Otomai's disciples are working to merge the two into one species.

items.name: Dhrellthat
items.description: In response to the Enutrof Kitsous hunters' Boarhog, here's the Enutrof Bwork hunters' Dhrellthat. The contest for who's got the biggest petsmount isn't over yet.

items.name: Drhellilax
items.description: Hot like fire and cruel like a nursery school teacher, the Drhellilax burns with desire to wreck everything in its path.

items.name: Mechadrhell
items.description: Rather than raising flesh-and-blood Drhellers, Foggernauts prefer to make them out of spare parts. That way, they can change their appearance at will and provide them with any improvements they deem necessary.

items.name: Kwismas Bauble
items.description: This fragile helmet is imbued with Kwismas magic. In other words, it allows you to exchange blows with comrades in an unparalleled moment of sharing. The winner is granted the right to steal the toys of their choice because, as is well known, the gifts of others are always the best.

items.name: Ice Dragoturkey
items.description: This harness is insusceptible to thawing. You can therefore continue living without worrying about the consequences of your actions on climate change.

items.name: Guild Costume
items.description: Your guild master ordered you to wear this costume decorated with a coat of arms that you didn't pick. It all reminds you of that horrible tabi woollen coat that your mother made you wear on your first day of school.

items.name: The Black Crow's Costume
items.description: You have every reason to be excited. This is neither the costume of the enigmatic Shadowy Crow, nor that of the Dark Crow. It is indeed the genuine, famous costume of the Black Crow.

items.name: Cloowk
items.description: Like your soulmate, this cape will keep you warm despite its basic appearance, and you won't be able to go out without it on your back.

items.name: Beaniwool
items.description: In the cold winter camps of Frigost, girls have only two topics of discussion: the glorious pompom of the Beaniwool, and boys.

items.name: Skeleton Dragoturkey
items.description: You've sent your Dragoturkey to the realm of the dead, so legend may come to life. Thanks to this paradox and especially this harness, your Dragoturkey never was so scary.

items.name: Ancient Ohwymi Costume
items.description: There's nothing ridiculous about dressing old-style, as this costume goes to show. As for those who would dare claim otherwise, a sceptre blow to the jaw will end their mockery.

items.name: Guild Cape
items.description: Proudly wear this cape to show everyone how committed you are to your Guild.

items.name: Guild Headgear
items.description: With this headgear, adopt your Guild's style and say no to nonconformity.

items.name: Desert Dragoturkey
items.description: This harness is specially designed to collect and recycle the Dragoturkey's bodily fluids in order to limit its dehydration in arid climates.

items.name: Giant Kralove Shield
items.description: Its tentacles can grab your opponent's weapon, or insert themselves into new orifices you've torn for your opponent.

items.name: Watchdog Headgear
items.description: Only adventurers equipped with a Watchdog Headgear are allowed to sniff those who wear a Watchdog Cape.

items.name: Watchdog Cape
items.description: This cape gives off a unique odour, allowing its wearer to be found if they get lost in the desert or on their way back from the tavern.

items.name: Ush's Shield
items.description: This shield will have your opponents seeing red right before everything goes black.

items.name: Mantiscore Shield
items.description: The Mantiscore uses a similar shield to defend itself from adventurers who are in too much of a hurry to make it rise to the bait.

items.name: Dantinea's Shield
items.description: This shield was given to Dantinea when she was just a little girl, during the Miss Abysses contest, where the other candidates mysteriously disappeared before the prize was awarded. Nobody dares to question her title today, yet everyone knows that the mermaid Arielle Little is the most beautiful creature in the ocean.

items.name: Kickroach's Shield
items.description: You may have been a dunce at school, but you're unbeatable when it comes to torturing and massacring defenceless insects. The benefits of playing truant, most likely.

items.name: Father Whupper Shield
items.description: Father Whupper smells as funky as a pair of old socks, and with this shield you'll be able to get your groove on too.

items.name: Unikron Seemyool
items.description: Myth or reality? There've never been so many Unikrons reported since this harness was put into service.

items.name: Magma Headgear
items.description: It is inadvisable to wear this headgear in summer, to avoid getting stewed alive.

items.name: Magma Cloak
items.description: Soft and always warm, this cloak is the perfect companion for soldiers when they are far from home.

items.name: Magma Shield
items.description: Forged in the heart of a volcano, this shield offers weak protection against your opponents' insults. It is, however, highly effective at making their spray of spit evaporate before it reaches you.

items.name: Magmatic Dragoturkey
items.description: This harness is perfect for protecting your Dragoturkey when it needs to cross the Sidimote Moors at full speed because you're hot to trot.

items.name: Zadioc Headgear
items.description: This headgear will make you look like a knight. You may sleep while wearing it.

items.name: Zadioc Cloak
items.description: From behind, you'll look like a knight running away.

items.name: Zadioc Shield
items.description: This shield will be the object of your opponents' desire until they realise that it didn't stop you from being ground to crumbs in your last fight.

items.name: Hornmet
items.description: Like Merlinmagus Ambrosius once said to an adventurer passing through Bonta: "Show me your wife! Then you'll know why you have horns."

items.name: Measured Tofu
items.description: As good as gold, but as stupid as a nutshell.

items.name: Paunchy Tofu
items.description: The size of its stomach is inversely proportional to that of your brain.

items.name: Jumbow Meow
items.description: This giant Bow Meow would be a very good petsmount if it didn't sleep twenty-three hours a day.

items.name: Icky Tofu
items.description: As sticky as the forehead of a Bwork who's got acne.

items.name: Charming Tofu
items.description: It's difficult to resist it when it wiggles its little behind while cooing each time you go to pet it.

items.name: Brakmarian Tofu
items.description: This particularly cheeky and undisciplined pet will give you the run-around. In comparison, raising children is a bed of roses.

items.name: Bontarian Tofu
items.description: This pet has been well-raised and will follow all your rules – that is, until it gets hungry or you don't pay enough attention to it for a few seconds.

items.name: Measured Bow Meow
items.description: As good as gold, and as dumb as a stump.

items.name: Paunchy Bow Meow
items.description: The size of its stomach is proportional to its ego.

items.name: Icky Bow Meow
items.description: As sticky as the forehead of an Astrubian who's got acne.

items.name: Charming Bow Meow
items.description: It's difficult to resist it when it wiggles its little behind while cooing each time you go to pet it.

items.name: Brakmarian Bow Meow
items.description: This particularly cheeky and undisciplined pet will give you the run-around. In comparison, raising children is a bed of roses.

items.name: Bontarian Bow Meow
items.description: This pet has been well-raised and will follow all your rules – that is, until it gets hungry or you don't pay enough attention to it for a few seconds.

items.name: Measured Boon
items.description: This pet has been given a healthy, balanced diet throughout its growth. You envy it each time you look at it.

items.name: Paunchy Boon
items.description: The size of its stomach is proportional to that of your your ankles.

items.name: Icky Boon
items.description: Even clingier than your old classmate, of whom you've never really managed to rid yourself.

items.name: Charming Boon
items.description: It's difficult to resist it when it wiggles its little behind while cooing each time you go to pet it.

items.name: Brakmarian Boon
items.description: Its piercing eyes will make you feel guilty every time you refuse to give it some kibble.

items.name: Bontarian Boon
items.description: This pet can look after a house while its master is away, but it's also capable of destroying it if its master doesn't come back quickly enough.

items.name: Tofury
items.description: This petsmount is all the rage in farmyards.

items.name: Boonax
items.description: Once it's dead, you can stuff it and make quite a comfortable armchair out of it.

items.name: Marvellous Woman Shield
items.description: Discreet, submissive, weak, servile, fearful, dependent: the marvellous woman doesn't have any of these qualities. She does have a wonderful look though, thanks to this shield.

items.name: Zombite Seemyool
items.description: If you think dressing your loyal destrier in the necrotised skin of one of its fellow creatures is tasteful, you should consider cutting back on eating Crobaks for breakfast or listening to Kramstine all day long.

items.name: Extravagant Shield
items.description: In addition to giving you presence and originality, this shield will protect you from your enemies' mortal blows in the middle of the battle. But when you open your mouth, it won't protect you from the sarcasm and jeers when people realise you don't actually have any personality to speak of. It's a risk you'll have to take.

items.name: Captivating Shield
items.description: Something about this shield captivates you, but you can't quite put your finger on what – and it's keeping you awake at night. It is handsome – very handsome – but you've got better things to do at night than stare at it constantly, starting with getting rid of those horrid bags under your eyes or doing your homework.

items.name: Zombite Shield
items.description: This shield seems to have a mind of its own and it likes to become one with its owner. If you're in any doubt, just take a look at the necrosis running from your hand to your shoulder.

items.name: Zombite Cape
items.description: This cape is in such bad shape that it looks like the slightest gust of wind will tear it into shreds. And yet, it hasn't happened yet. That's the power of the zombite-attitude: "I'm still standing, even though I'm living dead" as sang the zombie minstrel, John Elton.

items.name: Zombite Headgear
items.description: This hat gives off such an awful smell that it's hard to know whether your head smells like your feet or your feet smell like your head. At least you have a choice.

items.name: Jumping Knight Helmet
items.description: Rumour has it that if you jump on Bump's head while he's wearing this helmet, you'll be able to do a super-jump. You may wonder who was stupid enough to come up with an idea like that when you see those blades sticking out of it.

items.name: Toxic Mask
items.description: It's hard to know if Toxine wore this mask as protection from the most dangerous poisonous gases, or to protect her allies from her fetid breath.

items.name: Ancient Sufokia Shield
items.description: The motif on this shield is strangely reminiscent of the ones that can be found in the Eliotrope Temple at Sufokia.

items.name: Nimaltocape
items.description: Just like Mishell, this cape is soft and protective. All cute little animals are drawn to it, and they love to snuggle up inside. This isn't going to do much good for your reputation as a warrior with a heart of stone.

items.name: Green Ninja Nunchakus
items.description: The first thing you did when you got your hands on these nunchakus was to imagine yourself doing all sorts of windmills and figures-of-eight to impress your enemies. It's only after months of training and multiple facial and groin injuries that you realised that there's more to the mastery of this weapon than meets the eye (and groin). Becoming a ninja isn't all that easy.

items.name: Green Ninja Shell
items.description: The Green Ninja's shell is useful for both holding its weapons and protecting its rear. In your case, it's also handy for hiding your spinal malformation and your huge bum.

items.name: Green Ninja Pizzashield
items.description: This shield, made from a hot Margorito pizza, won't protect you from blows, but you can still throw it at your enemy's feet to distract them while you run away like the little coward you are.

items.name: Green Ninja Headband
items.description:
This orange headband may well be little out of fashion, but it's still effective: now you're a mysterious righter of wrongs, a defender of the oppressed! You'll have to rise to the occasion. 
(Change the appearance of the headgear you are wearing by dragging and dropping this item onto it.)

items.name: Raccoon
items.description: Behind its adorable appearance, the Raccoon is a cruel and highly meticulous animal. It both scares you and impresses you at the same time: it'll always clean your enemies, do their makeup and dress them up properly, before finishing them off in cold blood. It's a weird habit, but one that has the merit of giving them a dignified death. You can have a clear conscience.

items.name: Fouxar
items.description: Unlike the Maho Firefoux, the Fouxar won't transform into a Yokai Fouxar when in combat. But it does like to roll up into a ball and hide until the fighting is over, letting you do all the work. You thought you'd managed to tame a vicious predator, but you ended up with an adorable pet instead.

items.name: Air Knight Shovel
items.description: With this multi-functional shovel, the Air Knight can fight off his enemies and repot pumpkins in his vegetable patch. Rather practical, don't you think?

items.name: Air Knight Wings
items.description: Morgan Forr, nicknamed the Air Knight, is an old man (in excellent shape for his age), who defends widows and orphans, along with his loyal flying destrier, Pier. He claims to be an "independent righter of wrongs" and says he used to be the god of a celestial island, back in the day. Perhaps he's lost his marbles after all those years of solitude, but he's still a hero in the eyes of the little people.

items.name: Air Knight Shield
items.description: The Air Knight helps the most vulnerable by fighting for them when they get into trouble. He's given them a whistle so they can easily call him in case of difficulty. But clearly not everyone has the same understanding of the word "difficulty", so the knight has a very busy schedule that alternates between epic fights and thankless chores.

items.name: Air Knight Helmet
items.description: According to the Air Knight, this helmet is the most aerodynamic helmet ever made. Experts all agree that this title actually belongs to the Wind Kwak Headdress, but they're also keen to point out that the knight's helmet is also "really cool".

items.name: Skeleton Seemyool
items.description: You've sent your Seemyool to the realm of the dead, so legend may come to life. Thanks to this paradox and especially this harness, your Seemyool never was so scary.

items.name: Measured Godron
items.description: This small dragon is so shy that it'll never dare even declare its flame of love for you.

items.name: Paunchy Godron
items.description: This little dragon has stockpiled a serious amount of food for its next nap, which may well last several centuries. It must have followed its master's example.

items.name: Icky Godron
items.description: Its former master forgot to teach it the basic rules of hygiene, like not having a wash more than once a year (to preserve its skin) and never brushing its teeth (to preserve the toothbrushes). Now it's a little sticky, but it's also your pet, so you love it nonetheless.

items.name: Charming Godron
items.description: This little dragon is able to melt anyone's heart – or a slab of butter – with its hot, silky breath.

items.name: Brakmarian Godron
items.description: This little dragon loves houses set ablaze, infernos and forest fires. It'll cause you trouble, but will happily help you prepare grilled food.

items.name: Bontarian Godron
items.description: This little dragon is trying to spread the good word in the area by burning any ungodly hordes that would dare oppose it.

items.name: Dragnir
items.description: This little dragon will take you to infinity and perhaps beyond...

items.name: Count Harebourg's Shield
items.description: Legend has it that you received this shield because of your exceptional monster-massacring and noble-disembowelling skills. Only those who witnessed the scene know that you were simply in the right place at the right time.

items.name: Divine Shield
items.description: As soon as you say the word "divine", people can't help but answer "whine". Either this word has some link with the gods that you've failed to grasp, or your entourage has a really poor sense of humour.

items.name: Divine Helmet
items.description: This helmet sends you visions from a distant astral plain, as if the gods you were whispering in your ear regarding the mysterious fate of the universe. Had you been someone else, you would have interpreted them and might have become an oracle or prophet, but fortunately, you don't understand a word of it.

items.name: Divine Cape
items.description: This cape, also known as "The Adornment of the Gods", is known for its immaculate whiteness. Rumour has it that nothing can sully this cape, but it wasn't counting on your diet, mainly consisting of fatty foods, and your messy passion for sliding in the mud.

items.name: Battler Cloak
items.description: This thick cloak will easily cushion a few smacks on the bottom.

items.name: Coulive Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Coulive Shield
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.

items.name: Coulive Hat
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate hats.

items.name: Primordial Artificer's Shield
items.description: This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.

items.name: Primordial Craftmagus's Shield
items.description: This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.

items.name: Primordial Blacksmith's Shield
items.description: This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.

items.name: Primordial Smithmagus's Shield
items.description: This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.

items.name: Primordial Carver's Shield
items.description: This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.

items.name: Primordial Carvmagus's Shield
items.description: This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.

items.name: Scarab Shield
items.description: The carapace used for this shield makes it extremely resistant but still light. Better keep a close grip on it. It'd be a shame to lose it with the first gust of wind – like you did your first love and your last hat.

items.name: Scarab Cape
items.description: I wouldn't expect to have much success when you spread the wings of this cape, if I were you. Not unless you're hoping to seduce eager Scaraleaves nearby.

items.name: Scarab Helmet
items.description: There was once a vast underground city called Gazjol-Nureb, where Scarabs – those proud giant beetles – had prospered for centuries. But their civilisation disappeared one day in mysterious circumstances... Archaeologists hypothesise that the terrible King Lytch was responsible, but nothing has been proven definitively. All that's left of these legendary insects are the Scaraleaves, their closest living relatives.

items.name: Scarab Seemyool
items.description: When you equip your Seemyool with this harness, it might start to think it's a Scarab and push a ball of dung in front of it. But that's a good thing. People will get out of your way to let you by – excellent for avoiding those traffic jams on the way out of Astrub during the height of rush hour.

items.name: Royal Gobball Shield
items.description: This shield was given to you by Parillia for managing to calm the Royal Gobball down. However, you have been banned from ever setting foot in Tainela again after the chaos you caused. But, as the proverb says: "You can't make peace without breaking things to pieces".

items.name: Queen of Thieves Shield
items.description: When you carry this shield, it's as if you thieved it from the Queen of Thieves herself. Oh, the irony! Is it due to your talent, a stroke of luck, or fate? Even you're not certain, but despite everything, it'll make for a rather funny anecdote to tell your friends.

items.name: Robust Helmet
items.description: This helmet provides optimal protection for the skull, but diminishes the visual field considerably. If you're used to rushing in headlong, this helmet will become your best friend.

items.name: Robust Cape
items.description: Underneath its warrior-like appearance and unrivalled strength, this cape is soft and silky smooth. At long last, here's an item that will allow you to be both gentle and powerful at once.

items.name: Lagomorph Helmet
items.description: The metal ears on this headgear amplify the sound of growling stomachs in those around you. It's ideal for hearing enemies approach, or verifying whether your friends are properly digesting the delicious meal you've reheated for the twelfth time.

items.name: Lagomorph Cape
items.description: Is it a ball? Is it a tail? It doesn't matter. Either way, you wear it proudly.

items.name: Melodious Cape
items.description: The Melodious Cape is currently very fashionable with minstrels, because it lets you record a voice using its magic. Once recorded, you need to press different areas of the cape to create a melody from the voice. Purists debate using it, but you have to admit that it opens many interesting possibilities.

items.name: Sewn Shield
items.description: This shield is made from many magical threads, whose colours change depending on the bearer's mood and health. When they're fighting fit, the shield is solid and radiant. On the other hand, if ever you should suffer from nasty stomachache or gangrene, for example, avoid holding it, because nobody wants to see that.

items.name: Dracolyte
items.description: Dracolytes are loyal and affectionate animals who will follow you everywhere. True, they don't have the stature of a real dragon, nor even of a Dreggon, but they can spit modest flames and cook small amounts of food to perfection! This may appear futile, but how many have perished because they neglected good cooking at a critical moment?

items.name: Crypt Shield
items.description: Filled with powerful magic, this shield will protect you from crypts. You can, of course, get attacked in a crypt, but not by the crypt itself, or so your friends tell you. It's clear that those oblivious fools have never been attacked by a garden shed, or they'd have bought this shield too.

items.name: Crypt Cape
items.description: The person who sold you this cape claimed to have acquired it from a wise old hermit who lived long ago, in a crypt where he meditated, far away from the stupidity of man. The hermit must have been truly wise and very brave to live in such deprivation and put up with the smell of urine, alcohol and dead animals that emanate from this cape.

items.name: Crypt Headgear
items.description: This headgear will give you an excuse to look like something the dog dug up without having to mention last night's party.

items.name: Cryptic Seemyool
items.description: Judging by its name, you'd expect this harness to be difficult to decrypt. That's not really a problem, since harnesses aren't the sort of item that need decrypting anyway. Unless it's in a crypt and you need to take it out of there, but then "decrypt" isn't really the right word for that either.

items.name: Rhineetle Draeggosaure
items.description: Your Rhineetle finally looks mean.

items.name: Draeggosaure Headgear
items.description: Careful not to get bitten when you scratch its head.

items.name: Draeggosaure Cape
items.description: Beautiful scales for a nicely rounded back.

items.name: Draeggosaure Shield
items.description: You are finally equipped to play the Kikousaure!

items.name: Shiny Shield
items.description:
"What is dead cannot protect."
That's the motto of champions who keep their shields to defend themselves instead of giving them to their weaker allies.

items.name: Shiny Headgear
items.description: The two horns on this headgear can be used as lightning rods in order to give you flashes of genius.

items.name: Shiny Cape
items.description:
"It doesn't shine when it comes to intelligence."
This quotation could be used to describe this cape, as well as some of your closest friends.

items.name: Shiny Dragoturkey
items.description: It's better to shine brightly than to burn brightly.

items.name: Shiny Seemyool
items.description: It's better to shine brightly than to burn brightly.

items.name: Nelween's Shield
items.description: Don't be gloomy: this is one gloaming good shield!

items.name: Crocabulia's Shield
items.description: Turn this shield upside down and you can dig its horns into the ground to use it like a hoe or a rake.

items.name: Temporis I Mask
items.description: Time seems to have no effect on you. You haven't lost any of your youthful immaturity.

items.name: Temporis I Cloak
items.description: Gone, awning, with the wind.

items.name: Snailtri
items.description: From the icy lands of Frigost to the darkest alleys of Brakmar, the Snailtri is at every party. A faithful companion, it won't let you out of its sight. And when the going gets tough, it won't hesitate to come zooming in to help you reach your goal.

items.name: Minowang
items.description: The Minowang has dark fur and a feisty temperament, inherited from a childhood spent in the shadow of a mountain of fire. Extremely stubborn, it preferred to join you rather than put its hooves up and lounge on the sandy beaches of Minotoror Island.

items.name: Komet
items.description: A lover of Goblimps' warped sense of humour, Komet was charmed by your own. This prompted him to leave the snowy forests of Kwismas Island so he could accompany you on rousing adventures.

items.name: Corsair Seemyool
items.description: The rudder attached to the back of this harness lets you steer your Seemyool as you would a pirate ship. You just need to sit on your Seemyool facing backwards, and steer without seeing where you are going; alternatively, you can sit facing forwards to see where you're going but make your Seemyool move opposite to all your instructions – that is backwards when you're going forwards. You'll get used to it right quick, you'll see.

items.name: Ice Rhineetle
items.description: Equip your mount with this harness to turn it into a walking stockpile of ice cubes, perfect for serving cold drinks to your guests. Careful it doesn't steal you limelight, though. Your Rhineetle might just become the hottest new cold thing at summer parties.

items.name: Tal Kasha Shield
items.description: Before you took it from her, Tal Kasha used this shield as a mirror when she brushed her monstrous hair in the morning. There are even a few hairs still caught on it, and they scratched you when you tried to pull them off. Hair this aggressive is exceedingly rare.

items.name: Obsidemon Shield
items.description: The volcanic energy of Obsidemon radiating out of this shield makes it a very practical portable grill for anyone who loves outdoor cooking.

items.name: Corsair Cloak
items.description: If by some odd twist of fate, your boat was ripped asunder, this solid cloak could replace it perfectly. Provided, of course, you had several dozen of the same model and sewed them all together, which leaves you plenty of time to go under.

items.name: Corsair Shield
items.description: This shield was designed specially to resist cannonballs, and thereby protect its bearer during naval battles. Make sure to read the fine print, though: "Only works if you have prodigious strength." So, make sure you build up as much muscle as you can before your next battle.

items.name: Corsair Hat
items.description: The shape of this hat makes it an excellent tool for rapidly bailing out large quantities of water. Quite handy when your ship is sinking as fast as your career as a pirate and your dreams of grandeur.

items.name: Al Howin Gobtubby
items.description: This Gobtubby is wearing a disguise out of solidarity with its Gobball friends, as Al Howin is a traumatic time for the fluffy creatures; they are forced to don silly Pumpkwin masks to try and scare Astrubians.

items.name: Al Howin Borbat
items.description: Is it a Pumpkwin with Borbat wings, or a Borbat with a Pumpkwin head?

items.name: Gladiator Shield
items.description: This shield's appearance is determined by your performance in the Kolossium. You can claim you deserve better and that your allies kept you from doing better, but the shield doesn't lie.

items.name: Malicious Shield
items.description: This shield is probably the result of a prank.

items.name: Malicious Hat
items.description: Unlike other hats of its kind, this magical hat never bends to its wearer's will, and its desires will go over your head.

items.name: Malicious Cloak
items.description: This cape renders you invisible, but only in total darkness.

items.name: Peki Peki Shield
items.description: Some people choose to decorate their shield with the head of a lion, a dragon, or a griffin as a symbol of power and majesty, but you've chosen a shield with the head of a stupid dog.

items.name: Protoz'orror Shield
items.description: This shield, made from a piece of the Protoz'orror, has a very high bacterial contamination potential. Indeed, it represents the equivalent of tens of dirty tissues rolled into one, so your enemies had better use sanitising gel or any other disinfectant after hitting your shield, or they'll catch a cold that would make the most energetic of Trools lethargic.

items.name: Hairy Helmet
items.description: This headgear is ideal for exploring the frozen lands of Kwismas Island, as the thickness of the hair stops the cold from getting through, and the glasses protect the eyes during snowstorms. But be careful that you're not mistaken for a Slayhound – a misguided hunter might inadvertently shoot at you.

items.name: Hairy Cloak
items.description: This thick fur cape is uniquely comfortable, perfect for facing the hardships of winter. Your friends say you look plump when you wear it, when actually, it's the hair that makes you feel puffy.

items.name: Hairy Shield
items.description: With its long sharp fangs and tousled hair, this shield is fearsome enough to instil fear in your enemies' hearts. The way it resembles your mother-in-law seems to be purely by chance, even if quite obvious.

items.name: Advenkap
items.description: Valiant adventurers know how to tout the advantages of this Advent cap to novices visiting Kwismas Island.

items.name: Az'Hassin Shield
items.description: This is not a shield. It is actually a kind of glider disguised as a shield, which the Az'Hassins raise above themselves before jumping from a high spot to enter or escape somewhere by air. Since its canvas is very fragile, a mere encounter with a small bird in flight could pierce it and make you fall. Also, even experienced Az'Hassins hardly use it, reluctant to end their lives in such an inglorious way.

items.name: Az'Hasstwo Shield
items.description: You might be surprised at there being a shield in an Az'Hassin's paraphernalia, but there is actually a very simple explanation. In fact, apprentices sometimes mess up their first attempts at murder, so they are given a shield to try and survive after having failed miserably to kill a defenceless person by surprise.

items.name: Az'Hassin Cloak
items.description: Ever since you acquired this cloak, it has regularly made you want to jump from absurd heights just for fun. Provided there is a cart full of straw below, you can survive the fall. This may sound strange, but you will be surprised at the number of straw-filled carts below just about every high spot from where you might want to jump. You'd almost think they were put there deliberately...

items.name: Az'Hassin Hood
items.description: No more failed entrances due to gusts of wind making your hood fly off too soon – and your credibility with it. The inside frame allows the hood to stay perfectly in place, worthy of the greatest Az'Hassins. On the other hand, you won't be able to turn or raise your head, which could be a problem when you have to look right, then left, then right before crossing the street.

items.name: Az'Hassin Daggers
items.description: These daggers were made for sneaking up on opponents, but it became apparent that they also had another very special ability. Indeed, if you are attacked head-on and you manage to counter the attack with these daggers, your body will – on its own – move to counterattack and kill your opponent for sure. If your enemies had the intelligence to attack all of you at the same time, you wouldn't have a chance, but since they stubbornly line up and attack one at a time, you'll massacre them.

items.name: Esspeakewlair Helmet
items.description: Legend has it that this helmet belonged to the famous war chief named Romulu Ceremu. Taken in and raised by a Boowolf family when he was a boy, he grew up to become a powerful warrior and an ambitious conqueror. You must honour his name.

items.name: Esspeakewlair Cloak
items.description: Romulu Ceremu had a habit of wearing this cloak with a small purple skirt and large sandal-boots. Strangely enough, this habit has disappeared, and people wear only the cloak now.

items.name: Esspeakewlair Shield
items.description: Romulu Ceremu regularly organised warriors' games to entertain his soldiers in peacetime, the DeeDubYuess. Fans could proudly wear the symbols of their favourite teams on their shields to support them in these contests.

items.name: Vee'two Battler Shield
items.description: "The fighter sharpens up his shield tirelessly, but only gets it out for good reason." — Vee'Two

items.name: Waurice Maleffe's Diadem
items.description: Waurice Maleffe was an aesthete, fascinated by beauty in general, and especially by that of people. One day, he came up with the idea of making a beautiful diadem that he would offer to the most beautiful person he would meet in his life. But his quest never came to an end, for there was always some more beautiful person to discover, and he ended up losing his mind in search of ultimate beauty. Waurice must be turning in his grave knowing that his diadem is on your head. You may not be the most beautiful person in the world, but at least you're not crazy or dead.

items.name: Headgear of Mystery
items.description: Highly appreciated by fans of investigations, puzzles and other disciplines that lead to headaches, this headgear has its own mystery, which has not been solved to this day: why do those who wear it grow a magnificent moustache when they equip it? The most-accepted theory (but not necessarily the most correct one) is that no one can solve an investigation without a big moustache.

items.name: Saint Bonnetwine
items.description: The two antennae situated on top of this hat have the peculiarity of releasing powerful seduction pheromones into the air when they are tossed around. In order to charm the one you love, you'll therefore have to shake your head vigorously to release these pheromones. Despite their effectiveness, it's quite likely you'll just look like an idiot. Using this helmet is not necessarily the best way to seduce people.

items.name: Monkiki'Ng Hat
items.description: If you think you're teasing, mischievous or a joker right now, it's probably because of this headgear. Indeed, it has been imbued with the character of its former wearer, an impish little monkey whose main occupation was annoying the gods by playing bad tricks on them all day long. The monkey ended up being turned into a mountain, so go easy on the jokes.

items.name: Monkiki'Ng Cloak
items.description: The staff attached to the back of this cloak has a very unusual power. It can change size at will, making this an item coveted by all, especially men who think that their virility depends on the size of their stick. It's often forgotten that too big a stick is impossible to handle, so why would you want a big stick at whatever cost if you're not going to use it?

items.name: Monkiki'Ng Shield
items.description: Under its appearance as a mere shield, there is actually a teasing, malicious demon who will exploit your enemies' sensitivities. A master in the art of grimacing, he will give your opponent a compendium of extremely annoying facial expressions. Unfortunately for your opponents, no one can try and beat him at this little game, because you can't teach an old shield new faces.

items.name: Storf
items.description: The Storf is made up of magic snow, so it can stay at a very low temperature in any environment. This ability has not escaped those who like to drink cold beers under a blazing sun, who have therefore renamed it "The Icebox". Another fine example of conversion.

items.name: Prez' Doh'bi
items.description: The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

items.name: Prez' Doh'blik
items.description: The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

items.name: Prez' Doh'bstruktion
items.description: The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

items.name: Prez' Doh'brrmann
items.description: The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

items.name: Prez' Doh'bivalent
items.description: The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

items.name: Pikip
items.description: A small tree with a wandering heart, this Pikip is the perfect companion for sowing thorns into the sides of your opponents' jumpers.

items.name: Aispik
items.description: Aispiks are of a very discreet nature. The icy peaks covering their skin allow them to camouflage themselves effectively in snow-covered lands. Paradoxically, it's also this ability that led to their discovery, when an unfortunate adventurer sat on what he thought was "a comfortable little pile of snow".

items.name: Rikoh
items.description: When he was still an infant, Rikoh got bitten by a Khamelerost, which gave him the amazing ability to change colour at will. It turns out he's attached himself to you, and he's changing colour to suit your outfit. So be careful, because if you're one of those people who dresses any old how, you'll both be matching, but doubly ridiculous.

items.name: Hesk
items.description: This Slayhound has the ability to adapt the colour of its fur to the colours of its rider.

items.name: Shadragon Shield
items.description: This shield, made from black dragon scales, might make you think of a charred skull. If you could spit fire, it would be brilliantly threatening to your enemies.

items.name: Shadragon Helmet
items.description: A fierce jawline, sharp fangs, made out of the darkest black metal edged with gold, glowing eyes under scaly eyebrows – this full-face helmet has all the bells and whistles if you want to make an impression. It is, shall we say, not very practical if you want to pick your nose, cough, sneeze, or even throw up.

items.name: Shadragon Cape
items.description: This cape is very useful if you need to pass yourself off as a huge lizard or puny dragon. Be warned, however. Its wings won't let you fly, and the tail doesn't grow back, so be careful.

items.name: Karne
items.description: What an odd creature it is, this Karne. Many theories abound. Some think it's an obese Tofu that grew in a skull; others prefer the version that says it's a skull animated by dark magic that caused it to grow wings and feet; while others still believe that a scientific experiment went horribly awry. One thing is sure: Karne is not the most affectionate animal ever, nor the cutest, but having it in your company will naturally give you a considerably evil aura.

items.name: Shadragon Rhineetle
items.description: Is it a nose? A horn? A coat rack? No matter. This large appendage will let your Rhineetle pierce your enemies' thoracic cages when you rush them.

items.name: Esspeakewlair Rhineetle
items.description: Rhineetles naturally have a very strong carapace able to withstand nearly all physical aggression. So, was it really necessary to add full-body armour to your Rhineetle?

items.name: Kwismas 648 Treetop
items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.

items.name: Rafal
items.description: Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them.

items.name: Brial
items.description: Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them.
