items.name: Dakal
items.description: Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them.

items.name: Salar
items.description: Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them.

items.name: Mikhal
items.description: Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them.

items.name: Kourial
items.description: Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them.

items.name: Hyrkul Shield
items.description: When Hyrkul was kind, he went to war on Saturdays. Now that he's mean, he goes to war all the time.

items.name: Hyrkul Helmet
items.description: This helmet may very well be thick and solid, but it won't stop experienced mind-readers from penetrating your brain. It is, however, the ideal accessory to protect you from falling objects on high-risk construction sites, and to protect you should you fall on your head.

items.name: Hyrkul Cape
items.description: Wearing the skin of a creature you managed to kill on your back as a trophy has, over time, become extremely commonplace. Nowadays, it's unclear whether whoever is wearing the skin is indeed the author of the feat... Claiming that you've defeated a Brakmarian champion with your own hands and that you're wearing a remnant of the epic fight on your back can make you an impostor, unless you master the art of lying perfectly.

items.name: Wa Odanowth's Cwown
items.description: Every year on 6 Javian, Twelvians come together to eat the famous Thwee Kings Cake. This tradition has been adapted from Wabbit customs, consisting of hiding this crown somewhere in the world. Whoever manages to find it earns the right to wear it and is named "Wa Odanowth" for the celebration.

items.name: Mandibular Bow
items.description: This bow is the only one made from Cyclouse carapaces. It'd be a shame to forgo owning such a rare item.

items.name: Mandibular Shield
items.description: Your enemies are likely to grit their teeth when they see you with this shield.

items.name: Mandibular Cloak
items.description: With this cloak, the next time someone taps on your shoulder hoping to give you a start, they're the one likely to be startled.

items.name: Mandibular Helmet
items.description: This nearly-full-face helmet is ideal protection on your travels, especially when riding the more recalcitrant mounts.

items.name: Biting Dragoturkey
items.description: Once you've equipped your Dragoturkey with this harness, no one'll dare lay a hand on you.

items.name: Biting Seemyool
items.description: Once it dons this harness, your Seemyool won't have any more trouble chewing the food you want to feed it.

items.name: Biting Rhineetle
items.description: Equipping your Rhineetle with this harness will make it less likely to bump its horn as it goes through doors. Be warned, though, it'll be more likely to bite the legs of any adventurers who get too close.

items.name: Wingepig
items.description: Burning with desire to escape from Minotoror Island, the Wingepig's tiny wings took it too close to the sun. Ever since that day, adventurers the world over have been drooling over its perfectly grilled back.

items.name: Glomerys
items.description: This pet rolls itself up into a ball whenever it senses any danger, which makes it the perfect enemy detector. If it's never relaxed and unrolled in your presence, you might want to take a long look in the mirror.

items.name: Tarantulino
items.description: This carapace-covered mount loves bloody combat and stories that end poorly.

items.name: Chocolate Dragoone
items.description: This Dragoone looks scrumptious indeed, but comes with a sternly worded warning.

items.name: Anakronik Helmet
items.description: This helmet has no business being in this world, and even less business being on your head.

items.name: Anakronik Pack
items.description: It seems that this backpack carries the answer to an ultimate question that hasn't been asked yet.

items.name: Anakronik Shield
items.description: The origin of this shield is still a great mystery; no one knows where it came from, nor what it's made of. However, some use it as a dice tray when games get heated.

items.name: Snowdrift Shield
items.description: When it's not pushing your friends when it shouldn't, this shield will protect you from blows and keep your cold heart from melting.

items.name: Chokao Shield
items.description: While mastering subordinating conjunctions has never saved an adventurer from a bloody battle, it can save you a few kamas. If it won't spread chaos, you can eat it on toast instead of hazelnut spread... or cover it with hazelnut spread and eat it instead of toast.

items.name: Dragokronik
items.description: Many have overestimated their Dragoturkeys' capacities after equipping this harness. Attempting to swim across a lake of lava or jump off the Incarnam cliffs is strongly discouraged.

items.name: Noxmask
items.description: This mask was designed for adventurers who've always dreamt of being known for their bright ideas but never have any ideas, bright or otherwise.

items.name: Noxcape
items.description: This cape will protect you while you're exploring dark, terrifying, and oh-so-exiting new places.

items.name: Noxshield
items.description: This shield shines with equal intensity day and night. Its manufacturer had no concept of energy efficiency.

items.name: Noxbow
items.description: The only thing original about this weapon is its name, and whoever named it couldn't be bothered.

items.name: Noxine Dragoturkey
items.description: Ideal if you want to be a target during a nighttime attack, this harness will shine a light on your mount.

items.name: Noxine Seemyool
items.description: You never know what you might encounter in the depths of the abysses, particularly since you can't see much more than a few kametres ahead. This harness will solve your vision problems and make your mount beloved prey for marine predators.

items.name: Noxine Rhineetle
items.description: This harness will make your mount look like a giant firefly and spread light pollution throughout the wildest regions.

items.name: Noxine
items.description: This technological parasite seems to come from a different era. Despite its harmful impact on the environment, adventurers are deliriously fond of it and ready to do anything to get their hands on one.

items.name: Bigxine
items.description: It's like a Noxine but much more: more feet, more light, more patterns, more sound, etc.

items.name: Pocketwatch Shield
items.description: Never let your guard down again when it's time to clean someone's clock.

items.name: Tailcoat Cloak
items.description: Sometimes it's wiser to adapt one's adornment to the world around you. Even though it might mean compromising your references.

items.name: Hats Off Ta Ya Hat
items.description: Magical hats are named after the first words said to them. I'm sure you can already imagine the look on the hatter's face when her apprentice commented on her work.

items.name: Weeov Hat
items.description: A wee oven to keep your wee head warm.

items.name: Jar-Jar Bag
items.description: A glass container full of mess at all times.

items.name: Fleaster Cape
items.description: Fleaster falls on the first Sunday after the first full moon following 21 Martalo, so on 22 Martalo at earliest, if the full moon falls on the evening of the 21st, and on 25 Aperirel at latest. This does not mean the moon as it is seen, but rather the "Fleastal" moon, calculated using an inexact but traditional method. The "civilised" peoples of the World of Twelve – having adopted both the Grougorian calendar reform and a concurrent correction for the lunar cycle – often celebrate on a different day than the "primitive" peoples, and the discrepancy can be either nothing, or one or five weeks (depending on the year), or exceptionally four weeks if there is a new moon in Bonta but not in Brakmar.

items.name: Fleaster Topper
items.description: This headgear will let you dress up as a Fleaster Wodent so you can hop through the bushes and scatter chocolate eggs to your heart's content. To each their own. We would never judge you for your hobbies.

items.name: Fleaster Targa
items.description: The thin layer of praline filling between the two squares of chocolate that make up this shield absorbs blows very well. Properly wielded, this shield can even return certain attacks to their senders. You can't count on it to protect against diabetes, though.

items.name: Proto-Noxine
items.description: An identical reproduction, made by an adventurer who has certified that he slipped into a temporal anomaly, this mechanical pet is perfect for studying your target before taking action. Be careful when looking up in the shower as its eye is very sensitive to shampoo splatter.

items.name: Viewshield
items.description: Some like to see, and others like to be seen. Your heart seems caught between the two, unable to settle on either.

items.name: Lagoonurkey
items.description: With this harness, your Dragoturkey will have the cutest eyes, deep blue scales, and a constant fear of finishing second.

items.name: Water Seemyool
items.description: Historical histories always mention draconic dragons and heroic heroes. Write your own adventurous adventure in writing with your water Seemyool.

items.name: Crowturkey
items.description:
This spectral dragoturkey will almost make you want to throw on a costume and terrorise your competitors. What a novel idea. You'll do it when Piwis have teeth. Or when the world has flooded.

Err, what?

items.name: Musical Ring
items.description: When you wear this ring, people can hear you coming long before you arrive. Slip it on your finger and you'll feel an irresistible urge to sing.

items.name: Tylezia Cape
items.description: This cape is reminiscent of a dragon's mane and gives you a refined air whenever you want.

items.name: Tylezia Diadem
items.description: There's nothing more elegant than a diadem adorned with feathers to command respect but keep the mood light as a feather.

items.name: Tylezia Shield
items.description: This shield is adorned with a ruby in a colour so bright that the Crocodyls will keep their distance from you.

items.name: Lucra Lucky Hat
items.description: Silam designed this hat for his friend, Lucra Lucky, who was looking for an inexpensive way to deal with the weather in Ohwymi. Made of flexible material, it fits narrow Piwi heads as well as it does adventurers' swollen heads.

items.name: Shushield
items.description: The expression "be careful no one gives you the evil eye" takes on its full meaning with this shield... Except in your case, you've already been given it.

items.name: Observant Shushield
items.description: The expression "be careful no one gives you the evil eye" takes on its full meaning with this shield... Except in your case, you've already been given it.

items.name: Skeleton Rhineetle
items.description: How did an insect end up with bones instead of an exoskeleton? Instead of racking your brains for an explanation, just be proud to show off your terrifying mount.

items.name: Torvil
items.description: Torvil has always dreamed of flying, feeling light as a feather, riding an updraught, getting lost in the vastness of the sky, and watching migratory birds soar off into the horizon. Unfortunately, his status as a turtle keeps his feet firmly on the ground in the mud with the Gobballs. Still, he hasn't given up hope of one day soaring above the clouds and living his dream.

items.name: LeChouque Shield
items.description: The good thing about being thick in the middle is that it offers some protection against blows, but not as much as this shield.

items.name: Daggero Shield
items.description: After a fun dungeon, there's nothing like a glass of bamboo milk and a new shield before jumping back into the fray.

items.name: Lezia
items.description: Many adventurers have fallen for Lezia's appearance, but few remain to warn about the chaos she can cause. Ignore this warning at your own risk and peril.

items.name: Iop Dragoturkey
items.description: Dragoturkeys aren't known for their intelligence, and this harness isn't going to help any. Don't be surprised if your Dragoturkey decides to jump into the fray for no apparent reason.

items.name: Esspeakewlair Dragoturkey
items.description: Many of the adventurers who've tried this harness have complained of the lack of visibility because of the crest attached to the Dragoturkey's head. Indeed, accidents have skyrocketed since this harness was released, much to alchemists' delight.

items.name: Vici Shield
items.description: Bearing this shield is a not-at-all discreet way of showing the world you're a conqueror.

items.name: Veni Cape
items.description: This cape will make your ordinary comings and goings seem like major historical events.

items.name: Vidi Helmet
items.description: This helmet won't help you see any better, but it will help you to be seen.

items.name: Petal Cape
items.description: This cape can't be worn year-round, but as soon as the sun is out, it blooms! Its colour and smell will leave a lasting impression on everyone you meet.

items.name: Daffodield
items.description: If you think fighting with style and grace is impossible, you've never given this shield a try. That said, remember to water it every day or you'll start to look a bit wilted.

items.name: Flowery Headgear
items.description: What could be better than a floral ensemble to express your love of nature? In these troubled times, you'll remind everyone to respect what was here before you and what will remain after you've gone.

items.name: Iop Shield
items.description: An old saying, known to all good disciples of the god of bravery, claims that Iops must sometimes know how to use their heads. Purists decry the use of this shield instead of one's head to strike opponents. Still, you must admit this shield has certain appealing qualities.

items.name: Iop Rhineetle
items.description: This harness will turn your Rhineetle's horn into a formidable spur. Perfect for making the most battle-hardened Trools quiver in their boots or satisfying the most insecure Iops.

items.name: Iop Seemyool
items.description: Used to aquatic environments, Seemyool hide is not known for its resistance to sharp objects. This armour is perfect if you don't want the tiniest of skirmishes to make Seemyool stir-fry out of you.

items.name: Azure Lance
items.description: This lance looks like a giant sweet, and you're quite safe putting it in your mouth. You simply need to like the taste of metal and varnish to truly enjoy it.

items.name: Azure Shield
items.description: When you're done parading around, don't forget to hang this shield up on the wall and equip a real shield made for combat, or you'll get a nasty surprise when you find yourself in the middle of the action.

items.name: Azure Cape
items.description: This cape is designed to impress young boys and appeal to older girls. It works just as well the other way round.

items.name: Azure Dragoturkey
items.description: This harness is ideal for parading around and will protect your mount from yelling and flower petals.

items.name: Armurino
items.description: Underneath this reinforced carapace, sharp horn and big eyes hides a faithful pet who will be as devoted to you as you've been to the White City.

items.name: Armoured Tortoise
items.description: As a well-known fable says, there's no point in being fast if you don't leave on time. With this petsmount, you won't be the first to get there, but you'll still reach your destination. What's more, its exceptional longevity makes the Armoured Tortoise a perfect gift for whichever successor you name.

items.name: Azure Seemyool
items.description: This harness was thought up for military parades both on land and underwater, which lets you show your military might even in the waters of Sufokia.

items.name: Azure Rhineetle
items.description: Whereas is provides excellent camouflage when Rhineetles fly by day in clear skies, this harness loses its whole purpose as soon as there's so much as a cloud or once the sun has set.

items.name: Azure Helmet
items.description: This helmet's aerodynamic shape shows that it was designed to be worn on the back of a mount, unless it's to help you withstand the wind you'll get in the face.

items.name: Bone Falchion
items.description: Initially designed to mutilate, this weapon can also be used to mutilate or mutilate. The only limit to how you use it is its designer's imagination.

items.name: Bone Shield
items.description: This shield is used as a portable summary execution tool when you're unable to take your gallows with you.

items.name: Bone Cape
items.description: You alone know whether your father- or mother-in-law was used in this cape's design. That way, you can always complain about your in-laws being on your back.

items.name: Bone Helmet
items.description: Your pet's death made you tougher, but you still can't quite bear to be separated from it.

items.name: Bone Dragoturkey
items.description: With this harness on your mount, you've found the almost-perfect solution to rebuff the advances of other Dragoturkeys.

items.name: Skrull
items.description: Rather playful and a little vicious, the Skrull is the perfect companion to paint the town red throughout the World of Twelve. If you feel like crushing someone's party, look no further: the Skrull is for you.

items.name: Bony Arachnee
items.description: Six-legged and highly mobile, the Bony Arachnee is an all-terrain mount that allows you to visit places that are difficult to reach. Careful, though: don't forget to give it some milk from time to time to make its bones stronger, or you could find yourself in a bad way in a secluded place.

items.name: Bone Seemyool
items.description: Thanks to this harness, only scavengers will dare sniff you in the abyssal depths.

items.name: Bone Rhineetle
items.description: Don't be surprised if a procession of Bow Wows follow you on your travels.

items.name: Iop Cape
items.description: Some Iops who are slightly better thinkers than usual wonder what the two shoulder pads on this cape are good for, given that the vast majority of the Warrior God's followers already wear two of them. But the others generally agree that three shoulder pads are always better than two.

items.name: Iop Tiara
items.description: This tiara puts an end to the stereotype of the abusively virile warrior who wears a 200-kilopod wrought-iron helmet, a 3-kametre-long sword covered with the blood of his enemies, and a shield the size of a door. This tiara brings a certain breath of fresh air to Iops' image. However, that won't stop some of them from using it as a weapon in a fistfight if the situation warrants it. As the saying goes, a leopard cannot change its spots!

items.name: Primate Satchel
items.description: The tail attached to this bag will give you an animal look, but be careful not to step on it...

items.name: Primate Ears
items.description: Even though this is clearly a fake pair of ears, seen from afar, people will think that you can hear everything and will be careful not to say bad things about you.

items.name: Primate Shield
items.description: The wood of this shield comes straight from Moon's tree, making it extremely robust while remaining light and easy to handle.

items.name: Rogue Shield
items.description: Young Rogues make one common mistake – using this shield right, left and centre. But they quickly learn that's not the best way to go unnoticed. You need to look unobtrusive so you don't scare your vict... err, clients.

items.name: Rogue Headgear
items.description: Many use this nightmarish headgear to rascal about anonymously and strike fear in their victims' hearts.

items.name: Rogue Cape
items.description: This cape provides efficient camouflage in the darker corners of the World of Twelve. However, wearing it about in broad daylight isn't recommended as the militia is likely to pounce on you very quickly.

items.name: Sram Headgear
items.description: Wearing this headgear is very popular among Sssram's disciples, but there are consssequences. Wearing this headgear will make you whistle when you speak, which may annoy everyone around you.

items.name: Sram Cape
items.description: Srams hide all sorts of traps and other snares under their capes, and the few visible snags are irrefutable proof of this.

items.name: Sram Shield
items.description: The treacherous part of this shield is that it can be used as a dagger: its bone edge is extremely sharp and very effective for stabbing your enemies.

items.name: Sram Dragoturkey
items.description: Not only does this Dragoturkey have skin on its bones, but also bones on its skin.

items.name: Sram Seemyool
items.description: With this harness, your Seemyool will be a bonny bony bundle.

items.name: Sram Rhineetle
items.description: This bag-o-bones boasts a carapace that's bone-deep, so you can make no bones about anything when you're on its back.

items.name: Khin-Tohoun
items.description: Now, not only can have your head in the clouds whenever you want, you can also soar wherever you go!

items.name: Rogue Rhineetle
items.description: Rogues don't always use bombs to break into their victims' bank accounts. Much more discreet, Rhineetle horns make formidable crowbars that can make short work of even the most solid doors in the World of Twelve.

items.name: Rogue Seemyool
items.description: An old Rogue once said, "If the fortress can't be taken, take the muddy path that smells bad." Once the saying became popular, he started selling this harness, touting it's excellent anti-odour properties.

items.name: Rogue Dragoturkey
items.description: If you can't find a way to stop your Dragoturkey from smiling, you're going to have trouble melting into the darkness.

items.name: Dream Wings
items.description: Every night you hope and pray that dream wings will come your way, wings to flap instead of arms, so you can know the magic of their charms.

items.name: Dream Shield
items.description: Some shields want to use you, some shields want to get used by you, some shields want to abuse you, some shields want to be abused...

items.name: Dream Helmet
items.description: Dream when you're feeling blue, dream, that's the only thing to do. Just put this helmet on your hair...

items.name: Osamodas Cape
items.description: This cape is the perfect chic accessory when attending a shockingly good party.

items.name: Osamodas Shield
items.description: This shield was designed for Osamodas who don't like taking a beating, and would rather watch than participate actively in the hostilities.

items.name: Osamodas Headgear
items.description: The bestial god's horns are very popular among fans of assault and battery. On both the giving and receiving end. No judgement here.

items.name: Osamodas Rhineetle
items.description: This harness doesn't give you an extra horn, or three, or four, or five, or six... or even seven. It gives you precisely two extra horns. The fussiest fusspots wonder why we don't just call them Trhineetles.

items.name: Osamodas Seemyool
items.description: The bestial god's influence has given your Seemyool fangs and claws. Is this the next link in the evolutionary chain for our peaceful underwater herbivores?

items.name: Osamodas Dragoturkey
items.description: Don't be surprised to see other Dragoturkeys kowtow before your magnificent steed. But be careful it doesn't take on airs and decide to live its life without you.

items.name: Dreamagon
items.description: If petting a dreamy creature has always been a pipe dream of yours, now you can.

items.name: Nightmare Feathers
items.description: Draped in this black-feather finery, you can sneak into innocent villagers' homes in the dead of night to scare them, chuckling all the way. Be sure NOT to wipe your feet off when you go in, as this will up your villain game.

items.name: Nightmare Eye
items.description: It is said that if the eye on this shield were to open, whosoever should meet its gaze would fall into a dreamlike limbo for eternity and go completely mad. Just in case the legend is true, keep it facing your enemies.

items.name: Nightmare Horns
items.description: The most wicked nightmares use these horns to jab sleeping dreamers on the bum. Now they're yours, you can play a nasty trick on your friends, who will have a good laugh once they've stopped screaming.

items.name: Kirino
items.description: Young, sleep-deprived parents are snapping up this pet. That's because it loves to snack on bad dreams, making it your best ally for peaceful nights.

items.name: Eybahl
items.description: It would seem you've caught its eye...

items.name: Kaspur
items.description: This unobtrusive little ghost will follow you around without making a peep. Listen closely and you'll hear him say he's the friendliest ghost around.

items.name: Boockler
items.description: This shield doesn't look scary at first glance. But its being transparent may explain why some people are startled to see you.

items.name: Foggernaut Headgear
items.description: Legend has it that the creator of this headgear dreamt of becoming a Unikron, which partly explains the gaping hole in the front of this crownlike piece. The myth was tested, but researchers only got sunburn on their foreheads for their trouble.

items.name: Foggernaut Cloak
items.description: This cloak is over 50% fabric, which is fairly surprising for a piece of Foggernaut equipment.

items.name: Foggernaut Shield
items.description: This technological jewel shaped like Oktapodas features six golden, rust-resistant tentacles designed to withstand all kinds of damage. From the front and the back, this high-quality item won't let you down. Only one recommendation on use: remember to protect yourself!

items.name: Foggernaut Dragoturkey
items.description: According to the Foggernaut that designed this harness, it is fitted with steam propellers and is guaranteed to accelerate movement speed. In practise, you don't notice a difference, apart from the metal weighing down the poor beast's old bones.

items.name: Foggernaut Rhineetle
items.description: Engineers before their time, Foggernauts don't do things by halves when it comes to technology. There is so much metal that it's hard to believe this Rhineetle is still alive.

items.name: Foggernaut Seemyool
items.description: One would expect Foggernauts to have a lot of respect for Seemyools, as they've shared the Sufokian Depths with them for such a long time. This constricting harness certainly says otherwise.

items.name: Monstralive Hat
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.

items.name: Cra Headgear
items.description: This headgear gives off a presence that will make everyone think that you belong to the upper classes.

items.name: Cra Cape
items.description: The quality of one's appearance is often found in the details. With this cape, you're certain not to make a mess of it.

items.name: Cra Shoulder Pads
items.description:
These shoulder pads are rare and highly prized pieces that give whoever wears them unrivalled elegance.

(Place these shoulder pads over an already-equipped shield to change their appearance.)

items.name: Cra Dragoturkey
items.description: This harness will transform your dragoturkey's bewildered look into a look that's still bewildered, but a little more classy.

items.name: Cra Seemyool
items.description: Imposing yet still elegant, this harness will give you the stylish touch you were missing.

items.name: Cra Rhineetle
items.description: With this horn as your crosshairs, your accuracy will be greatly increased.

items.name: Wild Headband
items.description: This strap of leather adorned with bones and fur will give you an animal air and terrify your prey.

items.name: Wild Pawncho
items.description: This cape requires special care to keep its fur soft and silky, and the claws that drag on the ground tend to get dirty quickly.

items.name: Wild Shield
items.description: The best defence is a good offence. But a furry shield to push back attacks isn't half bad.

items.name: Spoopy Boar
items.description: Its spotted pelt doesn't make it as fast as a Bow Meaguar, but it will give you a killer look.

items.name: Ankamian Shield
items.description: This shield was made from bricks thrown by the angry mob that appears every time the World of Twelve undergoes a major change.

items.name: Vanelle Sings Shoulder Pads
items.description: With these shoulder pads decorated with teeth, nobody will be able to pat you judgmentally on the shoulder because of your fondness for Borbats.

items.name: Icy Seemyool
items.description: If you're wondering how a Seemyool stuck in the ice can move around, try putting it in the sunshine and see what happens.

items.name: Ominous Helm
items.description: They say that fortune favours the bold, but anyone bold enough to challenge someone wearing this helm will be sceptical of the saying.

items.name: Ominous Cloak
items.description: The darkness of this cloak reveals a fateful omen, especially for anyone that dares to attack its wearer.

items.name: Vanelle Sings Cape
items.description: With this cape made from real Boowolf hairs, you won't catch a cold in the freezing corridors of Forfut Manor.

items.name: Vanelle Sings Hat
items.description: Every good vampire hunter needs this hat, even if it's just to make it look like they hunt vampires seriously.

items.name: Kwismas 649 Treetop
items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.

items.name: Dream Dreamshield
items.description: It's not enough to just move forward through life, you have to dream of your destination.

items.name: Fantastic Dreamshield
items.description: Fantasy is a concept quite foreign to this shield, although its origins lie on the edges of reality.

items.name: Imaginary Dreamshield
items.description: This shield is quite tangible in spite of its name. Each blow is a painful reminder of its very material condition.

items.name: Misty Dreamshield
items.description: Fortunately, this shield is much stronger than its name suggests. Its bright colours will also allow you to blind your enemies.

items.name: Infinite Dreamshield
items.description: This shield will take you to infinity and beyond.

items.name: Star Dreamshield
items.description: This shield is rare and likes that fact to be known. So don't get it dirty, or you'll be sorry.

items.name: Ratalda
items.description: The gem on her forehead allows Ratalda to accurately determine the beginning of the year of the rat. Since the invention of the calendar, the little rat has unfortunately had a hard time harnessing this talent.

items.name: Dorulphe
items.description: Dorulphe isn't the strongest, Dorulphe isn't the fastest, but he'll always be there on cold and frosty mornings.

items.name: Scrabrrrt
items.description: No one knows how long he's been locked in his ice cube, but one thing is for sure, he could put the whole world at risk if anyone touches his acorn.

items.name: Little Moushu Cape
items.description: There's no point sinking your milk teeth into the back of this cape – you've got the wrong legend.

items.name: Little Moushu Headgear
items.description: Nobody knows if Moushu was a little mouse or just a little girl who liked mice. One thing is certain: both stories are told every new year of the rat.

items.name: Little Moushu Shield
items.description: Forged to celebrate the year of the rat, this small ornamental shield is so refined that it'd be a shame to use it in combat.

items.name: Pandowla
items.description: Forget space. Forget time. Ride Pandowla and experience legends before they're written.

items.name: Last Hope Hood
items.description: The message this hood conveys is not to fight with your face covered, but to fight with an open heart.

items.name: Last Hope Cape
items.description: It's not enough to oppose the evil forces hanging over the World of Twelve – you've got to do it in style. This cape is a perfect example of that.

items.name: Last Hope Shield
items.description: When woe has conquered the heart of time, this shield will illuminate the path for those fighting to save it.

items.name: Last Hope Shoulder Pads
items.description: If the weight of the end of the world on your shoulders isn't enough for you, these shoulder pads are just right for you.

items.name: Soft Oak Shield
items.description: This shield saved a Stubbyob prince's life when he faced an albino Bwork. It may save yours when you face your in-laws.

items.name: Turtelonia's Shield
items.description: When you show off this shield, you can be sure that Turtelonia is sulking on moonless nights.

items.name: Nekineko Bag
items.description: Wherever you go with this bag bearing the effigy of Nekineko, don't be surprised if you get followed around by a crowd of Enutrofs.

items.name: Minibora
items.description: Being tall isn't always an advantage when it comes to time travel. Less mass to transport means more opportunities to create paradoxes that could give a narrator nightmares.

items.name: Wa Odanowth's Cloak
items.description: Some tradition-bound Twelvians thought it was forbidden to wear anything other than the Wa Odanowth's Cwown when it was Thwee Kings Cake time. So they wouldn't catch a cold, they voted for the right to wear other attire worthy of a Wa during the event, such as this marvellous cloak.

items.name: Corruption Death Cap
items.description: If you've ever ridden a Dragoturkey, you'll know that a quality saddle is crucial to avoid chafing and itching. If you plan to ride this Death Cap, make sure you have an even better saddle, because you definitely don't want to feel the itching come to life.

items.name: War Gobbalrog
items.description: This mount has a reputation for responding to every twitch of a finger, every wink, and every sound its rider makes. This last point is extremely important and has been the cause of numerous accidents. It is best to only use the words "charge", "attack", "offence", or indeed any war-related term at all in the appropriate context and circumstances.

items.name: Misery Vulture
items.description: With a skilled swoop of its beak, this vulture steals anything that comes within its reach. That makes it an ideal companion for thieves and bandits. The main issue with this method is when you want to get your hands on what it stole. But then, getting your hands dirty is part of the job.

items.name: Servitude Bow Wow
items.description: The trail of slobber behind this watchdog can be a formidable weapon if used properly, and will show off your pilot skills. However, it makes it extremely easy to follow your trail.

items.name: Feca Headgear
items.description: Donning this golden horned headgear will show everyone that luxury and elegance are your thing, but no one will dare comment on it to your face.

items.name: Feca Cape
items.description: The process used to weave this cape made of albino arachnee silk is highly complex, but it produces a light, sturdy and ridiculously stretchy fabric.

items.name: Feca Shield
items.description: The culmination of Feca art, this shield is indestructible and a source of eternal pride for its designers. Its refined colours are a treat for the eyes, too.

items.name: Feca Dragoturkey
items.description: Distinguished from tail to feet, this harness will turn your Dragoturkey into a luxury mount. Sadly, luxury has no effect on intelligence...

items.name: Feca Seemyool
items.description: Guaranteed not to rust (a handy feature for use with aquatic mounts), this harness will strengthen your Seemyool by providing it with protection worthy of a Feca.

items.name: Feca Rhineetle
items.description: There seems to be so much gold on this harness that you could blind your enemies and then crush them under the weight of your superiority. Flying is probably out of the question, though.

items.name: Masqueraider Headgear
items.description: Wearing this mask, which was forged with the soul of a monster, you can defeat many a monster... Just take care not to become one.

items.name: Masqueraider Cape
items.description: The perfect finishing touch to any disguise is a cape. This one will add a considerable class to your mysterious style.

items.name: Masqueraider Shield
items.description: This shield is made of gold and feathers, which makes it solid and easy to wield. Plus, its sharp edges mean you can use it offensively as well as defensively if the need arises.

items.name: Masqueraider Dragoturkey
items.description: When style is more important than practicality, effectiveness tends to suffer. Is it better to be swift but lack elegance or slow and full of panache?

items.name: Masqueraider Seemyool
items.description: This masked Seemyool will let you melt into the decor so you can surprise enemies who haven't seen you coming.

items.name: Masqueraider Rhineetle
items.description: With its blood-drenched horn and feathers, this Rhineetle inspires only fear and curses.

items.name: Griffined Cape
items.description: When you asked what this cape had to do with magic, and they answered "SUIM", you concluded that they were clearly clueless: griffins can fly but aren't very fond of water. But deep down, you suspect they might not be the ones who are clueless.

items.name: Griffined Hood
items.description: This hood reminds you of the days when wearing a hood in class let you copy off your neighbours without the teacher seeing where you were really looking. The acronym "HDFLL" on the label has you completely stumped, however.

items.name: Griffined Shield
items.description: You figured that with a griffin on your arm, you'd outshine every falconer everywhere. But no, alas. If you'd bothered to look at the inscription inside the shield, you'd have seen "VBMR - Secondary Wheel". VBMR probably stands for "very best magnetic roundel" but you're still wondering what that could possibly have to do with flying beasts.

items.name: Griffined Boots
items.description: Since Bow Wows tend to whimper when you wear them like slippers, you've decided to cut off a griffon's paws and shove your feet into them. So much classier, and much less noisy when you walk.

items.name: Shariva Shield
items.description:
This shield – which is much better at decorating than protecting – shakes up preconceived notions, tilts truths, and makes legends tremble. It is also your way of proclaiming to the world: "Let Shariva laugh!"
The following inscription can also be read on the back: "Forged in the Maelstrom".

items.name: Newborn Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Infant Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Juvenile Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Immature Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Determined Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Courageous Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Astute Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Wise Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Glorious Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Champion Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Crowned Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Souverain Grifforis
items.description: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

items.name: Iopscot
items.description: True believers in their god's precepts, Iopscot pets are always quick to charge head first into close combat.

items.name: Sramscot
items.description: Follow this pet's advice and you, too, will become an expert in the art of outfoxing your opponents.

items.name: Roguscot
items.description: Thanks to this ingenious pet, you'll have the perfect alibi and be at the inn when the militia building explodes.

items.name: Osamscot
items.description: This pet's suckers, pointy tongue and long tail make this pet the perfect companion for masked parties in the depths of the Osamodas Temple.

items.name: Foggerscot
items.description: Foggernaut technology lets land creatures survive under water and lets aquatic creatures survive on dry land. This pet is living proof of that, even though the others ended their lives as toppings for seafood pizza.

items.name: Crascot
items.description: When you can't afford the luxury of being accompanied by seven Cras into battle, this miniature version is the next best thing. At the very least, it won't be turned away at the entrance to the Kolossium.

items.name: Coulive Headgear
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate hats.

items.name: Coulive Cloak
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Coulive Buckler
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.

items.name: Sadida Headgear
items.description: Since Masqueraiders have surpassed Sadidas when it comes to masks, those nature lovers have sought out other attributes to set themselves apart. With this headgear, you might say they've succeeded.

items.name: Sadida Cape
items.description: "Make do with what you have," or so says a wise Sadida tailor.

items.name: Sadida Shield
items.description: Sadidas have become masters in the art of plant sculptures, and this shield is decidedly one of their greatest creations.

items.name: Sadida Dragoturkey
items.description: When a group needs to overcome hardships, versatility is very important. If you are ever lost in the middle of the desert, your mount can fuel the fire on which you cook your companions' mounts and thus prevent you from starving to death.

items.name: Sadida Seemyool
items.description: If you're a fan of plant syrup, the road from producer to consumer has never been shorter.

items.name: Sadida Rhineetle
items.description: You no longer need to head into the forest to gather the leaves for your afternoon herbal tea. You just need to stretch out your hand.

items.name: Aqua Codex
items.description: This codex contains useful formulas such as how to transform shower water into bathwater. This explains why apprentice sorcerers prefer to use it as a mount.

items.name: Terra Codex
items.description: After realising that the formulas contained in this spellbook provided for better burial of the dead without the need for a shovel, the necromancer Sadrax cursed it and turned it into a mount for Chafers.

items.name: Aeris Codex
items.description: When you hop aboard this flying book, you can visit the clouds and crash miserably down on the bottom of a valley after a poorly executed aerial loop.

items.name: Ignis Codex
items.description: This treatise contains all of grandmama's secret formulas to systematically overcook everything. It ran away when she tried to make it taste her newest recipe – flambéed Chafer's pie.

items.name: Magicae Codex
items.description: Despite its many years of perfect service, this spellbook was abandoned along the side of the road by Larry Poller when he went to pick up the latest model nim bus.

items.name: Shushum Codex
items.description: This spellbook is possessed by a Shushu who was sentenced for having encouraged adventurers to listen to the complaints of other Twelvians rather than letting those same adventurers merely nod without listening and then complain they don't understand the mission they had just accepted.

items.name: Bronze Escuktaeon
items.description: This coat of arms is a reward for young fighters who show great promise. So you see, fighting in the mud and biting your opponent's foot or pulling his ear was worth it.

items.name: Silver Escuktaeon
items.description: This coat of arms rewards the spectacular feats of the best fighters from among the ordinary rank and file. This gives them a place of pride in all the inns in the World of Twelve.

items.name: Gold Escuktaeon
items.description: This coat of arms rewards the most tenacious veterans and superb tacticians. The lowest of low blows and most dazzling acts have no secrets for them.

items.name: Donfus
items.description: This pet is cute enough to bite, both literally and figuratively. And that's not all! Its cuteness is made even better by its practicality thanks to the hole in its back where you can insert anything and everything – especially anything – safely.

items.name: Gladiabone
items.description: Condemned to fight for all eternity in the arenas of the Krosmoz, this skeleton of a warrior has found a way to escape its fate by sticking to you like glue.

items.name: Rokwa Headband
items.description: This headband shows that your master believes you've mastered the path of the fist and that your apprenticeship as a Pandawushuka has only just begun.

items.name: Gokwa Headband
items.description: This headband shows that your master believes you've mastered the path of the staff. You can now keep an arm's length away from your opponents and still whack them soundly.

items.name: Yonkwa Headband
items.description: This headband shows that your master believes you've mastered the path of the sabre. You are now one of the finest blades among the Pandawushuka.

items.name: Sankwa Headband
items.description: This headband shows that your master believes you've mastered the path of the shield. You are now as solid as rock and as elusive as the wind.

items.name: Nikwa Headband
items.description: This headband shows that your master believes you've mastered the path of the five claws. Pandawan elements have no secrets for you!

items.name: Ikwa Headband
items.description: This headband shows that your master believes you've mastered the path of the drunken warrior. It also proves that you are now a widely respected Pandawushuka.

items.name: Sacrier Headgear
items.description: This headgear is all the rage among Enutrofs in the middle of that awkward adolescent phase, which often includes sudden hair loss. Sacriers would have gladly done without this kind of publicity.

items.name: Sacrier Cape
items.description: Created from the instruments of torture used on a Sacrier, this cape is soaked in the blood from their injuries. The Crobak whose wings were ripped off to adorn this cape in the honour of the goddess was mistreated in proper form and then released back into nature.

items.name: Sacrier Shield
items.description: Too heavy to be worn around the neck, this necklace is worn on the forearm like a shield. It doesn't protect the wearer one bit, but that doesn't seem to bother Sacriers in the slightest.

items.name: Sacrier Dragoturkey
items.description: The Dragoturkey had no idea it was destined to suffer and – dumb as it is – probably still hasn't figured it out.

items.name: Sacrier Seemyool
items.description: It takes intense training to make Seemyools more threatening than ridiculous. This is why Sacriers have adopted this harness – it ensures immediate results.

items.name: Sacrier Rhineetle
items.description: Equipped with pieces of metal bathed in blood that came directly from the Sacrier Temple butcher's shop, your Rhineetle will be perfectly fitted out for both the battlefield and Al Howin costume parties.

items.name: Ashy Shoulder Pads
items.description: Made from the ashes of your enemies and recycled metal, these shoulder pads will make you both ferocious and environmentally friendly.

items.name: Scarlet Spaulders
items.description: They are blushingly beautiful on anyone whose emotions are close to the surface, or anyone with a compulsive addiction or fragile skin.

items.name: Shoulder Claws
items.description: It's said that the creator of these spaulders got the idea of adding the huge spikes after falling for the old tap-on-the-shoulder prank for the fiftieth time.

items.name: Bony Aegis
items.description: You're certainly not skin and bones, but with these, you'll have bones on your skin.

items.name: Epwowlettes
items.description: You'll have trouble getting into an alliance with these on your shoulders.

items.name: Warrior's Burden
items.description: It's good to be the ki...er... greatest of warriors. You get to ignore everything your enemies say, stroll leisurely across the battlefield, and storm castles.

items.name: Xelor Headgear
items.description: This helmet tends to reflect the immense void often found in the hearts – and sometimes heads – of those who wear it.

items.name: Xelor Cape
items.description: Fashion trends come and go but if you can control time, you can ensure that it never goes out of fashion.

items.name: Xelor Shield
items.description: There's nothing like a bit of solidity when you tend to lug your destiny around like a beloved weight.

items.name: Xelor Dragoturkey
items.description: This mechanical Dragoturkey is so well oiled that you need to be careful not to slip when mounting it.

items.name: Xelor Seemyool
items.description: This Seemyool's anti-rust guarantee is its main selling point – and you should expect nothing less from this type of machine.

items.name: Xelor Rhineetle
items.description: Over time, the finest Xelors have endeavoured to perfect their creations. This Rhineetle is ample proof of that.

items.name: Pandawushuka Apprentice Headband
items.description: This headband marks the first step towards becoming a Pandawushuka. Patience and self-control are the qualities needed for the long apprenticeship before you.

items.name: Weebamboo
items.description: Don't be fooled by its nonchalant air: the Weebamboo is a fearsome fighter and always eager to give you a hand in a scrape.

items.name: Bamboockler
items.description: Make sure you keep this shield with you for the day you no longer feel like holding out an olive branch to everyone you meet. It is very easy to wield, which will help with your defence.

items.name: Bamboo Flask
items.description: Cloaks are annoying – always getting underfoot and tripping you up. A flask full of bamboo milk, however, always comes in handy.

items.name: Bamboo Dora
items.description: There are doras of all sorts out there, but it seems that the bamboo this one was made out of has taken over and is still growing.

items.name: Gladius Seemulus
items.description: The alloys used in this harness are designed to be water-resistant. It's incredibly heavy, though, so be careful that you don't wind up stuck to the sea floor like some ancient shipwreck.

items.name: Gladius Headgearicus
items.description:
Inside the helmet is a brief inscription engraved into the metal: 
"Victoriae mundis et mundis lacrima." This doesn't actually mean anything, but it does sound pretty amazing.

items.name: Gladius Capus
items.description: Don't try to act all high and mighty. Everyone knows not to judge a general by their cape.

items.name: Gladius Shieldius
items.description: They say that the artisan who designed this shield mistakenly left his blade inside when he put the two halves together. After realising his mistake, he ultimately decided to leave it that way.

items.name: Pandawa Headgear
items.description: This headgear was inspired by the Lotus flowers that grow on Pandala Island. You can only imagine its scent, however, since sniffing the hair of strangers is usually frowned upon.

items.name: Pandawa Cape
items.description: If you don't like going unnoticed, here's a cape that should delight you. As imposing as it is elegant, it symbolises several noble Pandawan dynasties.

items.name: Pandawa Shield
items.description: This umbrella may seem flimsy but it's surprisingly sturdy. It can protect you from the sun, will come in handy in the rain, and could even become a means of locomotion on very windy days.

items.name: Pandawa Dragoturkey
items.description: For connoisseurs, the lotus is the symbol of speed and performance, and this Dragoturkey is no exception.

items.name: Pandawa Seemyool
items.description: Able to go against the strongest currents, or swim with them to reach very high speeds, this mount will let you sail with the winds on a glassy sea.

items.name: Pandawa Rhineetle
items.description: Even if you've mastered all the elements, you typically dominate the situation in the air. The freedom this mount procures is almost limitless... Well, except for dry land... Accidents happen so quickly, you know.

items.name: Sacriscot
items.description: Your companions are always the first to make you suffer, especially in situations you'd rather have avoided, such as listening to them snore loud enough to wake the dead at night. This sword, however, will only make you bleed the strict minimum. Just enough so you can show off your scars at the Astrub Zaap. Maybe a little bit more. If you're lucky.

items.name: Sadidascot
items.description: Just like Gobballs are a dinner's best friend, dolls are a Sadida's best friend. Day or night, rain or shine, hugs are always welcome.

items.name: Xeloscot
items.description: Since he can't turn back time, he loves wasting yours by making you turn back the clock over and over again.

items.name: Pandascot
items.description: This little Pandawa stays afloat by releasing a constant stream of natural gas. That way, it can avoid obstacles and easily join you when it's time to wet your whistle.

items.name: Masquerscot
items.description: Inspired by the infamous Sadida dolls, Masquerscots look more like sad clowns than world-class fighters. Unfortunately for you, sometimes you can indeed judge a book by its cover.

items.name: Fecascot
items.description: Many an Amaknian has heard tell of the tofoone that laid the golden eggs, but no one has ever seen it or its eggs. Gobtubbys with golden horns, on the other hand, are very real – and you've got one right here to prove it.

items.name: Elely Mask
items.description: This terrifying mask portrays the potential hostility of an angry Iop – better not mess with those horns.

items.name: Elely Shoulder Pads
items.description: When you spend your life slinging punches, it's vital to protect your shoulders, or later on you'll have to use your head.

items.name: Elely Glove
items.description: This glove amplifies the wearer's energy, supposedly endowing each blow with the force of a Rhinoblasty.

items.name: Flopin Mask
items.description: This vision-enhancing visor makes the wearer extremely precise – so precise that they'll always hit their target.

items.name: Samuralive Shield
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.

items.name: Samuralive Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Flopin Shoulder Pads
items.description: While they seem to hinder movement, these shoulder pads are in fact light and sturdy, making them an undeniable plus in combat.

items.name: Flopin Cannon
items.description: Who's never dreamed of having a cannon for a forearm? Today, that dream came true. Just be careful scratching your nose.

items.name: Samuralive Helmet
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.

items.name: Falcodove
items.description: Niceties schmiceties, your flying mount with its talons travels on foot because that's what it likes. Other adventurers can laugh if they like, but you'll be the classy one on its feathered back.

items.name: Yugo the Eliatrope Cape
items.description:
Finally, a cape worthy of your power and style. Will it bring you glory or put an end to your adventure? Only time will tell.

(Place these shoulder pads over an already-equipped cape to change their appearance.)

items.name: Yugo the Eliatrope Mask
items.description: There's no better way to face your destiny than wearing a mask. Plus, your ears won't get cold! Or your horns. No judgement here.

items.name: Pandawarai
items.description: Small in sword but big in bravery, this young Pandawarai will protect you from the fiercest dangers.

items.name: WKS-S4 Steed
items.description: Riding the WKS-S4 combat steed is like travelling to the ultimate battle. Forgetting time and living in the moment. Fighting to understand a world without really understanding the world you're fighting for.

items.name: Itztield
items.description: In this festive season, there's nothing like an afternoon of crafting after a morning in a Kwismas dungeon. What a surprising combination of branches and balls – you've really outdone yourself this time!

items.name: Pitcheater
items.description: Have you always dreamed of cleaning up your vegetable patch while fighting? With this fabulous heater shield combined with the working end of a pitchfork, your dream can now come true. Poke your opponents and protect your pumpkins with style!

items.name: Autonobarrel
items.description: Rather than carrying their barrels on their backs, lazy Pandawas prefer barrels that can move around on their own.

items.name: Prickle
items.description: Since blood baths don't really make the hearts of Twelvians flutter, well-prepared Sacriers never leave home without their Prickle. That way, their blood baths last longer.

items.name: Espadeath
items.description: It may look quite like a luxury Trool toothpick, but don't be fooled: this bony sword won't fail to bring your enemies that bit closer to their final hour in the World of Twelve.

items.name: Capel Picado
items.description: "The delicate, complex folds of this cape are a reminder of the precariousness of existence and the fragility of the material form that binds us to this world." – Van Itas

items.name: Mascatrina
items.description: Just because you look like death, it doesn't mean you can't be stylish.

items.name: Rosarmadura
items.description: This shield can be used in one of two ways: to defend the most skilled fighters from death, or to decorate their tombs if they don't manage to use it correctly.

items.name: Fen Ecalavera
items.description: This small fennec fox is particularly fond of napping in and around tombs, especially ones that are lavishly decorated.

items.name: Virizeon
items.description: The elders say that once you come back to life, you're never really the same again. It would seem that the darkest aspects remain, while all the good dissipates, leaving only a sad husk lacking that once-defining spark. No one knows why the Virizeon comes back to life, but everyone agrees that he attaches himself to very unsavoury beings afterwards.

items.name: Ecaflip Headgear
items.description: "If I were a king, I'd be wary of aces," said someone who also wore these glasses.

items.name: Ecaflip Cape
items.description: This cape does not stand up well to contact with water, therefore the only way to clean it is to lick it all over often, like any worthy follower of Ecaflip would do.

items.name: Ecaflip Shield
items.description: In addition to its impeccable attention to detail, this shield has many pockets to protect your favourite cards from the hazards of life.

items.name: Ecaflip Dragoturkey
items.description: As any Bow Meow lover can guess, equipping this harness means being tormented by an astronomical quantity of tiny hairs covering your entire wardrobe.

items.name: Ecaflip Seemyool
items.description: With this harness, your Bow Meow will be as happy as a Seemyool in water... Err, no. Your Seemyool will be as happy as a Bow Meow in water... Err, not that either. Your Seemyool will just be a Bow Meow. That's something at least.

items.name: Ecaflip Rhineetle
items.description: Contrary to popular belief, a rhinemeow isn't the Rhineetle's mating call (which, unfortunately, words cannot properly reproduce), but rather a protective shell with a Bow Meow hiding under it. Please don't ask us to write out the Rhineetle mating call. Trust us, it's better this way.

items.name: Monkiki'ng Shoulder Pads
items.description: All the trees in the Monkiki'ng's domain bear traces of these shoulder pads. Of course they do. When you swing from branch to branch, you tend to bump into things. Now that you're the one wearing them, it's more likely that those same marks will end up on your opponents' faces...

items.name: Vixie Shoulder Pads
items.description: No matter how important the fight, winning only matters if the winner comes out alive. These shoulder pads – symbols of a great battle – remind you every day that you've overcome much to get as far as you have.

items.name: Shoulder Ivy
items.description: These climbing shoulder pads require regular pruning if you don't want to end up strangled.

items.name: Nightmare Spikes
items.description: With shoulder pads of this calibre, no one will ever dare come near you. After all, if they did, they'd be only an unexpected sneeze away from being impaled.

items.name: Little Moushu Shoulder Pads
items.description: All the precious metals adorning these shoulder pads makes them very heavy and you'll probably have a sore neck, back and arms at the end of your day's adventures. But prestige is priceless. A few sore muscles won't stop you from looking classy, now, will they?

items.name: Corsair Shoulder Pads
items.description: These detachable shoulder pads have been reinforced. Yes, indeed, they have. You can even attach them to a telescoping pole to have your own makeshift shovel if you ever stumble across buried treasure.

items.name: Moonotaur
items.description: Used to living in twisting labyrinths and other natural or artificial mazes, the Moonotaur has a real knack for guiding you straight to the closest dead end. But you love this little horned critter all the same.

items.name: Kwismas 650 Treetop
items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.

items.name: Pandauge
items.description: Shiny fur, head high, an impeccable strut, lively sparkling eyes – there's no doubt about it: the Pandauge is one proud creature. But make no mistake, all that comes at a price: 3 fermented mimilk baths every week, 2 large glasses of vodkawa morning and night, and 4 to 6 hours of naps every day. The rest of the time, it keeps dehydration at bay with Pandapils – approximately 5 bowls a day.

items.name: Master Tor Toise's Shell
items.description: Weighing at least 20 kilo-pods, this shell is used for muscle strengthening during Master Tor Toise's training sessions.

items.name: Folded Headgear
items.description: This practical folding headgear is lightweight and always seems to be dripping. Take care not to let others track you.

items.name: Folded Cape
items.description: Meticulously folded according to traditional origami techniques, this cape has also been decorated with a non-staining ink.

items.name: Folded Shield
items.description: We all know that paper can cause horrific flesh wounds, but it also becomes ultra-strong if folded the right way. This shield is a great example. It is structurally perfect having been made from paper folded 12 times, which is probably a record.

items.name: Blitzem
items.description: Blitzem is the ideal pet for all those who sorely need a flash of brilliance at every level.

items.name: Unikron
items.description: This Unikron will shower glitter on you wherever you are and whatever you do, which means you'll find it in your pockets, safe, haven bag, socks, hair, food and just about everywhere else.

items.name: Bakenaki
items.description: This pet is the perfect balance between the forces of Wukin and Wukang.

items.name: Hairy Shoulder Pads
items.description: If the idea of rubbing shoulders this closely with a hairy Harry doesn't tickle your fancy, you can always use a bit of gel on these shoulder pads and give them a slick hairdo. But that kind of defeats the purpose...

items.name: Ekirin
items.description: They say that only a great adventurer can ride the proud Ekirin. If you feel up to it, try your luck and prove your worth.

items.name: Zhenbaisu
items.description: The first person to ever get this pet was the captain of a prestigious ship. Ironically, he was also a fastidious control freak who insisted his crew hoist their trousers way up above their waists before hoisting anchor.

items.name: Wa Odanowth's Sword
items.description: According to the Association of Thwee Kings Cake Tasters Keen on Tempting Confectionery (ATKCTKC), using an ordinary knife to cut your cake is absolutely positively unthinkable. Only this sword is worthy enough to cut the royal dessert.

items.name: Ouginak Headband
items.description: Don't count on this headband keeping you dry when it's raining cats and dogs.

items.name: Ouginak Tippet
items.description:
"It's a fang!... It's a spike!... It's a cloak!

A cloak? What am I saying? It's a tippet!"

items.name: Ouginak Shield
items.description: That long-awaited day has finally come! Shields now have ears.

items.name: Ouginak Dragoturkey
items.description: The expression "grab the Dragoturkey by the horns" finally makes sense.

items.name: Ouginak Seemyool
items.description: This Seemyool will frolic in the waves if you take it for a walk on the beach. It'll stink of wet Bow Wow afterwards, though. Don't say we didn't warn you.

items.name: Ouginak Rhineetle
items.description: Now there's a mount all done up like a dog's dinner!

items.name: Haurnes
items.description: These metal horns provide effective protection to the back of your head. As an added bonus, they make a great weapon if you can run incredibly fast backwards.

items.name: Cape Haurne
items.description: The unique thing about this cape is that it's made entirely of very solid metal plates welded together. It provides considerable protection. The only downside is the clanking noise it makes with every step you take.

items.name: Ollyoxen Shield
items.description: Forged from a thick sheet of metal, this shield is excellent for convincing the hardest heads in the World of Twelve to leave you alone.

items.name: Carnavalo Bauta
items.description: Go totally incognito at the most prestigious celebrations in the World of Twelve with this mask. Perfect for getting up to trouble without getting in trouble.

items.name: Carnavalo Tabarro
items.description: Unfortunately, the feathers on this cape do not automatically open like a fan to cover your blunders on romantic outings.

items.name: Carnavalo Scudo
items.description: The delicate feathers on this shield are extremely fine, just perfect for tickling your enemies' weapons. Not for the faint-hearted.

items.name: Carnavalo Spalla
items.description: These superb shoulder pads edged with metal will naturally lift your shoulders and give you an allure that no one would call haughty.

items.name: Dustoro
items.description: This adorable ball of feathers is a very rare species of bird renowned for its ability to do cartwheels. This particular bird, however, cannot do cartwheels and so it's been ostracised by its peers. It just goes to show that a lack of gymnastics skills can have very sorry consequences.

items.name: Vortishield
items.description: This shield represents the great spiral of time. What makes it especially interesting, though, is that if its owner can spin it quickly enough, they can hypnotise their opponents.

items.name: Eniripsa Tiara
items.description: This tiara hovers gracefully a few centikametres over your head thanks to its tiny, rapidly-fluttering wings. Be very careful around Arachnees and Toads. They could easily (and often do) mistake this tiara for a huge, juicy moskito.

items.name: Eniripsa Cloak
items.description: This cape is so stain-resistant that it can easily pull double duty as a sheet in an operating room or a survival blanket. Come to think of it, it could also come in handy for transporting ham and other picnic fixings.

items.name: Eniripsa Shield
items.description: The heart in the centre of this shield glows softly when it's close to a person in need of healing. It's very useful in determining if your child has the lurgi or a huge test they didn't study for.

items.name: Eniripsa Wings
items.description: An Eniripsa without wings is a bit like a Lenald without "Ls".

items.name: Eniripsa Dragoturkey
items.description: Saying that dragoturkeys are stupid creatures is like insulting an ambulance.

items.name: Eniripsa Seemyool
items.description: In an emergency, the heart on this harness will flash blue and red to catch the attention of passers-by, who will of course step aside to let you by. Or not.

items.name: Eniripsa Rhineetle
items.description: You should know that rhineetles often have neck problems because of their massive heads. The small wings on this harness are there specifically to help them keep their heads up without tiring out.

items.name: Glorious Headgear
items.description: This headgear is perfect for anyone looking to artificially boost their glory.

items.name: Glorious Polykrome Headgear
items.description: This headgear is perfect for anyone looking to artificially boost their glory.

items.name: Glorious Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Glorious Polykrome Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Glorious Shield
items.description: The inside of this shield is engraved with: "Wearing this shield will bring you brilliant, universal, lasting fame."

items.name: Glorious Polykrome Shield
items.description: The inside of this shield is engraved with: "Wearing this shield will bring you brilliant, universal, lasting fame."

items.name: Meowfiamulet
items.description: This amulet is a sign that the Meowfia consider you to be one of their own. For you, art and money are two sides of the same coin. Keep it safe and keep a low profile: it might just lead you to the Golden Kitty-Neko.

items.name: Woofiamulet
items.description: With this amulet around your neck, you can proudly show that you are part of the Woofia. You've proven yourself worthy of joining the pack, so now it's time to live up to their expectations.

items.name: Chocolate Pwakring
items.description: This ring seems to embody the festive spirit of Pwak perfectly – just looking at it is enough to make you want to devour sweets.

items.name: Chocolate Wabbiring
items.description: While it won't make you jump any higher, this ring will make your blood sugar take a flying leap.

items.name: Chocolegg Ring
items.description: You might not have a Bwak that lays golden eggs, but this ring will turn you into a Twelvian capable of laying chocolate eggs!

items.name: Dofolat Ring
items.description: A travelling merchant told you that this ring contains the power of the six Dofus... He very carefully forgot to mention that it's made of chocolate, though. What did you expect?

items.name: Mira
items.description: Don't be fooled by her sweet looks: Mira can be a vile creature whom you either love or hate. If you're not to her liking, watch out – she'll make sure you remember it.

items.name: Catmeleon Mira
items.description: Don't be fooled by her sweet looks: Mira can be a vile creature whom you either love or hate. If you're not to her liking, watch out – she'll make sure you remember it.

items.name: Louz
items.description: Louz likes to pick fights, so if you take your eyes off him, he'll be off looking for trouble in no time. This tendency towards violence might be useful if Louz weren't as tiny as a catoken from the casino.

items.name: High Roller Headgear
items.description: Any extended visit to the streets and alleys of Ecaflip City will make money go to your head, quite literally.

items.name: High Roller Cape
items.description: This cape used to belong to the famous owner of three of the largest casinos in Ecaflip City, Ben Eddict – that is until Donny O'Sean and his 11 co-conspirators stole it from him. In passing, they also stole half his fortune. And his wife. O'Sean clearly doesn't like leaving anything to chance – or leaving anything behind, apparently.

items.name: High Roller Shield
items.description: This shield may seem like just a token souvenir, but it's also perfect for carrying all your tokens on a platter.

items.name: High Roller Paws
items.description: We bet you can't wait to get your paws on these.

items.name: Catmeleon Louz
items.description: Louz likes to pick fights, so if you take your eyes off him, he'll be off looking for trouble in no time. This tendency towards violence might be useful if Louz weren't as tiny as a catoken from the casino.

items.name: Malo
items.description: Malo is brave and independent. Even though he likes to be left alone, he's always ready to come to the rescue. No matter what stands in his way, he'll always overcome it and emerge victorious. And when it comes to casinos, he often walks away with the big prize.

items.name: Catmeleon Malo
items.description: Malo is brave and independent. Even though he likes to be left alone, he's always ready to come to the rescue. No matter what stands in his way, he'll always overcome it and emerge victorious. And when it comes to casinos, he often walks away with the big prize.

items.name: Desse
items.description: Desse has got a pedigree that's the envy of every alley cat in Ecaflip City! With her elegance and class, she's welcomed like a queen at all the top-notch establishments, and those who are with her can barely believe their good luck.

items.name: Skratiay Clan Diadem
items.description: Skratiay is synonymous with wickedness, bravery and pride, but the clan is actually best known for its acorns.

items.name: Skratiay Clan Escutcheon
items.description: The Skratiay motto is "When a wise man points at the acorn, the imbecile looks at the finger". Sounds like a warning... What's more, their emblem depicts a giant cromagmunk.

items.name: Skratiay Clan Coat
items.description:
The Skratiay clan, a clan from Frigost that has since vanished, was founded by the great Brandon Skratiay. By tricking Master Cromagmunk, who was once Lord of the Lonesome Pine Trails, he earned the recognition of the island's people and animals. The story of their encounter goes:  

"Master Cromagmunk, perched on a tree one day,
With his tail an acorn squeezed.
Master Skratiay, by the odour drawn that way,
Spoke to him in words like these:
Good morning, Master Cromagmunk.
How well you look, high up that trunk!
Upon my honour, if beauty is not remote
To the remainder of your coat,
You are the Lord of the dwellers in these woods.
At these words, the Cromagmunk did wail,
And to display his beauteous tail,
He unfurled it and let fall his stolen goods.
Skratiay seized them and said: My dear good sir,
Learn that every flatterer
Lives at the expense of those who hear him out.
This lesson is well worth an acorn, no doubt.
Cromagmunk, ashamed and much in pain,
Swore, a little late, they'd not catch him again."

items.name: Catmeleon Desse
items.description: Desse has got a pedigree that's the envy of every alley cat in Ecaflip City! With her elegance and class, she's welcomed like a queen at all the top-notch establishments, and those who are with her can barely believe their good luck.

items.name: Berlo
items.description: Berlo is the king of games of chance. He's seen it all, done it all, and reached the top of the great pyramid of players. If he challenges you, you'd better run, because your chances of beating him are really, really slim. Although that does mean that your victory would taste all the sweeter...

items.name: Catmeleon Berlo
items.description: Berlo is the king of games of chance. He's seen it all, done it all, and reached the top of the great pyramid of players. If he challenges you, you'd better run, because your chances of beating him are really, really slim. Although that does mean that your victory would taste all the sweeter...

items.name: Red Headdice
items.description: If you spend too much time rolling your die just anywhere, your head might start to itch. After all, you never know what pesky little passengers will hitch a ride on a die if given a chance. I suppose you could avoid wearing a die on your head, but what fun is that?
