items.name: Mawashield
items.description: Both decadent and crunchy at the same time, this shield prototype straight out of the Waddict Foundry is surprisingly resistant... Probably because of the absolute purity of the cocoa used in its fabrication. We hope. We advise against using it to parry the fiery breath of a dragon, though. Even pure cocoa has its limits!

items.name: Bluffer's Visor
items.description: To bluff convincingly, you have to seem transparent. With this visor, everyone can see your eyes. That way, they'll think you can be trusted – up until the moment you betray them without batting an eye.

items.name: Bluffer's Cape
items.description: This cape glows whenever the person wearing it is having a run of good luck. Don't expect to see it light up very often.

items.name: Bluffer's Shield
items.description: This shield is perfect for fighters (or lovers, or both). Carry it and hearts will be all aflutter. Your opponents will be distracted by dreams of diamonds and rings. With a bit of luck, that'll give you time to whack them with a few clubs. Then you can walk away victorious, as cocky as the king of spades.

items.name: Bluffer Shoulder Pads
items.description: Good bluffers know when to show off, and if that means convincing everyone that shoulder pads are lavish finery, so be it.

items.name: Panache Cape
items.description: Is this cape made of dragon scales or crobak feathers? Let those who are curious come closer to find out. That way, they can also bask in your immeasurable charisma.

items.name: Panache Shield
items.description: This eminently stylish jet black shield gives you incomparable charisma. As a bonus, this perfect shine lets you admire your own reflection whenever you want.

items.name: Aqueous Panache Headgear
items.description: This headgear will easily remind your opponents to beware of silent waters as they run deep.

items.name: Fiery Panache Headgear
items.description: When you wear this headgear, you'll shine down on the World of Twelve like a mini-sun!

items.name: Botanic Panache Headgear
items.description: This headgear is a reminder to other adventurers that you too are constantly evolving, like a sapling in spring.

items.name: Volatile Panache Headgear
items.description: As light and fluffy as a cloud, this headgear gives its wearer an almost ethereal charisma.

items.name: Cannylynx
items.description: If you're a bit dim, you choose a pingwin. If you're rather canny, you go for a cannylynx.

items.name: Huppermage Headgear
items.description: How can you maintain the Krosmic balance if you can't even balance your wardrobe? With this headgear, you'll be off to a good start.

items.name: Huppermage Shield
items.description: The prism in the centre of this shield not only deflects attacks, but light as well. The resulting diffraction will blind your enemies, giving you a considerable advantage.

items.name: Huppermage Cape
items.description: The essence of the combined elements that was used to reinforce this cape makes it extraordinarily tough. Not only that, its immaculate white fabric never seems to get dirty, which is pretty special in its own right.

items.name: Huppermage Dragoturkey
items.description: If you're feeling like a fish out of water, the Huppermage dragoturkey will help get you back in your element. It may seem like a bit of an airhead, but it's actually very down-to-earth, with an appealingly fiery attitude.

items.name: Huppermage Seemyool
items.description: This seemyool is a real deep-sea treasure, as glorious as any ancient shipwreck. It's also a great way to make some waves as you speed off on your next adventure, leaving the snappers paddling feebly in your wake.

items.name: Huppermage Rhineetle
items.description: If this rhineetle has one flaw, it's that you may have to worry about someone stealing it from you. Covered in gold and other decorations, it's bound to make some of the dimmer Iops a bit jealous. But that's just the price of being so high-class.

items.name: Porcigami
items.description:
A Pandalan legend has it that pigs attract mooflies, nuisance and trouble. It doesn't seem to bother them. By adopting such creatures, Pandawas have lived calmer lives, with any annoyances stuck to the backsides of their pets. Who'd have thought it? That's why Porcigami are so popular. They are great for avoiding trouble and capturing misfortune, thus bringing you happiness.
Folded from particularly absorbent paper that keeps it clean, this faithful friend could also be of great help if you find yourself helpless in a shed at the end of the garden.

items.name: Rocksteady Shield
items.description: Besides offering solid protection, this shield can also play short melodies as you deflect your enemies' attacks.

items.name: Close Hornbat
items.description: If you're feeling out of tune with your warrior instincts, try playing a few chords with this shield to bring every attack and parry into perfect harmony.

items.name: Sacaram Ring
items.description: This ring makes a pleasant little sound when you shake it, as though it were filled with tiny seeds.

items.name: Swing Band
items.description: For some reason, wearing this ring puts you in the mood to sing, sing, sing. Could it give you the confidence you need to win the top prize at the next Gobbstock Festival?

items.name: Yappeleon
items.description: This very yappy little bow wow is very devoted to his master. Excessively so, even: his fur changes colour to always be a perfect match for his master.

items.name: Catseye Shield
items.description: Get the upper hand on your opponents while they're stuck in a staring match with this shield whose pupils are as worrying as its smile.

items.name: Chaotic Headgear
items.description:
"When you're searching for authenticity, you realise that chaos is here, inside each of us, and you'll have to get used to that."

– Rick Manalan

items.name: Chaotic Cape
items.description: If you like total chaos and relaxing, you can use this cape spread on the wet grass like a blanket and enjoy a picnic that is both peaceful and tormented.

items.name: Chaotic Shield
items.description: Apparently, this shapeless blob is supposedly a shield. Clearly, artificers have taken the avant-garde a wee bit too far when trying to make a name for themselves.

items.name: Chaotic Koalak
items.description: Yes, he'll follow you as closely as your shadow. Yes, he'll obey without question. Still, this Koalak's looks and penchant for violence leave plenty of room for doubt when it comes to its alignment: lawful evil or chaotic good?

items.name: Enutrof Shield
items.description: It's said that the god Enutrof hid a priceless precious stone in the compartment on this shield but then lost the key that would let him open the lock. You'll just have to find it, or drive up the price of this shield by spreading the legend.

items.name: Enutrof Cape
items.description: Don't be fooled by the wings on this cape – they are purely decorative. I'm sorry to say that your dreams of flying high on wings of steel have come crashing down like a lead balloon even though lead is only one of the many metals that went into the composition of this cape.

items.name: Enutrof Helm
items.description: This sparkly helm in Enutrof's likeness has left you in a state of horrible uncertainty – is he a god? Or a dragon? Or maybe both? But in that case, is he a draconic god or a divine dragon? Does he really whisper in pebbles' ears? Can pebbles talk? So many questions that remind you that knowledge is a treasure that even the most sumptuous headgear cannot bestow.

items.name: Enutrof Rhineetle
items.description: The ring on the jaw of this rhineetle lets you tie it to the ground easily with a bit of rope, preventing it from flying away in search of someone else's fortune.

items.name: Enutrof Seemyool
items.description: As my great uncle Enutrof used to say, you should always be wary of a seemyool wearing golden armour... or bearing golden armour... or... oh, never mind.

items.name: Enutrof Dragoturkey
items.description: The Enutrof dragoturkey has the reputation of being a nasty piece of work most of the time, and turning docile when you give it a handful of kamas to nibble on.

items.name: Amphitrident Diadem
items.description: This diadem is a replica of one owned by the legendary Tritun, Lanceglb du Blac, presumed champion of Queen Gwenheavyfart.

items.name: Amphitrident Cloak
items.description: A cape would be more of a bother than it's worth in the water. That's why Tritun guards usually only wear a simple trident to show off their sense of style.

items.name: Amphitrident Conchield
items.description: According to adepts, when you smash the skulls of your opponents with this conchield, you can hear the sea.

items.name: Pirate Tricorn
items.description: No pirate has ever managed to touch this magnificent three-cornered hat during a sword fight thanks to its wearers' agility and flexibility. If, however, it were ever to receive even the tiniest scratch (heaven forbid!), the wearer will be cursed to the end of their days and no longer worthy of wearing it.

items.name: Pirate Coat
items.description: This Pirate Coat, nicknamed the "Thousand Battle Trophy", symbolises the astounding feat of having triumphed in at least that many sea battles. Best to think twice before attacking a pirate of such renown! Rumour has it that wearing this coat before accomplishing that feat will make you horrifically seasick... Sailors, take heed!

items.name: Pirate Shield
items.description: Is it a shield? Or a sheath? Or both at once? This splendid and versatile Pirate Shield lets you block your opponents' most fearsome blows and store your sharpest weapons.

items.name: Hikups
items.description: They say that a bow wow is a Twelvian's best friend... But for pirates, there's nothing like heading out to sea with a faithful, feathered parrot. And this parrot always gets the hiccups right before a storm. Which is why sailors often say, "Put away your cups if you hear Hikups."

items.name: Fiery Panache Shield
items.description: This shield will make your days – but not your opponents' days – absolutely lit!

items.name: Aqueous Panache Shield
items.description: Carrying this shield might make you drip with sweat. Will that get your dander up or will you be too happy to be blocking your opponents' attacks to mind?

items.name: Botanic Panache Shield
items.description: This shield will give you botanic powers. (Yes, botanic, not bionic. Sorry, not sorry.)

items.name: Volatile Panache Shield
items.description: Rumour has it that the feathers that fly off this shield do a good job making it harder for your opponents' to see your movements.

items.name: Neutro
items.description: Imagine yourself alone in the dark. Suddenly, you see two threatening white lights. Can you feel the shiver running up your spine, the sweat pearling on your forehead, and your knees knocking together? With this pet by your side, that's exactly what your opponents will feel.

items.name: Amphermit Crab
items.description: Awww, just look at its itty bitty cuteness! Oops. Not so fast. You're going to have to coax it out of its shell if you want to see it with your own eyes. This Amphermit crab stays in its shell and only comes out if its master sings its favourite song from a movie that takes place "under the sea". Start singing!

items.name: Jahash's Cape
items.description: Never confuse his cape and his cloak... Jahash keeps these two items straight by the wings on the cloak. He used the cloak for battle because it shows the path of justice that leads to peace. The cape is used outside of battle to differentiate between the two.

items.name: Jahash's Aegis
items.description: Originally, only the Guardian of the Ivory Dofus could carry this Aegis designed by Julith, wife of Jahash. Will you prove yourself worthy of this noble heritage?

items.name: Jahash's Winged Headband
items.description: This headband is an elegant and practical way to keep your grizzled mane out of your eyes.

items.name: Red Dragoone
items.description: They say that this Dragoone got tired of being compared to the pink buttocks of a female Bwork and wanted to set herself apart from her peers. So she headed to Ohwymi to soak up some serious rays. Just look at her now! She's taken on the colour of a real flaming dragon!

items.name: Nagate's Aqueous Targe
items.description: This shield can absorb any of your opponents' blows thanks to its aqueous consistency drawn directly from Nagate's magic water.

items.name: Horneteddy
items.description: Adorable and endearing, the Horneteddy packs a bit of a sting as a pet. He loves being petted but does have a wee issue with sudden mood swings and you can easily end up with a stinger stuck in your palm.

items.name: Ankanniversary Hat
items.description: This festive hat reminds you of a very odd dream you had two years ago. See there: you do have a good memory when you put your mind to it!

items.name: Candleblaster
items.description: Legend has it that this Candleblaster was once the butler to an awkward witch who secretly had feelings for him... but the feeling wasn't mutual. Instead, he began courting another servant in the manor, which drove the witch mad with jealousy. Realising that she couldn't hold a candle to his true love, she turned him into a Candleblaster to get her revenge. All in all, not the most illuminating tale.

items.name: Scrollsayer Headgear
items.description: This headgear would make you look like the sorcerer's apprentice if it didn't hide your eyes, giving you a very striking and enigmatic air.

items.name: Scrollsayer Cape
items.description: Magical filaments seem to radiate out from this cape, giving your scrollsayer charm a whole new dimension.

items.name: Scrollsayer Shield
items.description: This shield is set with a genuine faux-caliser gem that gives you better control over Scrollmagic. At least that's what the sales clerk said with a giggle.

items.name: Scrollsayer Shoulder Pads
items.description: Experienced scrollsayers carve defensive runes into their shoulder pads to protect themselves from the undesirable effects of certain spells.

items.name: Sherajah Attire
items.description: The majestic fur used to make this cape is both soft and comforting – and you can sense powerful magic straining at the seams to get out.

items.name: Sherajah Teeth
items.description: Whenever you wear this headgear, people say you look rather long in the tooth. You only hope they mean it literally.

items.name: Sherajah Claws
items.description: The best defence is a strong attack! And there's nothing better than a shield covered in sharp claws when you're on the attack and want to come out on top.

items.name: Sherajah Flames
items.description: Like the burning fire consuming you, these flames provide a feeling of well-being and pure power.

items.name: Devoted Sherajah
items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.name: Loyal Sherajah
items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.name: Untameable Sherajah
items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.name: Spectral Sherajah
items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.name: Blue Hatsofftoyou
items.description: If you want to toss your hat into the ring, the Hatsofftoyou is a good choice. Hats off to you!

items.name: Red Hatsofftoyou
items.description: If you want to toss your hat into the ring, the Hatsofftoyou is a good choice. Hats off to you!

items.name: Yellow Hatsofftoyou
items.description: If you want to toss your hat into the ring, the Hatsofftoyou is a good choice. Hats off to you!

items.name: Green Hatsofftoyou
items.description: If you want to toss your hat into the ring, the Hatsofftoyou is a good choice. Hats off to you!

items.name: Pink Hatsofftoyou
items.description: If you want to toss your hat into the ring, the Hatsofftoyou is a good choice. Hats off to you!

items.name: White Hatsofftoyou
items.description: If you want to toss your hat into the ring, the Hatsofftoyou is a good choice. Hats off to you!

items.name: Armoured Sherajah
items.description: During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

items.name: Klever Kamoot
items.description: With this petsmount, have no worries when you head out in search of bones – you'll have ample warning of any pile-ups along your chosen itinerary. Pro tip: to avoid traffic tie-ups caused by slow-moving dragoturkeys, don't travel at the start or end of major holidays.

items.name: Osteomancer Shield
items.description: This shield will protect you from bad blows during your osteomagic sessions.

items.name: Osteomancer Cape
items.description: Read your future in this cape. To do so, engrave your existential questions along the spine and press it against white-hot tin. Then, all you need to do is interpret the cracks produced by the heat.

items.name: Osteomancer Mask
items.description: When you stare out from behind this mask, the art of osteomancy holds no secrets for you.

items.name: Drakatiay Clan Tiara
items.description: The Clan, or Drakatiay House, like its counterpart Skratiay, contains many fierce fighters. Founded long ago by the fearsome Eghon Drakatiay, this ancient clan affiliated with Dragons inspires fear and respect in both its allies and enemies.

items.name: Drakatiay Clan Attire
items.description:
"We are the Drakatiays, my friends
And we'll keep on fighting till the end
We are the Drakatiays
We are the Drakatiays
No time for losers 
'Cause we are the winners of the cup!"

– Drakatiay House Fans' Anthem

items.name: Drakatiay Clan Caetra
items.description: This year once again, Shask and Midul Katiay, the rulers of the Katiay dynasty, have called for competition. The various Katiay clans – and anyone brave enough, and foolish enough, to want to join them – will battle it out in the Goultard Arenas in order to crown the best fighters in the World of Twelve! Up for grabs: a very handsome sum of kamas, the famous Champion attire, an embossed shield from the Katiay Clan's cupboards, and the glory of having won. That should tempt many to go for it!

items.name: Katiay Clan Shield
items.description:
"The intoxication of combat is deadly, and we are all, dear enemies, caught in its wake."

– Author unknown, probably a member of the Katiay Clan

items.name: Dragosayer
items.description: "The last time I made fun of a Dragosayer's height, he set all my magnificent hair on fire. Such a bummer. I'd been letting it grow for years, ever since I started practising scrollmagic..."

items.name: Weegle Owl
items.description: A problem? A bug? A clever adventurer gave you 10% of your kamas? Don't panic! No need to contact Ankama Support because the adorable Weegle Owl will be there to guide you and dry your tears throughout your adventures in the World of Twelve.

items.name: Crossil
items.description: Some species would be better off going extinct, but when you're made entirely of bones, you don't have much to worry about. If you give your Crossil milk every day, it'll make him stronger and he can stay with you forever!

items.name: B'Wilda Ring
items.description: A strange, not altogether pleasant aura surrounds the wearer of this ring... something dark and deeply unsettling.

items.name: Reinforked Hellmat
items.description: This helmet's creator had the brilliant idea of creating it only after receiving an inordinate number of blows to the head.

items.name: Reinforked Kape
items.description: Washing this cape in water is not at all recommended, unless you want to fight with rusty metal down your back. Instead, apply oilbow grease, mama pingwin oil or even snapper oil with a soft brush.

items.name: Reinforked Shelled
items.description: Much good it may do you if you ever manage to lift this shield. It is at least as heavy as it is effective protection.

items.name: Fuyutora
items.description: This little white chtiger seems to suffer from a failure to thrive that stunted its predatory instincts. The amulet hanging from its ear seems to be a good luck charm... or maybe the cause of the particularity. Taking it might be the only way to know for sure, but doing so would be ill-advised: Byakou, the white chtigers' spirit protector, would hardly appreciate the gesture!

items.name: Kompakt Showldor Pads
items.description: If you ever experience an urge to put your shoulder to the wheel to help someone else, make sure you don't fall asleep at the wheel.

items.name: Ecascot
items.description: Pro tip: keep your purse of kamas out of the paws of this pet if you don't want to end up with snake eyes.

items.name: Ougiscot
items.description: This pet will follow you everywhere, no matter where you go. No point trying to lose it: your scent will betray you, and this pet'll find you faster than you can say "woof".

items.name: Enuscot
items.description: Apparently, pets have a nasty habit of stealing their masters' loot at the end of fights. Obviously, it's just a rumour. But when this pet is with you, you can't help but think about it.

items.name: Elioscot
items.description: If this pet seems to be giving you the side-eye, it's probably because it's staring at you through a portal.

items.name: Eniscot
items.description: Sad and lonely nights will be but a distant memory with this pet. A tiny bit of the blues, and it'll jump at the chance to play the role of a soft, warm stuffy to give you that needed dose of love.

items.name: Hupperscot
items.description: Huppermage elemental magic created this little pet in order to make a faithful and reliable companion. It'll even gobble down the lousy pig kidneys so "lovingly" prepared by your mother-in-law for Sunday tea.

items.name: Eliotrope Cap
items.description: Winter and summer alike, with this hat firmly on your head, you'll be wearing such emblematic Eliotrope gear that you won't go unnoticed any longer.

items.name: Eliotrope Cape
items.description: They say that when Eliotropes pass away, they disappear from memory, as if they had never existed. But how could one ever forget someone who wore this sublime cape? So, maybe...

items.name: Eliotrope Shield
items.description: The great thing about this magic shield is that you can use portals to make your enemies hit themselves. When it comes to defeating powerful opponents, nothing can beat using their own strength against them.

items.name: Eliotrope Dragoturkey
items.description: When you can hop from portal to portal, you really have to wonder if you actually need a dragoturkey... Or if you just have a thing for this noble, worthy animal.

items.name: Eliotrope Seemyool
items.description: Under water, simply cast an elemental spell through a portal to move your seemyool along much faster – almost as if it had a propeller. Be careful, though, they can get hard to control that way.

items.name: Eliotrope Rhineetle
items.description: This rhineetle's shiny horn can guide you like a lighthouse in the night. Make sure you stay focused on the road, though, as any loss of control could result in much higher insurance premiums.

items.name: Nut'Itinem Helmet
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.

items.name: Nut'Itinem Cape
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Nut'Itinem Shield
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.

items.name: Ratteking
items.description: Legends claim that the Ratteking uses a pile of rats, attached together by their tails, as a litter to be carried around in. Perhaps this guy will make room for you on his so you can be carried in triumph at his side.

items.name: Kwismas 651 Treetop
items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.

items.name: Imperiafeline
items.description: This impressive animal is known mainly for being extremely territorial. Train it properly and, together, you'll build an empire. Beware if you neglect it, however, because you're the one who'll pay the price.

items.name: Kwismas Reindeer
items.description: Do you hear those jingling bells? Those crunching footsteps in the snow? It's Kwismas, and this pet is here to remind you of that!

items.name: Vee'two Battler Cloak
items.description: Like the first, this thick cloak will cushion a few smacks on the bottom just as easily.

items.name: Vee'two Battler Helmet
items.description: This helmet always commands respect, no matter who's wearing it.

items.name: Love of the White City
items.description:
"Its days are uncertain, 'tis indeed plain to see;
But such is its age of fine things, so it goes.
Jealous are the fates of our prosperity,
Letting thistle grow wilder than rose."

– Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"

items.name: Wrath of the White City
items.description:
"Let he who would don the mantle of Justice first chase wrath from his heart; for while reason seeks to decide what is just, wrath seeks to deem just that which it has decided, and justice is then but a mask for rage."

– Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"

items.name: Disdain of the White City
items.description:
"We may feel disdain towards the Brakmarians, but we must never lack in respect for them, for underestimating them would be our gravest error and the finest gift we could offer them."

– Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"

items.name: Vanity of the White City
items.description:
"Virtue would not go so far if vanity were not there to keep it company."

– Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"

items.name: Violence of the Dark City
items.description:
"Violence is in us; we all bear it, but only a few pursue it to its full extent."

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"

items.name: Hate of the Dark City
items.description:
"Hate is sacred. It is the indignation of strong and powerful hearts, the militant disdain of those infuriated by all forms of mediocrity and foolishness."

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"

items.name: Contempt of the Dark City
items.description:
"Curse these Bontarians, hold them in as much contempt as you like, but never forget that it is because they are our enemies that we are strong. So cherish your city, your friends and your family, but above all, cherish your enemies."

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"

items.name: Pride of the Dark City
items.description:
"Pride is a rose that grows in the devil's garden, and what could be more intoxicating than the scent of flowers on an enemy's grave?"

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"

items.name: Solar Bear
items.description: The Solar Bear has always been loyal to Father Kwismas, and he'll be loyal to you too. Thanks to its thick, downy coat, you'll never get cold, even on the iciest islands. Rub his belly once in a while to warm up his body.

items.name: Fiduval
items.description: A worthy descendant of a proud line of noble steeds, Fiduval will stay with you wherever you go and remain loyal forever, as long as you don't treat him like some common pony.

items.name: Zephyr
items.description: Zephyr responds to this name because he seems to like it, but don't be fooled – he's a bit hard-headed and you may regret it if you try to go against his will.

items.name: Roc
items.description: Roc is Dragon's oldest son, and the miracle brought about by the Witchfrog. He may not be the nicest one, though, as you'll probably discover.

items.name: Ki Neko Cap
items.description: With this cap equipped, Ecaflip's luck will always smile upon you. Or not! Who knows? And besides... It's not like an adventurer ever got rich just by wearing a cap shaped like a piggy bank.

items.name: Bontarian Banner
items.description: By wearing the attire of the White City, you're proclaiming loud and proud which side you're on. You might want to avoid going to Brakmar dressed like that.

items.name: Brakmarian Banner
items.description: By wearing the attire of the Dark City, you're proclaiming loud and proud which side you're on. You might want to avoid going to Bonta dressed like that.

items.name: Ginger Bow Wow
items.description: You'll be saying "wow" and taking bows every time you take this tiny bow wow out to do its business. Don't tease it too much about the colour of its fur or it just might take a tinkle on your boots.

items.name: Wintry Minifoux
items.description: Unlike its ginger cousin, this Minifoux is decked out for a trip to Kwismas Island. Don't underestimate its sense of smell – it'll help you find even the rarest Kwismas gifts.

items.name: Wintering
items.description: Wearing this ring may have unexpected consequences. It'll let you fit in perfectly in Frigost, but will earn you a cold shoulder in Brakmar. It can also make you a target for snowploughs everywhere. Still, it's better to be a snowflake than a flake! Keeping that winter magic alive is worth it.

items.name: Tooschuss Cap
items.description: "Adventurer, whether you're in town or rushing down the slopes, your ears will never get cold with this cap." Hard to believe the slogan when your ears aren't completely covered, but whatever... They say it's true: satisfaction guaranteed. No refunds!

items.name: Tooschuss Ski Carrier
items.description: When you wear this backpack, you aren't just carrying a simple backpack: you're carrying a simple backpack that is carrying a simple pair of skis.

items.name: Tooschuss Flakeshield
items.description: A sign that you can slide down the slopes without taking a tumble, this shield will show off your prowess as a novice skier from Frigost.

items.name: Blended Breeze Shield
items.description: This shield reminds you of your memorable fight against two experienced masters of the Wukin Breeze and Wukang Breeze. It is perfectly balanced and feels like an extension of your arm.

items.name: Founoroshi Exploshield
items.description: This shield with glowing extremities can be used to light candles or fireworks. The bravest of you can add explosive powder to it to make your blocks explosively good – just watch out for the flashback.

items.name: Father Kwismas Shield
items.description: This repulsive-looking shield is a good representation of the horror children must have faced in this frozen cave. If you stare at it a bit too long, you may get the impression that it's moving.

items.name: Wa Odanowth Shield
items.description: This shield is without a doubt the noblest and most evocative way to defend the values of the Wa Odanowth Cake celebrations.

items.name: Coulive Mask
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate hats.

items.name: Coulive Coat
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.

items.name: Coulive Targe
items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.

items.name: Jiva's Golden Horns
items.description: Jiva the Wise is loyal to the gods, and to Xelor in particular. She moves at the speed of thought, which lets her keep the gods up to date on what's happening down here. Jiva did not end up as the guardian of Javian by chance: as beautiful as she is fearful, her terrible task is to prevent the month of Descendre from running over its allotted time by fighting Djaul in a fierce battle year after year.

items.name: Jiva's Azure Locks
items.description:
"Javian has returned. Fear nought, noble dame!
No matter the passing years and their toll!
My youthful love blooms eternally in my soul.
Your beauty forever on your brow does flame.

Be solemn and sweet, oh, she who I adore.
Let your halo blind my eyes, I do implore!
As pure milk poured in a vase of alabaster,
May your courage be my heart's master.

Bear the fleeting time, for your beauty does protect.
Bear the winter, for soon Maysial shall resurrect.
The gods, to erase age and melt the snow,
Shall bring back spring so our love may grow."

— "Javian has returned", Frigostian poem

items.name: Jiva's Radiant Aegis
items.description:
"The wise square off without injuring, bend without doing harm, correct without violence, and gleam without blinding."

— Jiva the Wise, Guardian of Javian

items.name: Javian Spirit
items.description: This mysterious but nevertheless adorable little spirit would follow you everywhere if it wasn't constantly tortured by the eternal question: to Jiva or not to Jiva? Until that's cleared up, it's decided not to move.

items.name: Messenger Shoulder Pads
items.description: When you must deliver a message, nothing can stop you. Thanks to these shoulder pads, you can be even rasher in your deliveries. Be careful, though. A clumsy messenger who bumps into walls could scare children – unless, of course, that messenger is wearing red and coming down the chimney.

items.name: Docile Shoulder Pads
items.description: You aren't the type to get let orders throw you off your game. On the contrary, you like taking orders. So, when you were told to wear these shoulder pads, you said "Sure, where?" Now, you're ready for anything! Why not start with a little light dusting?

items.name: Flitter-Flutter Shoulder Pads
items.description: To give your body a feeling of unparalleled freedom, these shoulder pads are surprisingly elastic and so light that you'll feel like you're floating on a cloud. Just make sure you don't flit too close to the sun. Unless you want to become a myth, that is...

items.name: Vigilante Shoulder Pads
items.description: You got these shoulder pads at vigilante school on equipment selection day. They hold great sentimental value for you and remind you of the golden years when you were learning to become the legend you are today.

items.name: Malicious Shoulder Pads
items.description: Living in the shadow of an illustrious hero has taught you to act in secret to achieve your goals. Now, however, you've decided to come out of the shadows and have found these shoulder pads to match your new ambitions.

items.name: Assassin Shoulder Pads
items.description: If you're wondering what buckles are doing on these shoulder pads, you should know that Oize the assassin is extremely concerned about doing right by the environment and so he recycled old belts found languishing in the back of his closet at his hideout.

items.name: Flavoured Shoulder Pads
items.description: If you concentrate hard enough, you might be able to detect a taste that vaguely reminds you of your nan's biscuits.

items.name: Imperial Shoulder Pads
items.description: These shoulder pads will finally make you look like the military leader you dream of being. Just be careful you don't let it go to your head! You might end up exiled on castaway island.

items.name: Tribal Warrior Shoulder Pads
items.description: Decked out in these shoulder pads, you'll stride the battlefields like a true Paztek warrior. Disclaimer: this get-up does not protect from epidemics and deadly fevers.

items.name: Slayer Shoulder Pads
items.description: Now here's a piece of equipment that seems to come from a distant land... Despite appearances, though, it's easy to get a pair if you've got spunk enough to cross the bridge and visit the Pandala market.

items.name: Heartbreaker Hat
items.description: When you think about it, it's rather ironic that a heart breaker would put so much heart into breaking other people's hearts.

items.name: Kworrel Cape
items.description: What could be better than a rousing quarrel to weaken love, that constant connection just dripping with tenderness?

items.name: Reluctant Heart Shield
items.description: This shield will protect you from the thunderbolt that is love at first sight and those abominable flirts that might otherwise soften your heart of stone.

items.name: Love's Woes Shoulder Pads
items.description: These shoulder pads will defeat all those fickle hearts, including those of marble, stone, gold or anything else really.

items.name: Silvosse's Robust Headband
items.description: Silvosse, the master of cuttings, is a robust being who may seem rude at times but shows a great sensibility when it comes to vegetation. He makes sure the souls of the flora that have been sapped by the winter cold get to heaven and gives strength and life to trees so they can resist the freeze. He strides constantly through the forests and knows the names of each creature of the vegetable people.

items.name: Silvosse's Plant Mantle
items.description:
"And now, full of promise, Flovor returns,
All around, the bulbush buds do strengthen;
Snow may fall, but the cold no longer burns,
And already we feel each day does lengthen.

Spring is born, and cold winter decays;
The fields and meadows in green are dressed,
The treechnid's sap warms in the sun's gaze,
Soon, tofus in his canopy shall nest.

A radiant, glowing sun floods the atoll,
Gardens bloom in melodious celebration,
And I feel, under my feet as I stroll,
The soil quiver in hopeful anticipation."

— "Flovor", Amaknian poem in homage to Silvosse

items.name: Silvosse's Gnarled Bark
items.description: Carrying this shield isn't enough to ensure won't become deadwood.

items.name: Flovor Spirit
items.description: Make no mistake – this spirit's vivacity resides in its incredible resistance to seasonal changes in the weather, and not in its mental facilities.

items.name: Chtiger Ears
items.description: They claim that these ears improve your hearing, letting you hear everything from kilokametres away. Sadly, you won't be able to feign deafness in response to mumbled remarks about your bad taste, body odour, or even your paltry combat skills.

items.name: Chtiger Aegis
items.description: Legend says that this shield once belonged to Ninezen, an illustrious warrior-monk from Pandala. The deep gashes adorning this piece of protective gear are said to be scars from the white chtigre Byakou's trial. The animal spirit and the monk became friends, united by their respect for each other and their love of Pandala Island.

items.name: Chtiger Cape
items.description: Despite appearances, no chtigers were harmed in the making of this cape. The tail and fur are fakes, made out of synthetic materials produced by Phang the alchemist in Pandala.

items.name: Chtiger Armbands
items.description: These ornamental shoulder pads typical of Pandala are traditionally worn during the Feudala lantern festival. As chtigers are naturally connected to this region, many of its inhabitants don this accessory throughout the Year of the Chtiger to pay homage to these felines.

items.name: Cocoa Shield
items.description: Enough sugar to give a Trool diabetes.

items.name: Ruby Tibilax
items.description: Don't trust that cute little rosy face – Shushus are usually bloodthirsty, terrifying and cruel. So it's probably a bad idea to snuggle up to this pet for comfort on those long winter nights. It's impossible to say which body part you'll lose if you do.

items.name: Damadrya's Vegetal Shield
items.description: Fashion trends come and go. To ensure your look is always on point, there's nothing better than getting back to the source of everything: nature. This is especially true now when the ecology is everyone's top priority. Therefore, you've decided to use this 100% natural shield. Be careful not to store it too close to your fireplace in winter. Accidents happen so quickly.

items.name: Huge Silouate Horns
items.description:
If you wake up at dawn in the month of Aperirel, you can sometimes catch sight of a bovine silhouette with enormous horns, wrapped in a thick cloud of fog. This is Silouate, taking a brief moment to rest during his endless race across the world.
The Minotoror has agreed to use his great endurance in service to Xelor and all Twelvians by using his hot breath to drive the last remaining crystals of frost from the branches of the newly budding trees.

items.name: Silouate's Bronze Cowbell
items.description:
"On the horizon, a flock moves
Led by Silouate, Minotoror
Running among his fellows
Spreading his hot misty breath

They have a whole world to cross
Pausing briefly, only rarely
Before their journey resumes
To complete their task in time

Beyond the horizon goes the flock
Neither slowed nor stopped by naught 
He charges straight across the fields
And on his way sows seeds of spring

At long last, the fog will disperse
The sound of hooves will fade away
'Till naught but echoes do remain
Until the next month has its day."

— "Aperirel's Race", Amaknian poem

items.name: Silouate's Downy Bull Bars
items.description:
Have you ever seen Taurs playing? You may be shocked by the brutality of the scene but imagine a gobbowl match without a ball, and even fewer rules!

When these horned mountains of muscle start charging at each other, it's best to be equipped with some bull bars – not to fend off a direct hit (yeah, just forget about that), but to give you some chance of getting out of their way before you end up trampled flat.

items.name: Spirit of Aperirel
items.description: This may surprise you, but oddly enough, this spirit is hibernating. It will wake up in the spring with an outsize appetite and get right to work trimming your lawn with its front teeth to get things ready for outdoor fun.

items.name: Ulgrude's Electric Hairdo
items.description:
Ulgrude is the herald of spring. With its downpours and its unseasonal hails, this month is just like its guardian: capricious, but generous because he presides over the resurrection of all vegetation.

Ulgrude of Thunder is a versatile entity, who can go from anger to tears faster than you can say "mood swing". Hail, thunder and other adverse weather conditions depend on his emotions. Fundamentally good but unaware of his own strength, Ulgrude has a pure and childlike spirit. He can be easily manipulated by any ill-intentioned being...

In love but spurned by Jiva, Ulgrude will do whatever it takes to please her... The god Iop, who is very fond of him, often asks the goddess Eniripsa to ensure that nobody gets hurt as a result of his emotional outbursts.

items.name: Ulgrude's Stormy Sky
items.description:
After having brought down Hyrkul the Tendentious, Djaul's champion, Ulgrude earned the heroic title "of Thunder". Even though the Black Giant, at they very gates of Externam, later managed to return in the form of a lich, this victory was the fight that ended the first Crimson Dawn.

What is more, after the death of Menalt during the battle, killed by Hyrkul, Ulgrude was named the new protector of Martalo and head of the Order of the Valiant Heart.

items.name: Ulgrude's Spurned Love
items.description:
"Take these fruits and flowers, leaves and sprigs,
And take my heart, too; it beats only for you.
May your hands so white not tear it in two,
And may your eyes at its sight dance jigs.
Here I come, still moist with morning dew
That the morning breeze makes chilly as sleet.
Allow my weariness to lay down at your feet
And dream of dear moments to rest anew."

— Love letter from Ulgrude to Jiva

items.name: Martalo Spirit
items.description: Don't try to get rid of the spirit of Martalo by tossing it in the tip – or you might end up tipped over and tossed out yourself.

items.name: Ochre Dragon Helmet
items.description: From the heights of the Tree Koholo blows a wind so cold that it makes many adventurers ill. That's why this helmet is designed to cover your ears so snugly. Not only that, its unique style and sparkling colours will give you an intimidating edge in battle.

items.name: Ochre Dragon Cape
items.description: Like the tail of a dragon, this cape will be the last thing your dying enemies will see. So you've decided to give them a chance to appreciate your style in their final moments.

items.name: Ochre Dragon Targe
items.description: When protected by this shield, you'll feel as untouchable as if you were under the wing of a dragon protecting its Dofus. It seems impossible to break, giving you immense confidence in your abilities and allowing you to achieve your full potential.

items.name: Arjan's Mane
items.description: Arjan was known for his brutal prowess at breaking shields on the battlefield and breaking roguish hearts at home. Though you may never equal his strength, you hope that by wearing his mane, you'll finally achieve your lifelong dream of easily getting dates with dubious ruffians.

items.name: Arjan's Cape
items.description: This high-fashion cape perfectly showcased Arjan's chiselled form. It's not quite as good a fit on you... maybe it's time to start using that gym membership.

items.name: Arjan's Shield
items.description: Thanks to his impressive dodging abilities, Arjan never had to use his shield. So he chose a design that was elegant, but not necessarily very tough. Let's hope you're as agile as he was.

items.name: Arjan's Wings
items.description: To rise to the level of the gods he venerated, Arjan made these wings for himself. And now it's your turn to wear them. Hey, at least they'll help you get up a little quicker next time you slip and fall in the shower.

items.name: Aurum's Helmet
items.description: This helmet radiates an immense sense of prestige. When you wear it, you feel as strong as a lion!

items.name: Aurum's Cape
items.description: Long ago, certain gods apparently tried to steal Aurum's cape. Now that you're the one wearing it, beware of the jealousy it causes!

items.name: Aurum's Shield
items.description: They say that Aurum inherited this shield from the goddess Feca Hatena herself... Now this relic is in your hands, so be sure to take good care of it!

items.name: Aurum's Attire
items.description: "Gold, gold, always more gold," that was Aurum's motto. One look at his attire and you can see why he was so obsessed.

items.name: Golden Armour
items.description: What's nice about pure gold is that it's relatively soft and easy to shape, so this golden armour lets you move easily and with great agility. But be careful – opponents looking to get rich quick may try to steal it when you're in the arena.

items.name: Terrak
items.description: No Twelvian can boast of having tamed a Primordial Dragon, especially when it's sleeping in its Dofus. Against all odds, this dream vision of Terrakourial seems to have taken a liking to you. It's decided to make you its pet.

items.name: Ether Hood
items.description: They say that wearing this hood will change how you see the world. A single drop forms, and suddenly you're at the helm of bold and tumultuous thoughts. As though intertwining murmurs of disembodied laughter had slipped in to draw back a Veil.

items.name: Tumult Cape
items.description: When you wear this cape, all roads will lead you to the library at Lhambadda Manor, A place filled with mysterious and contradictory knowledge. Then again, who'd be foolish enough to believe everything they read in books?

items.name: Shield of Possibilities
items.description: Besides offering a barrier against the tedium and gloom of everyday life, this aegis is adorned with a big smile that will disarm even the grimmest of warriors! Some even say you can hear Shariva laughing with every axe blow it turns aside.

items.name: Fleestofura
items.description: If you aren't pleased at the idea of celebrating Fleaster, bring this pet along with you.

items.name: Fleastrecker Headgear
items.description: If you're heading to Fleaster Island this year for more chocolate, this headgear will come in handy and protect your head from flying hazelnut shrapnel. In addition, you can use it like a bucket to carry your loot!

items.name: Fleastrecker Cape
items.description: The ribbons that make up this cape used to decorate Fleaster Eggs. How ironic! They now come with a huge mallet bearing the Fleastreckers' seal – just perfect for crushing even the most solid caramel statues.

items.name: Fleastrecker Shield
items.description: Every year at about the same time, the market is suddenly flooded with a glut of highly suspicious commodities. And why? Well, it seems that unscrupulous adventurers wreak havoc on Fleaster Island in order to sell as much chocolate as they can to all the bakers and chocolate makers in the World of Twelve.

items.name: Crunchler Shield
items.description: The gold leaf that adorns this shield does not need to prove its strength – it will protect you as well as it protected the chocolaty "charms" of its former owner.

items.name: Selenic Diadem
items.description: People will be positively mooning over you when you wear this diadem.

items.name: Selenic Cape
items.description: If the full moon is keeping you awake, put on this cape. You probably won't sleep any better, but it'll light up your face making it seem like you slept well.

items.name: Selenic Shield
items.description: Carrying this shield is one small step for Twelvians, one giant leap for adventurers.

items.name: Glow-with-the-Flow Mask
items.description: You don't need a hydrating, purifying or soothing mask! With the glow-with-the-flow mask, you face will be glowing and absolutely flawless.

items.name: Glow-with-the-Flow Cape
items.description: This cape adapts to the outside temperature and gives off a constant flow of warmth. How? It catches the Sun's rays and turns them into energy.

items.name: Glow-with-the-Flow Shield
items.description: This shield is a two-for-one marvel. Use it to fend off blows or fend off sunburn.

items.name: Mystery Man Beret
items.description: Everyone who runs into the Mystery Man asks themself why he's always carrying around a spoon. Everyone has a theory but no one knows for sure. Is it a lucky charm? A souvenir? Something to remind himself that he's not dreaming? For most people, though, it's just the final finishing touch to this unusual man's intriguing personality.

items.name: Mystery Man Coat
items.description: The Mystery Man's modesty has always been at odds with his elegance. In a world where everyone looks alike, he stays true to himself and imposes his sense of style wherever he goes. If ever you encounter him in the World of Twelve or Externam, you'll be struck by his subtlety. Class can't be bought.

items.name: Mystery Man Pocket Watch
items.description: They say that the Mystery Man and his hairy acolyte spend all their time testing the solidity of every item they're given. Yet, they are never late for a break when it's time to talk about new ideas and tell stories. That's probably thanks to this huge pocket watch, which always shows the right time. After all, punctuality is the mark of a true gentleman.

items.name: Glorificus
items.description: When the sun's rays fall on this pet, everything seems brighter. With it by your side, you'll look like you're ready to accomplish great feats.

items.name: Rosal Refined Diadem
items.description: Rosal, the Guardian of Maysial, is both telepathic and empathic. Living creatures can't hide their thoughts or emotions from him. He's also known as the "Master of Flowers" because he communicates with them and helps them blossom. He's really proud of this ability, and he doesn't miss an opportunity to boast about it to the other Protectors. This is what led Pouchecot, who was fed up with his overt displays of pride, to maliciously call him the "Em-Pathetic Protector".

items.name: Rosal Fragrant Coat
items.description:
Rosal is extremely busy in the month of Maysial. He takes his work really seriously: helping flowers and other living beings blossom. The rest of the year, he retires to his crystal palace, which looks like a giant greenhouse. His heightened sensitivity makes him keep to himself, but he doesn't mind the odd visit, especially when the people visiting him stroke his ego.

So, he spends most of his time gaining knowledge in medicinal plants and concocting all sorts of experimental remedies. He also tries out new fragrances to suit his mood.

items.name: Rosal Floral Petal
items.description:
"Gracious Maysial, in his boat on the river
As flowers look down from the mountaintops
They are lovely but the stream will not stop
But who made the ancient willows quiver? 
Lush orchards stand still in the backdrop
Petals fall from all the trees sky high
Rosal's creations, it's like they can fly
Now they trickle down like mournful teardrops
Gracious Maysial has adorned what remains
With ivy, rosebush and hedge
The wind shakes the river to its edges
And the reeds and plants bristle again"

— "Maysial", Amaknian poem

items.name: Maysial Spirit
items.description:
"For the love of a rose, the gardener becomes the slave of a thousand thorns."

— Rosal

items.name: Green Helnut
items.description: They said you'd have to be off your Helnut to go on an adventure like this, so you went and bought one.

items.name: Red Helnut
items.description: They said you'd have to be off your Helnut to go on an adventure like this, so you went and bought one.

items.name: Blue Helnut
items.description: They said you'd have to be off your Helnut to go on an adventure like this, so you went and bought one.

items.name: Yellow Helnut
items.description: They said you'd have to be off your Helnut to go on an adventure like this, so you went and bought one.

items.name: White Helnut
items.description: They said you'd have to be off your Helnut to go on an adventure like this, so you went and bought one.

items.name: Black Helnut
items.description: They said you'd have to be off your Helnut to go on an adventure like this, so you went and bought one.

items.name: Sumens's Pointy Hat
items.description:
Sumens, Protector of the month of Junssidor and renowned alchemist, received a gift from his god – a power as extraordinary as it is, err, binding:
the ability to turn everything he eats into valuable items. The old man is thus able to produce a considerable quantity of precious stones, gold nuggets and cut gems in all sorts of shapes and sizes.

From time to time, he even manages to produce high-quality artefacts capable of rivalling the work of the best magi and crafters in the World of Twelve (that said, expelling a sharpened blade really isn't the most pleasant part of the process).

Given just how time-consuming and sensitive this activity can be, Sumens hates being disturbed when he's doing his business. This is why he spends much of the month of Junssidor moving from thicket to thicket to evacuate his providential excreta away from greedy eyes.

items.name: Sumens's Capelet
items.description:
Urinating in a stream barely dulls the water's sheen,
But defecating in a lagoon feeds the snappers right soon!

Eliminating breakfast can make the morning pass too fast,
But emptying one's bowels in a field increases the farmer's yield.

I love taking dumps in thickets, to the sound of singing crickets,
Or in my friend Dede's satchel – please don't tattle...

Because if Dede catches me in the act,
He's sure to rip out my intestinal tract.

— "Tormented Digestion", an Amaknian nursery rhyme

items.name: Sumens's Nomadic Ease
items.description:
Have you ever run into Sumens, the Protector of the month of Junssidor? It is always interesting to point out – at formal dinners or simply in casual conversation over a frothy tankard – that this Enutrof spends less time ensuring the proper passing of the seasons than he does the proper passing of the many treasures that are the fruits of his digestion.

Because of this, and to ensure some degree of comfort in cases of force majeure, it is said that he never goes anywhere without his own personal portable amenities.

Indeed, this item may at first glance look like a buckle adorned roughly with imposing gold nuggets, but it is actually a portable toilet seat that lets Sumens get comfortable, for example by balancing it over two rocks.

items.name: Junssidor Spirit
items.description: This little chap seems to be one of the last representatives of his species and, indeed, most of his kind have ended up in crushers.

items.name: Reincarnated Garudania
items.description: Garudania's cycle reminds you of your own story. Having started from nothing, you've managed to grow and shine with what you've achieved. Once this whole blaze of glory has consumed you, you too can start afresh. That is the path of an adventurer.

items.name: Incubated Garudania
items.description: Garudania's cycle reminds you of your own story. Having started from nothing, you've managed to grow and shine with what you've achieved. Once this whole blaze of glory has consumed you, you too can start afresh. That is the path of an adventurer.

items.description: Garudania's cycle reminds you of your own story. Having started from nothing, you've managed to grow and shine with what you've achieved. Once this whole blaze of glory has consumed you, you too can start afresh. That is the path of an adventurer.
